    const (
        VideoAssembleSliceID      = "video.assemble.slice.v1"
        VideoAssembleSliceVersion = 1
    )
    
    // videoAssembleSliceExecutor renders source windows on the selected worker.
    // It downloads/certifies full provider sources via the common asset resolver,
    // then makes one FFmpeg pass directly from those sources to the final mux.
    // No Producer-side fragments or worker-side intermediate video files exist.
    type videoAssembleSliceExecutor struct {
        runner     ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner
        prober     sliceMediaProber
        outputRoot string
    }
    
    type sliceMediaProber interface {
        ProbeMediaDetails(context.Context, string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error)
    }
    
    type ffprobeSliceMediaProber struct{}
    
    func (ffprobeSliceMediaProber) ProbeMediaDetails(ctx context.Context, path string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error) {
        return publisher.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, path)
    }
    
    func NewVideoAssembleSlice(outputRoot string, runner ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner) executor.Executor {
        if strings.TrimSpace(outputRoot) == "" {
            outputRoot = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "velox", "video-assemble-slice")
        }
        if runner == nil {
            runner = ffmpegrunner.NewProcessRunner()
        }
        return &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: ffprobeSliceMediaProber{}, outputRoot: outputRoot}
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Descriptor() executor.Descriptor {
        return executor.Descriptor{
            ID: VideoAssembleSliceID, Version: VideoAssembleSliceVersion,
            InputTypes: []string{"render.compiled.v2.drive"}, OutputTypes: []string{"video/mp4"},
            ResourceClass: executor.ResourceCPU, Deterministic: true, Cacheable: true,
            TemporalMode: executor.TemporalGlobal,
        }
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Validate(spec executor.TaskSpec) error {
        if spec.ExecutorID != VideoAssembleSliceID {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: executor_id must be %q", VideoAssembleSliceID)
        }
        if e == nil || e.runner == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFmpeg runner is not configured")
        }
        if e.prober == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFprobe media validation is not configured")
        }
        plan, err := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: invalid CompiledRenderPlanV2: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: canonical output profile required: %w", err)
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        hasDrive := false
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
            driveSource := asset.Kind == "video" && (asset.SourceKind == "drive" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(asset.AssetID), "drive:"))
            hasDrive = hasDrive || driveSource
        }
        if !hasDrive {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: plan must contain at least one Drive video source")
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: exactly one non-empty video track is required")
        }
        var nextFrame int64
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset, ok := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || (asset.Kind != "video" && asset.Kind != "prepared_video_fragment") {
                return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q must reference a video asset", segment.SegmentID)
            }
            if segment.TimelineStartFrame != nextFrame {
                return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q leaves a timeline gap or overlap at frame %d", segment.SegmentID, nextFrame)
            }
            nextFrame += segment.FrameCount
        }
        framesNum := int64(plan.DurationUS) * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        framesDen := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        wantFrames := (framesNum + framesDen - 1) / framesDen
        if nextFrame != wantFrames {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: timeline has %d frames, plan duration requires %d", nextFrame, wantFrames)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Execute(ctx context.Context, execCtx executor.ExecutionContext, spec executor.TaskSpec) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
        started := time.Now().UTC()
        fail := func(code string, err error) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
            return executor.ExecutionResult{Status: "failed", ErrorCode: code, ErrorDetail: err.Error(), StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC()}, nil
        }
        if err := e.Validate(spec); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        plan, _ := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        bindings, ok := runtimeassets.FromContext(ctx)
        if !ok {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_MISSING", errors.New("verified runtime asset bindings are required"))
        }
        profile, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        if err := e.verifyDriveSources(ctx, plan, bindings); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SOURCE_VALIDATION_FAILED", err)
        }
        jobID, err := safeOutputJobID(spec.JobID)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("INVALID_JOB_ID", err)
        }
        outputPath := filepath.Join(e.outputRoot, jobID+".mp4")
        if resolver := storageResolverFromExecutionContext(execCtx); resolver != nil {
            if placement, placeErr := resolver.Place(storage.ArtifactStaging, jobID+".mp4", estimateOutputBytesFromDuration(plan.DurationUS)); placeErr == nil {
                outputPath = placement.Path
            }
        }
        if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(outputPath), 0o750); err != nil {
            return fail("OUTPUT_DIRECTORY", err)
        }
        args, err := sliceRenderArgs(plan, bindings, outputPath, profile)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", err)
        }
        metrics, renderErr := e.runner.Run(ctx, ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRequest{Operation: ffmpegrunner.OperationEncode, Args: args})
        if renderErr != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_RENDER_FAILED", renderErr)
        }
        if err := e.verifyFinalMedia(ctx, outputPath, plan); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        artifact, err := artifactFromFile("video/mp4", outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("FINAL_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        raw := rawMetricsFromFFmpegResult(metrics)
        raw.OutputBytes = artifact.SizeBytes
        raw.OutputFileSize = artifact.SizeBytes
        raw.OutputSha256 = artifact.Hash
        raw.EncodePasses = 1
        raw.ConcatMode = "reencode"
        raw.FinalConcatStreamCopy = false
        raw.MediaDurationSeconds = float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        raw.WallClockSeconds = float64(metrics.ProcessWallMS) / 1000
        return executor.ExecutionResult{
            Status: "succeeded", Outputs: []executor.ArtifactRef{artifact}, RawMetrics: raw,
            StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
        }, nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyDriveSources(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if asset.SourceKind != "drive" && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(asset.AssetID), "drive:") {
                continue
            }
            if _, done := seen[asset.AssetID]; done {
                continue
            }
            seen[asset.AssetID] = struct{}{}
            binding := bindings[asset.AssetID]
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("probe Drive source %q: %w", asset.AssetID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.DurationSec <= 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q has no valid video stream/duration", asset.AssetID)
            }
            actualUS := int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000)
            if absoluteDurationDifference(actualUS, asset.DurationUS) > 1_000_000 {
                return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q duration mismatch: plan=%d us probed=%d us", asset.AssetID, asset.DurationUS, actualUS)
            }
            for _, requested := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
                if requested.AssetID != asset.AssetID {
                    continue
                }
                windowEnd := requested.SourceInUS + requested.SourceDurationUS
                frameUS := int64(1_000_000 * plan.Output.FPSDen / plan.Output.FPSNum)
                if windowEnd > actualUS+frameUS {
                    return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q window ends at %d us beyond probed duration %d us", asset.AssetID, windowEnd, actualUS)
                }
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func absoluteDurationDifference(left, right int64) int64 {
        if left >= right {
            return left - right
        }
        return right - left
    }

    // TaskSpec is the typed, validated, versioned representation of the work
    // a task must perform. It is serialized for transport and storage but
    // must be validated before persistence. A deterministic spec_hash is
    // stored alongside for integrity verification.
    type TaskSpec struct {
        Version    int                    `json:"version"`
        JobID      string                 `json:"job_id"`
        ExecutorID string                 `json:"executor_id"`
        Payload    map[string]interface{} `json:"payload,omitempty"`
        // DeliveryPlan is control-plane routing data. It is persisted into
        // job_delivery_plans and must never be sent to the renderer in Payload.
        // The map retains the canonical delivery_plan/legacy alias envelope so
        // the shared parser remains the single shape owner.
        DeliveryPlan map[string]interface{} `json:"delivery_plan,omitempty"`
        // PublicationSpecs are control-plane publication intents. They are
        // retained with the canonical spec but are never included in Payload.
        PublicationSpecs     []map[string]interface{} `json:"publication_specs,omitempty"`
        RequiredCapabilities []string                 `json:"required_capabilities,omitempty"`
        // Assembly is control-plane preparation metadata. It is persisted with
        // the task spec but is never included in Payload sent to the renderer.
        Assembly *assembly.AssemblyJobV1 `json:"assembly,omitempty"`
    }
    
    // Validate checks the task spec for structural correctness.
    // Both master and worker MUST pass this check before persisting or
    // executing a spec. Executor implementations may add stricter checks
    // via their own Validate method.
    }
    
    // AssetRefV2 is a typed, path-free reference to one plan asset. Ordinary and
    // prepared assets carry verified content identity. Drive stock sources may
    // instead carry source_kind/drive_file_id and duration metadata; the worker
    // downloads and certifies those bytes before rendering.
    type AssetRefV2 struct {
        AssetID  string `json:"asset_id"`
        AssetKey string `json:"asset_key,omitempty"`
        // SourceKind and DriveFileID identify provider-backed stock inputs. These
        // references are resolved and verified by the worker at execution time;
        // unlike prepared fragments, they need not be downloaded by the Producer.
        SourceKind  string `json:"source_kind,omitempty"`
        DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id,omitempty"`
    
        SHA256    string `json:"sha256"`
        SizeBytes int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
    
        Kind string `json:"kind"`
        MIME string `json:"mime,omitempty"`
    
        DurationUS int64 `json:"duration_us,omitempty"`
        Width      int   `json:"width,omitempty"`
        Height     int   `json:"height,omitempty"`
    
        // Prepared-fragment admission metadata. Optional for ordinary V2 assets;

        FirstFrameKeyframe bool   `json:"first_frame_keyframe,omitempty"`
        ClosedGOP          bool   `json:"closed_gop,omitempty"`
    }

    func (s *TaskSpec) Validate() error {
        if s == nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: TaskSpec is nil", ErrInvalidSpec)

        if s.Version <= 0 {

    package executors
    
    import (
    	"encoding/json"
    	"net/url"
    	"strings"
    
    	"velox-shared/contract"
    )
    
    // sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs resolves Drive transport locators from the
    // Producer's runtime manifest without changing the hash-bound render plan.
    // The runtime manifest is joined to the plan by its stable asset ID/key.
    func sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(raw interface{}) map[string]string {
    	encoded, err := json.Marshal(raw)
    	if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || string(encoded) == "null" {
    		return nil
    	}
    	var assets []struct {
    		AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
    		AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
    		DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
    		URL         string `json:"url"`
    		SourceURI   string `json:"source_uri"`
    	}
    	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &assets); err != nil {
    		return nil
    	}
    	byIdentity := make(map[string]string, len(assets)*2)
    	for _, asset := range assets {
    		fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
    		if fileID == "" {
    			for _, locator := range []string{asset.URL, asset.SourceURI} {
    				u, parseErr := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(locator))
    				if parseErr != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "velox-drive") {
    					continue
    				}
    				fileID = strings.TrimSpace(u.Host)
    				if fileID == "" {
    					fileID = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(u.Path), "/")
    				}
    				if fileID != "" {
    					break
    				}
    			}
    		}
    		if fileID == "" {
    			continue
    		}
    		for _, identity := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
    			if identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity); identity != "" {
    				byIdentity[identity] = fileID
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	return byIdentity
    }
    
    func isSliceDriveSource(asset contract.AssetRefV2, runtimeDriveIDs map[string]string) bool {
    	if asset.SourceKind == "drive" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:") {
    		return true
    	}
    	return sliceDriveFileID(asset, runtimeDriveIDs) != ""
    }
    
    func sliceDriveFileID(asset contract.AssetRefV2, runtimeDriveIDs map[string]string) string {
    	if fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID); fileID != "" {
    		return fileID
    	}
    	for _, identity := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
    		if fileID := strings.TrimSpace(runtimeDriveIDs[strings.TrimSpace(identity)]); fileID != "" {
    			return fileID
    		}
    	}
    	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:") {
    		return strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID[len("drive:"):])
    	}
    	return ""
    }

    $ sed -n '1,38p' .github/workflows/worker-image.yml; gh run list --repo Marcuss-ops/VeloxEditiingg --limit 8 --json databaseId,name,status,conclusion,workflowName,createdAt,url
    ---
    # PR D — Worker Docker image release pipeline.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Phase 1 of 100% Velox certification plan (cap. 2): every published digest
    # is sign + verify + baseline-recorded + bootstrap-tested under REAL deps
    # before the operator side ever sees a tag. NO `:latest`. NO fake-ffmpeg
    # bootstrap smoke. NO unsigned image accepted.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    name: Worker image release
    
    on:
      push:
        tags:
          - 'worker-v*'
        branches:
          - main
        paths:
          - 'RemoteCodex/native/worker-agent-go/**'
          - 'RemoteCodex/native/video-engine-cpp/**'
          - 'RemoteCodex/scripts/build-video-engine.sh'
          - 'shared/**'
          - 'VERSION.txt'
          - '.github/workflows/worker-image.yml'
          - '.github/actions/worker-*/**'
          - 'scripts/ci/test-worker-image-freshness.py'
          - 'scripts/ci/check-mixed-render-gate.sh'
      workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
          version:
            description: 'Version label (e.g. 1.2.3 or v1.2.3-rc1). The leading v is optional.'
            required: true
            default: ''
          no_push:
            description: 'Build + sign skipped locally — do NOT push, do NOT sign.'
            required: false
            default: 'false'
            type: boolean

    func (p *ProtectedAssetsPoller) invalidateReadiness() {
        p.mu.Lock()
        p.sessionEpoch++
        p.lastPollErr = ErrProtectedSnapshotSessionUnavailable
        p.mu.Unlock()
        p.readyMu.Lock()
        if p.ready {
            // The ready channel is already closed for the completed session;
            // waiters have been released. Replace it with an open channel for
            // the new session so future waiters cannot inherit old readiness.
            p.ready = false
            p.readyCh = make(chan struct{})
        }
        p.readyMu.Unlock()
        telemetry.MarkCacheProtectionReady(false)
    }
    
    func (p *ProtectedAssetsPoller) recordPollError(err error) {
        p.mu.Lock()
        p.lastPollErr = err
        p.mu.Unlock()
    }

    //     circuit-breaker rejection all leave p.snap untouched. The
    //     cleanup loop receives an error from Current and performs no

        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))

Il replay ha superato il controllo delle durate e ha raggiunto FFmpeg, ma ora si ferma aprendo il 27º decoder: `Resource temporarily unavailable`. Il piano contiene molte sorgenti e FFmpeg sta creando troppi thread automatici per i decoder in parallelo. Limito i thread per input e per il filtro video, poi preparo un altro rollout; gli asset restano in cache e non vengono riscaricati dal Producer.

            if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != binding.Size {

            }
            inputIndex[segment.AssetID] = len(inputs)
            inputs = append(inputs, binding.Path)
        }
        audio, ok := bindings[plan.FinalAudio.AssetID]
        if !ok || !audio.Verified || audio.Size <= 0 || audio.SHA256 == "" {

        }
        if audio.SHA256 != plan.FinalAudio.SHA256 || audio.Size != plan.FinalAudio.SizeBytes {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio integrity binding does not match the plan")
        }
        if info, err := os.Stat(audio.Path); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != audio.Size {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio local file identity is invalid")
        }
        audioIndex := len(inputs)
        inputs = append(inputs, audio.Path)
        fps := strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.FPSNum) + "/" + strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.FPSDen)
        filters := make([]string, 0, len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments)+1)
        labels := make([]string, 0, len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments))
        for i, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            windowEnd := segment.SourceInUS + segment.SourceDurationUS
            if segment.SourceInUS < 0 || segment.SourceDurationUS <= 0 || (!isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs) && windowEnd > asset.DurationUS) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("segment %q source window exceeds declared duration", segment.SegmentID)
            }
            label := fmt.Sprintf("v%d", i)
            filters = append(filters, fmt.Sprintf("[%d:v:0]trim=start=%s:duration=%s,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps=%s,scale=%d:%d:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=%d:%d:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,setsar=1,format=%s,trim=end_frame=%d,setpts=N/(%s*TB)[%s]",
                inputIndex[segment.AssetID], seconds(segment.SourceInUS), seconds(segment.SourceDurationUS), fps,
                plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height, profile.PixelFormat, segment.FrameCount, fps, label))
            labels = append(labels, "["+label+"]")
        }
        filters = append(filters, strings.Join(labels, "")+fmt.Sprintf("concat=n=%d:v=1:a=0[vout]", len(labels)))
        args := []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y"}
        for _, input := range inputs {
            args = append(args, "-i", input)
        }
        args = append(args, "-filter_complex", strings.Join(filters, ";"), "-map", "[vout]", "-map", fmt.Sprintf("%d:a:0", audioIndex),
            "-t", seconds(plan.DurationUS), "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-profile:v", profile.CodecProfile,
            "-level:v", profile.CodecLevel, "-pix_fmt", profile.PixelFormat, "-r", fps, "-g", strconv.Itoa(profile.GOPSize),
            "-keyint_min", strconv.Itoa(profile.GOPSize), "-sc_threshold", "0", "-flags", "+cgop",
            "-bf", strconv.Itoa(profile.BFrames), "-c:a", "copy", "-movflags")
        if profile.ContainerLayout == contract.ContainerLayoutFragmented {
            args = append(args, "+frag_keyframe+empty_moov+default_base_moof")
        } else {
            args = append(args, "+faststart")
        }
        args = append(args, output)
        return args, nil
    }
    
    func seconds(microseconds int64) string {
        return strconv.FormatFloat(float64(microseconds)/1_000_000, 'f', 6, 64)
    }

    package executors
    
    import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "time"
    
        "velox-shared/contract"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/executor"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/publisher"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/runtimeassets"
        "velox-worker-agent/pkg/storage"
        "velox-worker-agent/pkg/video/ffmpegrunner"
    )
    
    const (
        VideoAssembleSliceID      = "video.assemble.slice.v1"
        VideoAssembleSliceVersion = 1
    )
    
    // videoAssembleSliceExecutor renders source windows on the selected worker.
    // It downloads/certifies full provider sources via the common asset resolver,
    // then makes one FFmpeg pass directly from those sources to the final mux.
    // No Producer-side fragments or worker-side intermediate video files exist.
    type videoAssembleSliceExecutor struct {
        runner     ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner
        prober     sliceMediaProber
        outputRoot string
    }
    
    type sliceMediaProber interface {
        ProbeMediaDetails(context.Context, string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error)
    }
    
    type ffprobeSliceMediaProber struct{}
    
    func (ffprobeSliceMediaProber) ProbeMediaDetails(ctx context.Context, path string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error) {
        return publisher.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, path)
    }
    
    func NewVideoAssembleSlice(outputRoot string, runner ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner) executor.Executor {
        if strings.TrimSpace(outputRoot) == "" {
            outputRoot = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "velox", "video-assemble-slice")
        }
        if runner == nil {
            runner = ffmpegrunner.NewProcessRunner()
        }
        return &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: ffprobeSliceMediaProber{}, outputRoot: outputRoot}
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Descriptor() executor.Descriptor {
        return executor.Descriptor{
            ID: VideoAssembleSliceID, Version: VideoAssembleSliceVersion,
            InputTypes: []string{"render.compiled.v2.drive"}, OutputTypes: []string{"video/mp4"},
            ResourceClass: executor.ResourceCPU, Deterministic: true, Cacheable: true,
            TemporalMode: executor.TemporalGlobal,
        }
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Validate(spec executor.TaskSpec) error {
        if spec.ExecutorID != VideoAssembleSliceID {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: executor_id must be %q", VideoAssembleSliceID)
        }
        if e == nil || e.runner == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFmpeg runner is not configured")
        }
        if e.prober == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFprobe media validation is not configured")
        }
        plan, err := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: invalid CompiledRenderPlanV2: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: canonical output profile required: %w", err)
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        hasDrive := false
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
            driveSource := asset.Kind == "video" && isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs)
            hasDrive = hasDrive || driveSource
        }
        if !hasDrive {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: plan must contain at least one Drive video source")
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: exactly one non-empty video track is required")
        }
        var nextFrame int64
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset, ok := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || (asset.Kind != "video" && asset.Kind != "prepared_video_fragment") {
                return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q must reference a video asset", segment.SegmentID)
            }
            if segment.TimelineStartFrame != nextFrame {
                return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q leaves a timeline gap or overlap at frame %d", segment.SegmentID, nextFrame)
            }
            nextFrame += segment.FrameCount
        }
        framesNum := int64(plan.DurationUS) * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        framesDen := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        wantFrames := (framesNum + framesDen - 1) / framesDen
        if nextFrame != wantFrames {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: timeline has %d frames, plan duration requires %d", nextFrame, wantFrames)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Execute(ctx context.Context, execCtx executor.ExecutionContext, spec executor.TaskSpec) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
        started := time.Now().UTC()
        fail := func(code string, err error) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
            return executor.ExecutionResult{Status: "failed", ErrorCode: code, ErrorDetail: err.Error(), StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC()}, nil
        }
        if err := e.Validate(spec); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        plan, _ := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        bindings, ok := runtimeassets.FromContext(ctx)
        if !ok {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_MISSING", errors.New("verified runtime asset bindings are required"))
        }
        profile, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        if err := e.verifyDriveSources(ctx, plan, bindings, spec.Payload["runtime_assets"]); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SOURCE_VALIDATION_FAILED", err)
        }
        jobID, err := safeOutputJobID(spec.JobID)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("INVALID_JOB_ID", err)
        }
        outputPath := filepath.Join(e.outputRoot, jobID+".mp4")
        if resolver := storageResolverFromExecutionContext(execCtx); resolver != nil {
            if placement, placeErr := resolver.Place(storage.ArtifactStaging, jobID+".mp4", estimateOutputBytesFromDuration(plan.DurationUS)); placeErr == nil {
                outputPath = placement.Path
            }
        }
        if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(outputPath), 0o750); err != nil {
            return fail("OUTPUT_DIRECTORY", err)
        }
        args, err := sliceRenderArgs(plan, bindings, outputPath, profile, spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", err)
        }
        metrics, renderErr := e.runner.Run(ctx, ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRequest{Operation: ffmpegrunner.OperationEncode, Args: args})
        if renderErr != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_RENDER_FAILED", renderErr)
        }
        if err := e.verifyFinalMedia(ctx, outputPath, plan); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        artifact, err := artifactFromFile("video/mp4", outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("FINAL_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        raw := rawMetricsFromFFmpegResult(metrics)
        raw.OutputBytes = artifact.SizeBytes
        raw.OutputFileSize = artifact.SizeBytes
        raw.OutputSha256 = artifact.Hash
        raw.EncodePasses = 1
        raw.ConcatMode = "reencode"
        raw.FinalConcatStreamCopy = false
        raw.MediaDurationSeconds = float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        raw.WallClockSeconds = float64(metrics.ProcessWallMS) / 1000
        return executor.ExecutionResult{
            Status: "succeeded", Outputs: []executor.ArtifactRef{artifact}, RawMetrics: raw,
            StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
        }, nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyDriveSources(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings, runtimeAssets interface{}) error {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(runtimeAssets)
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if asset.Kind != "video" || !isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs) {
                continue
            }
            if _, done := seen[asset.AssetID]; done {
                continue
            }
            seen[asset.AssetID] = struct{}{}
            binding := bindings[asset.AssetID]
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("probe Drive source %q: %w", asset.AssetID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.DurationSec <= 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q has no valid video stream/duration", asset.AssetID)
            }
            actualUS := int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000)
            // For a source sliced by the Worker, AssetRefV2.DurationUS can be the
            // requested materialized window, not the full provider file duration.
            // The plan's source window is checked against the probed media below.
            for _, requested := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
                if requested.AssetID != asset.AssetID {
                    continue
                }
                windowEnd := requested.SourceInUS + requested.SourceDurationUS
                frameUS := int64(1_000_000 * plan.Output.FPSDen / plan.Output.FPSNum)
                if windowEnd > actualUS+frameUS {
                    return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q window ends at %d us beyond probed duration %d us", asset.AssetID, windowEnd, actualUS)
                }
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func sliceRenderArgs(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings, output string, profile contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1, runtimeAssets interface{}) ([]string, error) {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(runtimeAssets)
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        inputs := make([]string, 0, len(plan.Assets))
        inputIndex := make(map[string]int, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            if _, exists := inputIndex[segment.AssetID]; exists {
                continue
            }
            binding, ok := bindings[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" || binding.Size <= 0 || strings.TrimSpace(binding.SHA256) == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q is not downloaded and integrity-verified", segment.AssetID)
            }
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if asset.SHA256 != "" && binding.SHA256 != asset.SHA256 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q SHA-256 does not match the plan", segment.AssetID)
            }
            if asset.SizeBytes > 0 && binding.Size != asset.SizeBytes {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q size does not match the plan", segment.AssetID)
            }
            info, err := os.Stat(binding.Path)
            if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != binding.Size {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q local file identity is invalid", segment.AssetID)
            }
            inputIndex[segment.AssetID] = len(inputs)
            inputs = append(inputs, binding.Path)
        }
        audio, ok := bindings[plan.FinalAudio.AssetID]
        if !ok || !audio.Verified || audio.Size <= 0 || audio.SHA256 == "" {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio is not downloaded and integrity-verified")
        }
        if audio.SHA256 != plan.FinalAudio.SHA256 || audio.Size != plan.FinalAudio.SizeBytes {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio integrity binding does not match the plan")
        }
        if info, err := os.Stat(audio.Path); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != audio.Size {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio local file identity is invalid")
        }
        audioIndex := len(inputs)
        inputs = append(inputs, audio.Path)
        fps := strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.FPSNum) + "/" + strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.FPSDen)
        filters := make([]string, 0, len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments)+1)
        labels := make([]string, 0, len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments))
        for i, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            windowEnd := segment.SourceInUS + segment.SourceDurationUS
            if segment.SourceInUS < 0 || segment.SourceDurationUS <= 0 || (!isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs) && windowEnd > asset.DurationUS) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("segment %q source window exceeds declared duration", segment.SegmentID)
            }
            label := fmt.Sprintf("v%d", i)
            filters = append(filters, fmt.Sprintf("[%d:v:0]trim=start=%s:duration=%s,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps=%s,scale=%d:%d:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=%d:%d:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,setsar=1,format=%s,trim=end_frame=%d,setpts=N/(%s*TB)[%s]",
                inputIndex[segment.AssetID], seconds(segment.SourceInUS), seconds(segment.SourceDurationUS), fps,
                plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height, profile.PixelFormat, segment.FrameCount, fps, label))
            labels = append(labels, "["+label+"]")
        }
        filters = append(filters, strings.Join(labels, "")+fmt.Sprintf("concat=n=%d:v=1:a=0[vout]", len(labels)))
        // A Drive render can reference hundreds of separate source files. FFmpeg's
        // automatic decoder/filter thread counts multiply across those inputs and
        // can exhaust the worker container's PID limit before rendering starts.
        // Bound decoder, filter-graph, and encoder concurrency for predictable use.
        args := []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-filter_complex_threads", "1", "-y"}
        for _, input := range inputs {
            args = append(args, "-threads", "1", "-i", input)
        }
        args = append(args, "-filter_complex", strings.Join(filters, ";"), "-map", "[vout]", "-map", fmt.Sprintf("%d:a:0", audioIndex),
            "-t", seconds(plan.DurationUS), "-c:v", "libx264", "-threads:v", "2", "-preset", "veryfast", "-profile:v", profile.CodecProfile,
            "-level:v", profile.CodecLevel, "-pix_fmt", profile.PixelFormat, "-r", fps, "-g", strconv.Itoa(profile.GOPSize),
            "-keyint_min", strconv.Itoa(profile.GOPSize), "-sc_threshold", "0", "-flags", "+cgop",
            "-bf", strconv.Itoa(profile.BFrames), "-c:a", "copy", "-movflags")
        if profile.ContainerLayout == contract.ContainerLayoutFragmented {
            args = append(args, "+frag_keyframe+empty_moov+default_base_moof")
        } else {
            args = append(args, "+faststart")
        }
        args = append(args, output)
        return args, nil
    }
    
    func seconds(microseconds int64) string {
        return strconv.FormatFloat(float64(microseconds)/1_000_000, 'f', 6, 64)
    }

    }
    
    // VideoTrackV2 groups ordered video segments belonging to one output track.
    // Segment order is semantic and therefore remains exactly as supplied by the
    // producer; only the set-like assets list is reordered during canonicalizing.
    type VideoTrackV2 struct {
        TrackID  string           `json:"track_id"`
        Segments []VideoSegmentV2 `json:"segments"`
    }
    
    // VideoSegmentV2 places a source window on the CFR output timeline. Output
    // placement uses frames; source trimming remains in microseconds so source
    // media does not need to be assumed CFR.
    type VideoSegmentV2 struct {
        SegmentID string `json:"segment_id"`
    
        AssetID string `json:"asset_id"`
        SHA256  string `json:"sha256"`
    
        TimelineStartFrame int64 `json:"timeline_start_frame"`
        FrameCount         int64 `json:"frame_count"`
    
        SourceInUS       int64 `json:"source_in_us"`
        SourceDurationUS int64 `json:"source_duration_us"`
    }
    
    // AssetRefV2 is a typed, path-free reference to one plan asset. Ordinary and
    // prepared assets carry verified content identity. Drive stock sources may
    // instead carry source_kind/drive_file_id and duration metadata; the worker
    // downloads and certifies those bytes before rendering.
    type AssetRefV2 struct {
        AssetID  string `json:"asset_id"`
        AssetKey string `json:"asset_key,omitempty"`
        // SourceKind and DriveFileID identify provider-backed stock inputs. These
        // references are resolved and verified by the worker at execution time;
        // unlike prepared fragments, they need not be downloaded by the Producer.
        SourceKind  string `json:"source_kind,omitempty"`
        DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id,omitempty"`
    
        SHA256    string `json:"sha256"`
        SizeBytes int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
    
        Kind string `json:"kind"`
        MIME string `json:"mime,omitempty"`

    // Config describes the backing directories for each class. All paths are
    // resolved from the worker configuration (see the composition root in
    // internal/worker); this struct is the storage layer's own contract.
    type Config struct {
        // CacheDir is the CACHE_PERSISTENT backing (NVMe). Required.
        CacheDir string
        // TempDir is the ATTEMPT_TEMP NVMe backing. Required.
        TempDir string
        // TmpfsDir is the ATTEMPT_TEMP tmpfs backing (e.g. /dev/shm/velox-worker).
        // Empty disables tmpfs entirely — all scratch lands on TempDir.
        TmpfsDir string
        // ArtifactDir is the ARTIFACT_FINAL backing (NVMe). Required.
        ArtifactDir string
        // TmpfsThresholdBytes is the size gate for tmpfs placement: only files
        // with sizeBytes in [0, threshold) are eligible. Files at/above the
        // threshold (or with unknown size) always go to TempDir. Must be > 0
        // when TmpfsDir is set.
        TmpfsThresholdBytes int64
        // ArtifactStaging configures volatile tmpfs staging for
        // ARTIFACT_STAGING placements. Zero value (Enabled=false) routes every
        // staging placement to the durable ArtifactDir.
        ArtifactStaging ArtifactStagingConfig
        // StagingMetrics is the optional observability sink for ARTIFACT_STAGING
        // decisions (fallback reason + live reserved-bytes gauge). Nil disables
        // collection. The concrete Prometheus implementation is wired at the
        // worker composition root.
        StagingMetrics StagingMetrics
    }

        }

    package executors
    
    import (
        "context"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "strings"
        "testing"
    
        "velox-shared/contract"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/publisher"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/runtimeassets"
        "velox-worker-agent/pkg/video/ffmpegrunner"
    )
    
    type sliceFFmpegRunner struct{ args []string }
    
    func (r *sliceFFmpegRunner) Run(_ context.Context, req ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRequest) (ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult, error) {
        r.args = append([]string(nil), req.Args...)
        if err := os.WriteFile(req.Args[len(req.Args)-1], []byte("remote-render"), 0o640); err != nil {
            return ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult{}, err
        }
        return ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult{ProcessWallMS: 12}, nil
    }
    
    type sliceMediaProbeStub struct{}
    
    func (sliceMediaProbeStub) ProbeMediaDetails(_ context.Context, path string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error) {
        if strings.HasSuffix(path, "stock.mp4") {
            return publisher.MediaProbe{HasVideo: true, DurationSec: 20}, nil
        }
        return publisher.MediaProbe{HasVideo: true, HasAudio: true, VideoCodec: "h264", AudioCodec: "aac", DurationSec: 1, Width: 1920, Height: 1080}, nil
    }
    
    func driveSlicePlan() *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2 {
        const timelineHash = "cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"
        return &contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2{
            PlanVersion: 2, TimelineRevision: 7, TimelineSHA256: timelineHash, DurationUS: 1_000_000,
            Output: contract.OutputContractV2{
                Container: "mp4", VideoCodec: "h264", Width: 1920, Height: 1080,
                FPSNum: 24, FPSDen: 1, PixelFormat: "yuv420p", ProfileID: contract.CanonicalVideoProfileIDV1,
                CodecProfile: "high", CodecLevel: "4.0", GOPSize: 48, BFrames: 0,

            },

    func TestVideoAssembleSlice_RendersDriveSourceWindowsWithoutIntermediateFragments(t *testing.T) {
        plan := driveSlicePlan()
        canonical, err := plan.CanonicalJSON()
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        videoPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "stock.mp4")
        audioPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "audio.m4a")
        if err := os.WriteFile(videoPath, []byte("stock"), 0o640); err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        if err := os.WriteFile(audioPath, []byte("audio"), 0o640); err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        runner := &sliceFFmpegRunner{}
        exec := &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: sliceMediaProbeStub{}, outputRoot: t.TempDir()}
        spec := executorTaskSpec(VideoAssembleSliceID, "job-drive-slice", canonical, plan)
        result, err := exec.Execute(runtimeassets.WithBindings(context.Background(), runtimeassets.Bindings{
            "drive:stock-01": {AssetID: "drive:stock-01", Path: videoPath, SHA256: strings.Repeat("b", 64), Size: 5, Verified: true},
            "audio":          {AssetID: "audio", Path: audioPath, SHA256: copyOnlySHA([]byte("audio")), Size: 5, Verified: true},
        }), nil, spec)
        if err != nil || result.Status != "succeeded" {
            t.Fatalf("slice execution result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
        }
        if len(result.Outputs) != 1 || result.RawMetrics == nil || result.RawMetrics.ConcatMode != "reencode" {
            t.Fatalf("slice result did not report remote final render: %+v", result)
        }
        joined := strings.Join(runner.args, " ")
        for _, want := range []string{"trim=start=14.000000:duration=1.000000", "concat=n=1:v=1:a=0", "libx264", "-c:a copy"} {
            if !strings.Contains(joined, want) {
                t.Errorf("FFmpeg args missing %q: %s", want, joined)
            }
        }
    }

## Activity

    $ sed -n '90,115p' docs/operations/fleetctl.md && rg -n "VELOX_MASTER_URL" scripts/fleetctl | head -10
    The canonical chain is:
    
    ```text
    fleetctl/API → Master → FleetController → UpdateExecutor →
    WorkerNodeRegistry → SSH → velox-worker-activate-image
    ```
    
    The worker must already be `DRAINING` with `active_jobs=0`. The command
    refuses to run otherwise.
    
    ```bash
    scripts/fleetctl update worker-id \
      ghcr.io/marcuss-ops/velox-worker@sha256:<64-hex-digest> \
      "canary release"
    ```
    
    Manual rollback uses the previously recorded pinned image reference:
    
    ```bash
    scripts/fleetctl rollback worker-id \
      ghcr.io/marcuss-ops/velox-worker@sha256:<previous-64-hex-digest> \
      "rollback after smoke failure"
    ```
    
    No `FLEET_INVENTORY`, `FLEET_ROLLOUT_PLAYBOOK`, `FLEET_ROLLOUT_BUNDLE_HASH` or
    `ansible-*` binaries are used: the release-evidence checks live server-side in
    8:MASTER_URL="${VELOX_MASTER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}"
    21:  VELOX_MASTER_URL   Master base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000)
    61:export VELOX_MASTER_URL="$MASTER_URL"
    ✓ • 0ms

## Activity

    $ /tmp/fleetctl-drive-slice --help 2>&1 | head -80; /tmp/fleetctl-drive-slice worker --help 2>&1 | head -60
    fleetctl — Velox fleet-operator unified CLI (Step 15/15).
    
    Usage:
      fleetctl -h
      fleetctl [--master=URL] [--token-file=PATH] <sub-command> [args]
    
    Sub-commands:
      status                  list all workers + WorkerCard snapshot
      inspect <worker_id> [--json]  IMAGE + LAST UPDATE OPERATION sections (--json = raw card)
      drain    <worker_id>    DRAINING transition (waits for active_jobs=0)
      update   <worker_id> [--digest sha256:...]   image update cascade
      smoke    <worker_id>    on-demand Level-D smoke (await terminal state)
      resume   <worker_id>    RESUME (RESUMED after drain/quarantine)
      rollback <worker_id>    rollback to previous_digest (Step 9/15 cascade)
      operations [worker_id] [status] list operation audit rows
      wait-ready <worker_id>  wait for canonical worker readiness
      rollout [--digest IMAGE] [--workers all|id1,id2] [--reason R] [--wait-ready]
                              serial image rollout across selected workers
      ssh-check               per-worker SSH connectivity (ssh/hostkey/sudo -n)
      job cancel <job_id> [--reason R]  cancel a direct job through the canonical lifecycle
      job inspect <job_id> [--waterfall]  complete job diagnostics; --waterfall renders only
                              the attempt waterfall block (buckets/coverage/missing)
      job metrics <job_id>    execution and cache metrics for one job
      job watch <job_id>      follow the persisted job event timeline
      quarantine <worker_id>  exclude worker from placement
      restart <worker_id>     schedule worker restart
      benchmark <worker_id> [--fixture ID] [--concurrency N] [--runs N]
                              run concurrent benchmark to determine sweet spot
      benchmark-collect <worker_id> [--fixture ID] [--concurrency N] [--runs N]
                              run benchmark, validate scorecard, persist results, show tuning
      worker-capacity <worker_id> [--json]
                              canonical capacity report from Master SQL (no Prometheus)
      worker-config set <worker_id> [--audio-mix-strategy legacy|optimized|auto] [--audio-mix-profile 0|1]
                                    [--asset-download-concurrency 1..128] [--prefetch-max-concurrent 1..127]
                                    [--cache-idle-ttl-seconds 60..604800]
                                    [--fmp4-stream-profile 0|1]
                              atomically update allowlisted worker config and wait-ready;
                              --fmp4-stream-profile is the fMP4 admission-gate rollout knob
      doctor --production     fleet/readiness/digest production checks
    
    Auth (in precedence order):
      1. --token-file=PATH    chmod-600 file holding the bare token
      2. $VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN   env var
      3. /opt/velox/secrets/admin-token    canonical Master path
    
    See deploy/fleetctl/README.md for per-sub-command examples

## Assistant

Ho trovato l’errore preciso: la verifica finale rileva un video più corto di 4,989 secondi rispetto al piano. Il taglio avviene ai confini dei blocchi perché ogni FFmpeg usa `-t`, che può troncare gli ultimi frame. Correggo imponendo il numero esatto di frame per blocco e rilancio la verifica.

    import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "os/exec"
        "strconv"
        "strings"

    // manifest_ffprobe.go owns the best-effort ffprobe enrichment of
    // OutputManifest (ProbeMediaDetails + parseFfprobeJSON) and the legacy
    // pure parsing helpers retained for compatibility. The manifest computation
    // itself lives in manifest.go.
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // ffprobe enrichment (best-effort).
    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    // MediaProbe is the final-artifact media metadata used by the publisher.
    // Unlike the old video-only probe, it inspects every stream so the report can
    // prove that the delivered artifact really contains audio as well as video.
    type MediaProbe struct {
        VideoCodec        string
        VideoCodecTag     string
        VideoProfile      string
        VideoLevel        int
        VideoPixelFormat  string
        VideoFPSNum       int
        VideoFPSDen       int
        VideoTimeBaseNum  int
        VideoTimeBaseDen  int
        AudioCodec        string
        DurationSec       float64
        Width             int
        Height            int
        HasVideo          bool
        HasAudio          bool
        VideoTrackCount   int
        AudioTrackCount   int
        AudioSampleRateHz int
        AudioChannels     int
    }
    
    type ffprobeDocument struct {
        Streams []ffprobeStream `json:"streams"`
        Format  ffprobeFormat   `json:"format"`
    }
    
    type ffprobeStream struct {
        CodecType   string `json:"codec_type"`
        CodecName   string `json:"codec_name"`
        CodecTag    string `json:"codec_tag_string"`
        Profile     string `json:"profile"`
        Level       int    `json:"level"`
        Width       int    `json:"width"`
        Height      int    `json:"height"`
        PixelFormat string `json:"pix_fmt"`
        FrameRate   string `json:"r_frame_rate"`
        TimeBase    string `json:"time_base"`
        Duration    string `json:"duration"`
        SampleRate  string `json:"sample_rate"`
        Channels    int    `json:"channels"`
    }
    
    type ffprobeFormat struct {
        Duration string `json:"duration"`
    }
    
    // ProbeMediaDetails calls ffprobe if it is on PATH and parses every stream.
    // Returns an error when ffprobe is missing, non-zero-exits, or emits invalid
    // JSON. Callers decide whether missing media streams are a quality failure.
    func ProbeMediaDetails(ctx context.Context, path string) (MediaProbe, error) {
        if _, lookErr := exec.LookPath("ffprobe"); lookErr != nil {
            return MediaProbe{}, fmt.Errorf("ffprobe missing on PATH")
        }
    
        args := []string{
            "-v", "error",
            "-print_format", "json",
            "-show_format",
            "-show_streams",
            path,
        }
        cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ffprobe", args...)
        out, runErr := cmd.Output()
        if runErr != nil {
            return MediaProbe{}, fmt.Errorf("ffprobe exec: %w", runErr)
        }
        probe, err := parseFfprobeDetails(out)
        if err != nil {
            return MediaProbe{}, err
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo && !probe.HasAudio {
            return MediaProbe{}, fmt.Errorf("ffprobe returned no media streams")
        }
        return probe, nil
    }
    
    // ProbeMedia keeps the original API for callers that only need video fields.
    func ProbeMedia(ctx context.Context, path string) (codec string, durationSec float64, width, height int, err error) {
        probe, err := ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, path)
        if err != nil {
            return "", 0, 0, 0, err
        }
        return probe.VideoCodec, probe.DurationSec, probe.Width, probe.Height, nil
    }
    
    func parseFfprobeDetails(b []byte) (MediaProbe, error) {
        var doc ffprobeDocument
        if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &doc); err != nil {
            return MediaProbe{}, fmt.Errorf("ffprobe JSON parse: %w", err)
        }
        probe := MediaProbe{}
        for _, stream := range doc.Streams {
            switch stream.CodecType {
            case "video":
                probe.HasVideo = true
                probe.VideoTrackCount++
                if probe.VideoCodec == "" {
                    probe.VideoCodec = stream.CodecName
                    probe.VideoCodecTag = stream.CodecTag
                    probe.VideoProfile = stream.Profile
                    probe.VideoLevel = stream.Level
                    probe.VideoLevel = stream.Level
                    probe.Width = stream.Width
                    probe.Height = stream.Height
                    probe.VideoPixelFormat = stream.PixelFormat
                    probe.VideoFPSNum, probe.VideoFPSDen = parseRatio(stream.FrameRate)
                    probe.VideoTimeBaseNum, probe.VideoTimeBaseDen = parseRatio(stream.TimeBase)
                }
            case "audio":
                probe.HasAudio = true
                probe.AudioTrackCount++
                if probe.AudioCodec == "" {
                    probe.AudioCodec = stream.CodecName
                    probe.AudioSampleRateHz, _ = strconv.Atoi(stream.SampleRate)
                    probe.AudioChannels = stream.Channels
                }
            }
            if probe.DurationSec == 0 && stream.Duration != "" {
                probe.DurationSec, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(stream.Duration, 64)
            }
        }
        if probe.DurationSec == 0 && doc.Format.Duration != "" {
            probe.DurationSec, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(doc.Format.Duration, 64)
        }
        return probe, nil
    }
    
    func parseRatio(raw string) (int, int) {
        parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(raw), "/")
        if len(parts) != 2 {
            return 0, 0
        }
        numerator, errNum := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
        denominator, errDen := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
        if errNum != nil || errDen != nil || numerator <= 0 || denominator <= 0 {
            return 0, 0
        }
        return numerator, denominator
    }

          - name: Verify checkout is the event commit
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              CHECKOUT_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
              if [ "$CHECKOUT_SHA" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
                echo "::error::checkout commit ($CHECKOUT_SHA) does not match event commit ($GITHUB_SHA). Refusing to certify an ambiguous source tree." >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "Release source commit: $GITHUB_SHA"
    
          - name: Read VERSION.txt (canonical source)
            id: read-version
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              VERSION="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION.txt)"
              if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
                echo "::error::VERSION.txt is empty — refusing to publish." >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "Resolved version from VERSION.txt: ${VERSION}"
    
          - name: Resolve effective version + determine push
            id: version
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "push" ] && [ "${{ github.ref_type }}" = "tag" ]; then
                TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#worker-v}"
              elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "push" ]; then
                TAG="${{ steps.read-version.outputs.version }}"
                TAG="${TAG#v}"
              elif [ -n "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
                INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
                TAG="${INPUT#v}"
              else
                TAG="${{ steps.read-version.outputs.version }}"
              fi

    $ sed -n '1,240p' scripts/ci/check-mixed-render-gate.sh
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    # check-mixed-render-gate.sh — native mixed packet-copy golden gate.
    #
    # This gate runs before the worker image is built. The C++ golden test asserts
    # that a successful mixed render is packet-only (zero frames/encodes), rejects
    # incompatible sources deterministically, and never reaches the legacy video
    # renderer. The published-image canary repeats the same contract against the
    # immutable runtime image.
    
    set -euo pipefail
    
    SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    readonly SCRIPT_DIR
    REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.." && pwd)"
    readonly REPO_ROOT
    readonly ENGINE_SOURCE="${REPO_ROOT}/RemoteCodex/native/video-engine-cpp"
    readonly BUILD_DIR="${VIDEO_MIXED_BUILD_DIR:-/tmp/velox-mixed-render-build}"
    
    for command_name in cmake ffmpeg ffprobe; do
      command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
        echo "[mixed-render-gate][ERROR] missing dependency: ${command_name}" >&2
        exit 3
      }
    done
    
    echo "[mixed-render-gate] configuring native engine"
    cmake -S "${ENGINE_SOURCE}" -B "${BUILD_DIR}" \
      -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -DVELOX_ENABLE_LIBAV=ON
    
    echo "[mixed-render-gate] building mixed golden test"
    cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}" --target velox_render_mixed_tests --parallel
    
    echo "[mixed-render-gate] running mixed packet-copy contract"
    "${BUILD_DIR}/velox_render_mixed_tests"
    
    echo "[mixed-render-gate][PASS] mixed_packet capability contract holds"

    package executors
    
    import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "time"
    
        "velox-shared/contract"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/executor"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/publisher"
        "velox-worker-agent/internal/runtimeassets"
        "velox-worker-agent/pkg/storage"
        "velox-worker-agent/pkg/video/ffmpegrunner"
    )
    
    const (
        VideoAssembleSliceID      = "video.assemble.slice.v1"
        VideoAssembleSliceVersion = 1
        maxSliceBatchSources      = 8
    )
    
    // videoAssembleSliceExecutor renders source windows on the selected worker.
    // It downloads/certifies full provider sources via the common asset resolver,
    // then makes one FFmpeg pass directly from those sources to the final mux.
    // No Producer-side fragments or worker-side intermediate video files exist.
    type videoAssembleSliceExecutor struct {
        runner     ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner
        prober     sliceMediaProber
        outputRoot string
    }
    
    type sliceMediaProber interface {
        ProbeMediaDetails(context.Context, string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error)
    }
    
    type ffprobeSliceMediaProber struct{}
    
    func (ffprobeSliceMediaProber) ProbeMediaDetails(ctx context.Context, path string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error) {
        return publisher.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, path)
    }
    
    func NewVideoAssembleSlice(outputRoot string, runner ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner) executor.Executor {
        if strings.TrimSpace(outputRoot) == "" {
            outputRoot = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "velox", "video-assemble-slice")
        }
        if runner == nil {
            runner = ffmpegrunner.NewProcessRunner()
        }
        return &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: ffprobeSliceMediaProber{}, outputRoot: outputRoot}
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Descriptor() executor.Descriptor {
        return executor.Descriptor{
            ID: VideoAssembleSliceID, Version: VideoAssembleSliceVersion,
            InputTypes: []string{"render.compiled.v2.drive"}, OutputTypes: []string{"video/mp4"},
            ResourceClass: executor.ResourceCPU, Deterministic: true, Cacheable: true,
            TemporalMode: executor.TemporalGlobal,
        }
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Validate(spec executor.TaskSpec) error {
        if spec.ExecutorID != VideoAssembleSliceID {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: executor_id must be %q", VideoAssembleSliceID)
        }
        if e == nil || e.runner == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFmpeg runner is not configured")
        }
        if e.prober == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFprobe media validation is not configured")
        }
        plan, err := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: invalid CompiledRenderPlanV2: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: canonical output profile required: %w", err)
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        hasDrive := false
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
            driveSource := asset.Kind == "video" && isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs)
            hasDrive = hasDrive || driveSource
        }
        if !hasDrive {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: plan must contain at least one Drive video source")
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: exactly one non-empty video track is required")

    type AssetRefV2 struct {
        AssetID  string `json:"asset_id"`
        AssetKey string `json:"asset_key,omitempty"`
        // SourceKind and DriveFileID identify provider-backed stock inputs. These
        // references are resolved and verified by the worker at execution time;
        // unlike prepared fragments, they need not be downloaded by the Producer.
        SourceKind  string `json:"source_kind,omitempty"`
        DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id,omitempty"`
    
        SHA256    string `json:"sha256"`
        SizeBytes int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
    
        Kind string `json:"kind"`
        MIME string `json:"mime,omitempty"`
    
        DurationUS int64 `json:"duration_us,omitempty"`
        Width      int   `json:"width,omitempty"`
        Height     int   `json:"height,omitempty"`
    
        // Prepared-fragment admission metadata. Optional for ordinary V2 assets;
        // video.assemble.copy.v1 requires it for every externally prepared video.
        ProfileID          string `json:"profile_id,omitempty"`
        FrameCount         int64  `json:"frame_count,omitempty"`
        TimelineRevision   int64  `json:"timeline_revision,omitempty"`
        TimelineSHA256     string `json:"timeline_sha256,omitempty"`
        TimelineStartFrame int64  `json:"timeline_start_frame,omitempty"`
        FirstFrameKeyframe bool   `json:"first_frame_keyframe,omitempty"`
        ClosedGOP          bool   `json:"closed_gop,omitempty"`
    }
    
    // CanonicalJSON returns the deterministic V2 document used for persistence
    // and hashing. Asset references are sorted by AssetID because their order is
    // set-like; track and segment order is preserved because it is semantic.
    // Nil slices are normalized to empty arrays so equivalent empty collections
    // never alternate between JSON null and [].
    func (p *CompiledRenderPlanV2) CanonicalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
        if p == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: nil plan")
        }
    
        canonical := *p
        canonical.VideoTracks = cloneVideoTracks(p.VideoTracks)
        canonical.Assets = append([]AssetRefV2(nil), p.Assets...)

    // MediaProbe is the final-artifact media metadata used by the publisher.

    type MediaProbe struct {
        VideoCodec        string
        VideoCodecTag     string
        VideoProfile      string
        VideoLevel        int
        VideoPixelFormat  string
        VideoFPSNum       int
        VideoFPSDen       int

        AudioSampleRateHz int
        AudioChannels     int
    }

    }
    
    type ffprobeStream struct {
        CodecType   string `json:"codec_type"`

        FrameRate   string `json:"r_frame_rate"`

    // ProbeMediaDetails calls ffprobe if it is on PATH and parses every stream.

    func ProbeMediaDetails(ctx context.Context, path string) (MediaProbe, error) {
        if _, lookErr := exec.LookPath("ffprobe"); lookErr != nil {
            return MediaProbe{}, fmt.Errorf("ffprobe missing on PATH")
        }
    
        args := []string{
            "-v", "error",

            path,
        }

    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyDriveSources(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings, runtimeAssets interface{}) error {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(runtimeAssets)
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if asset.Kind != "video" || !isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs) {
                continue
            }
            }
            if _, done := seen[asset.AssetID]; done {
                continue
            }
            seen[asset.AssetID] = struct{}{}
            binding := bindings[asset.AssetID]
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("probe Drive source %q: %w", asset.AssetID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.DurationSec <= 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q has no valid video stream/duration", asset.AssetID)
            }
            actualUS := int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000)
            // For a source sliced by the Worker, AssetRefV2.DurationUS can be the
            // requested materialized window, not the full provider file duration.
            // The plan's source window is checked against the probed media below.
            for _, requested := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
                if requested.AssetID != asset.AssetID {
                    continue
                }
                windowEnd := requested.SourceInUS + requested.SourceDurationUS
                frameUS := int64(1_000_000 * plan.Output.FPSDen / plan.Output.FPSNum)
                if windowEnd > actualUS+frameUS {
                    return fmt.Errorf("Drive source %q window ends at %d us beyond probed duration %d us", asset.AssetID, windowEnd, actualUS)
                }
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func groupSliceSegments(segments []contract.VideoSegmentV2, maxSources int) [][]contract.VideoSegmentV2 {
        if maxSources < 1 {
            maxSources = 1
        }
        var batches [][]contract.VideoSegmentV2
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        for _, segment := range segments {
            if len(batches) == 0 {
                batches = append(batches, nil)
            }
            if _, ok := seen[segment.AssetID]; !ok && len(seen) >= maxSources {
                batches = append(batches, nil)
                seen = make(map[string]struct{})
            }
            batches[len(batches)-1] = append(batches[len(batches)-1], segment)
            seen[segment.AssetID] = struct{}{}
        }
        return batches
    }
    
    func writeFFConcatList(path string, files []string) error {
        var b strings.Builder
        b.WriteString("ffconcat version 1.0\n")
        for _, file := range files {
            abs, err := filepath.Abs(file)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }
            // The concat demuxer uses shell-like single-quoted paths; embedded
            // quotes are represented by closing, escaping, and reopening quotes.
            quoted := strings.ReplaceAll(abs, "'", "'\\''")
            fmt.Fprintf(&b, "file '%s'\n", quoted)
        }
        return os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o600)
    }
    
    func sliceConcatMuxArgs(listPath, audioPath, output string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) ([]string, error) {
        if strings.TrimSpace(audioPath) == "" {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio path is empty")
        }
        return []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
            "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listPath,
            "-threads", "1", "-i", audioPath,
            "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0", "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "copy",
            "-t", seconds(plan.DurationUS), "-movflags", "+faststart", output}, nil
    }
    
    func sliceVideoRenderArgs(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings, output string, profile contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1, runtimeAssets interface{}, segments []contract.VideoSegmentV2) ([]string, error) {
        if len(segments) == 0 {
            return nil, errors.New("video batch has no segments")
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(runtimeAssets)
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        inputs := make([]string, 0, maxSliceBatchSources)
        inputIndex := make(map[string]int, maxSliceBatchSources)
        for _, segment := range segments {
            if _, exists := inputIndex[segment.AssetID]; exists {
                continue
            }
            binding, ok := bindings[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" || binding.Size <= 0 || strings.TrimSpace(binding.SHA256) == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q is not downloaded and integrity-verified", segment.AssetID)
            }
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if asset.SHA256 != "" && binding.SHA256 != asset.SHA256 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q SHA-256 does not match the plan", segment.AssetID)
            }
            if asset.SizeBytes > 0 && binding.Size != asset.SizeBytes {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q size does not match the plan", segment.AssetID)
            }
            info, err := os.Stat(binding.Path)
            if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != binding.Size {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("source %q local file identity is invalid", segment.AssetID)
            }
            inputIndex[segment.AssetID] = len(inputs)
            inputs = append(inputs, binding.Path)
        }
        fps := strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.FPSNum) + "/" + strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.FPSDen)
        filters := make([]string, 0, len(segments)+1)
        labels := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
        var batchFrames int64
        for i, segment := range segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            windowEnd := segment.SourceInUS + segment.SourceDurationUS
            if segment.SourceInUS < 0 || segment.SourceDurationUS <= 0 || (!isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs) && windowEnd > asset.DurationUS) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("segment %q source window exceeds declared duration", segment.SegmentID)
            }
            label := fmt.Sprintf("v%d", i)
            filters = append(filters, fmt.Sprintf("[%d:v:0]trim=start=%s:duration=%s,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps=%s,scale=%d:%d:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=%d:%d:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,setsar=1,format=%s,tpad=stop_mode=clone:stop=%d,trim=end_frame=%d,setpts=N/(%s*TB)[%s]",
                inputIndex[segment.AssetID], seconds(segment.SourceInUS), seconds(segment.SourceDurationUS), fps,
                plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height, profile.PixelFormat, segment.FrameCount, segment.FrameCount, fps, label))
            labels = append(labels, "["+label+"]")
            batchFrames += segment.FrameCount
        }
        filters = append(filters, strings.Join(labels, "")+fmt.Sprintf("concat=n=%d:v=1:a=0[vout]", len(labels)))
        // A Drive render can reference hundreds of separate source files. FFmpeg's
        // automatic decoder/filter thread counts multiply across those inputs and
        // can exhaust the worker container's PID limit before rendering starts.
        // Bound decoder, filter-graph, and encoder concurrency for predictable use.
        args := []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-filter_complex_threads", "1", "-y"}
        for _, input := range inputs {
            args = append(args, "-threads", "1", "-i", input)
        }
        args = append(args, "-filter_complex", strings.Join(filters, ";"), "-map", "[vout]",
            "-frames:v", strconv.FormatInt(batchFrames, 10), "-c:v", "libx264", "-threads:v", "2", "-preset", "veryfast", "-profile:v", profile.CodecProfile,
            "-level:v", profile.CodecLevel, "-pix_fmt", profile.PixelFormat, "-r", fps, "-g", strconv.Itoa(profile.GOPSize),
            "-keyint_min", strconv.Itoa(profile.GOPSize), "-sc_threshold", "0", "-flags", "+cgop",
            "-bf", strconv.Itoa(profile.BFrames), "-an", "-movflags", "+faststart", output)
        return args, nil
    }
    
    func seconds(microseconds int64) string {
        return strconv.FormatFloat(float64(microseconds)/1_000_000, 'f', 6, 64)
    }
