            identity := compiledAssetIdentity(asset)
            if identity == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: asset %q has no canonical identity", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if previous, exists := seenIdentities[identity]; exists && previous != asset.AssetID {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: assets %q and %q share canonical identity %q", previous, asset.AssetID, identity)
            }
            seenIdentities[identity] = asset.AssetID
            uri := compiledAssetReference(asset)
            driveID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
            if driveID == "" {
                driveID = runtimeDriveIDs[strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)]
            }
            if driveID == "" {
                driveID = runtimeDriveIDs[strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetKey)]
            }
            if asset.SourceKind == "drive" || driveID != "" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:") {
                if driveID == "" && strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(asset.AssetID), "drive:") {
                    driveID = strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID[len("drive:"):])
                }
                if driveID == "" {
                    return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: Drive asset %q has no drive_file_id", asset.AssetID)
                }

            assetEnvelopes = append(assetEnvelopes, map[string]interface{}{

        for index, envelope := range assetEnvelopes {

                if !ok || len(items) != 1 {
                    errMu.Lock()
                    if firstErr == nil {

                    }

        }

        }

            if !ok {

            }
            path, ok := resolved["uri"].(string)

                sha = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(resolvedSHA), "sha256:")

            size := asset.SizeBytes

                SHA256:   sha,
                Size:     size,
                Verified: true,
            }
        }
        return bindings, nil

    // compiledRuntimeDriveFileIDs joins the Producer's runtime transport manifest
    // to immutable V2 plan identities. The plan SHA remains untouched; the
    // runtime manifest supplies only the Drive file locator used to fetch it.
    func compiledRuntimeDriveFileIDs(raw interface{}) map[string]string {
        encoded, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || string(encoded) == "null" {
            return nil
        }
        var assets []struct {
            AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
            AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
            DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
            URL         string `json:"url"`
            SourceURI   string `json:"source_uri"`
        }
        if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &assets); err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        byIdentity := make(map[string]string, len(assets)*2)
        for _, asset := range assets {
            fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
            if fileID == "" {
                for _, locator := range []string{asset.URL, asset.SourceURI} {
                    u, parseErr := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(locator))
                    if parseErr != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "velox-drive") {
                        continue
                    }
                    fileID = strings.TrimSpace(u.Host)
                    if fileID == "" {
                        fileID = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(u.Path), "/")
                    }
                    if fileID != "" {
                        break
                    }
                }
            }
            if fileID == "" {
                continue
            }
            for _, identity := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
                if identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity); identity != "" {
                    byIdentity[identity] = fileID
                }
            }
        }
        return byIdentity
    }

        identity := strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetKey)
        if identity == "" {
            identity = strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)
        }
        if wireID, ok := assetref.WireAssetID(identity); ok {
            return wireID
        }
        return identity
    }

            // request: fall back to the single-stream resume path, which has its

        if err := os.MkdirAll(cacheDir, 0o755); err != nil {

        // canonical CacheResolver boundary records the classified miss exactly

        // the byte pipeline.
        source, sourceErr := t.assetSource(assetID, req.SourceURI)
        if sourceErr != nil {

    func firstStringResolver(m map[string]interface{}, keys ...string) string {

    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyCopyInputs(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        probes := make(map[string]publisher.MediaProbe)
        var baseline *publisher.MediaProbe
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if _, done := seen[asset.AssetID]; done {
                continue
            }
            seen[asset.AssetID] = struct{}{}
            binding := bindings[asset.AssetID]
            if !binding.Verified || binding.SHA256 != asset.SHA256 || binding.Size != asset.SizeBytes || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q is not integrity-verified against the plan", asset.AssetID)
            }
            info, statErr := os.Stat(binding.Path)
            if statErr != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != binding.Size {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q local file identity is invalid", asset.AssetID)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("probe source %q: %w", asset.AssetID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.DurationSec <= 0 || asset.ProfileID != plan.Output.ProfileID || !asset.FirstFrameKeyframe || !asset.ClosedGOP {

            }
            if probe.VideoFrameCount <= 0 || probe.VideoFrameCount != asset.FrameCount {

            }
            wantLevel, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.ReplaceAll(plan.Output.CodecLevel, ".", ""))
            if probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || !strings.EqualFold(probe.VideoProfile, plan.Output.CodecProfile) || probe.VideoLevel != wantLevel || probe.VideoBFrames != plan.Output.BFrames || probe.VideoExtradataHash == "" || probe.VideoTimeBaseNum <= 0 || probe.VideoTimeBaseDen <= 0 || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height || probe.VideoFPSNum != plan.Output.FPSNum || probe.VideoFPSDen != plan.Output.FPSDen || probe.VideoPixelFormat != plan.Output.PixelFormat {

            windowEnd := segment.SourceInUS + segment.SourceDurationUS
            frameUS := int64(1_000_000 * plan.Output.FPSDen / plan.Output.FPSNum)
            if windowEnd > actualUS+frameUS {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q window ends at %d us beyond probed duration %d us", segment.AssetID, windowEnd, actualUS)
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        if probe.VideoFrameCount != slicePlanFrameCount(plan) {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output has %d frames, plan requires %d; refusing to publish", probe.VideoFrameCount, slicePlanFrameCount(plan))
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func sameSliceCopySignature(a, b publisher.MediaProbe) bool {
        return a.VideoCodec == b.VideoCodec && a.VideoCodecTag == b.VideoCodecTag &&
            a.VideoProfile == b.VideoProfile && a.VideoLevel == b.VideoLevel &&
            a.VideoPixelFormat == b.VideoPixelFormat && a.VideoFPSNum == b.VideoFPSNum &&
            a.VideoFPSDen == b.VideoFPSDen && a.VideoTimeBaseNum == b.VideoTimeBaseNum &&
            a.VideoTimeBaseDen == b.VideoTimeBaseDen && a.VideoBFrames == b.VideoBFrames &&
            a.VideoExtradataHash == b.VideoExtradataHash
    }
    
    func writeSliceConcatList(path string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        var b strings.Builder
        b.WriteString("ffconcat version 1.0\n")
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            binding, ok := bindings[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q is not ready for stream-copy concat", segment.AssetID)
            }
            abs, err := filepath.Abs(binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }
            // The concat demuxer uses shell-like single-quoted paths; embedded
            // quotes are represented by closing, escaping, and reopening quotes.
            quoted := strings.ReplaceAll(abs, "'", "'\\''")
            frameDurationUS := segment.FrameCount * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
            fmt.Fprintf(&b, "file '%s'\ninpoint 0\noutpoint %s\n", quoted, seconds(frameDurationUS))
        }
        return os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o600)
    }
    
    func sliceConcatMuxArgs(listPath, audioPath, output string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) ([]string, error) {
        if strings.TrimSpace(audioPath) == "" {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio path is empty")
        }
        return []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
            "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listPath,
            "-threads", "1", "-i", audioPath,
            "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0", "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "copy",
            "-frames:v", strconv.FormatInt(slicePlanFrameCount(plan), 10),
            "-t", seconds(plan.DurationUS), "-video_track_timescale", strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.TimeBaseDen),
            "-movflags", "+faststart", output}, nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        var frames int64
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            frames += segment.FrameCount
        }
        return frames
    }
    
    func seconds(microseconds int64) string {
        return strconv.FormatFloat(float64(microseconds)/1_000_000, 'f', 6, 64)
    }

    // DriveFolderID is the canonical Google Drive folder identifier extracted
    // from a supported folder URL. It is deliberately distinct from DriveFileID:
    // a folder is a collection that must be expanded before a worker can consume
    // its media files.
    type DriveFolderID string
    
    // String returns the canonical string representation.
    func (id DriveFolderID) String() string { return string(id) }
    
    // Empty reports whether the ID has no usable value.
    func (id DriveFolderID) Empty() bool { return strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" }
    
    // ParseDriveFolderID extracts the canonical folder ID from a Google Drive
    // folder URL. File URLs are rejected so callers cannot accidentally treat a
    // single file as a stock pool.
    func ParseDriveFolderID(rawURL string) (DriveFolderID, error) {
        rawURL = strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)
        if rawURL == "" {
            return "", ErrEmpty
        }
    
        u, err := url.Parse(rawURL)
        if err != nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("assetref: parse %q: %w", rawURL, err)
        }
        host := strings.ToLower(u.Host)
        if host != "drive.google.com" && host != "www.drive.google.com" {
            return "", &NotDriveError{URL: rawURL}
        }
        parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(u.Path, "/"), "/")
        for i, part := range parts {
            if !strings.EqualFold(part, "folders") || i+1 >= len(parts) {
                continue
            }
            id := strings.TrimSpace(parts[i+1])
            if id != "" {
                return DriveFolderID(id), nil
            }
            break
        }
        return "", &NoIDError{URL: rawURL}
    }
    
    // ParseDriveFileID extracts the canonical Google Drive file ID from a
    // supported URL form, preserving the case of the opaque provider ID.
    func ParseDriveFileID(rawURL string) (DriveFileID, error) {
        rawURL = strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)
        if rawURL == "" {
            return "", ErrEmpty

        u, err := url.Parse(rawURL)
        if err != nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("assetref: parse %q: %w", rawURL, err)
        }
    
        host := strings.ToLower(u.Host)
        if host != "drive.google.com" && host != "www.drive.google.com" {
            return "", &NotDriveError{URL: rawURL}
        }

    func (h *Handlers) submitJobCore(ctx context.Context, req SubmitJobRequest, identity intakeIdentity) intakeResponse {

        // chars or forbidden separators (':' or '%'). The helper trims whitespace

        // resolver as source_job_id. A typed *IdempotencyKeyError carries a
        // machine-readable reason + diagnostics so the API envelope is actionable.
        // 400 because idempotency_key is a request-level byte-shape issue, distinct
        // from the 422 semantic issues that follow.
        if vErr, bad := ValidateIdempotencyKey(req.IdempotencyKey); bad {
            status, body := idempotencyKeyErrorEnvelope(vErr)
            return intakeResponse{Status: status, Body: body}
        }
        // ValidateIdempotencyKey intentionally trims only for validation; carry the
        // same canonical value into the resolver, response, and logs so retries
        // with surrounding whitespace cannot diverge.
        req.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(req.IdempotencyKey)

        if vErr, bad := ValidateSubmitJobRequest(req); bad {

    package pipeline
    
    import (

    // resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets is the one V2 folder-resolution boundary.
    // It lists metadata only; media bytes remain worker-owned transfers.
    func (h *Handlers) resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets(ctx context.Context, req *SubmitJobRequest) error {
    	if req == nil || req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON == "" {
    		return nil
    	}
    	plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON))
    	if err != nil || plan.StockPool == nil {
    		return err
    	}
    	if h.stockFolderLister == nil {
    		return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool requires the Master Drive folder-listing capability")
    	}
    	folderURL := "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID
    	folderID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFolderID(folderURL)
    	if err != nil {
    		return err
    	}
    	files, err := listStockFolderVideos(ctx, h.stockFolderLister, folderID.String(), 0, make(map[string]struct{}))
    	if err != nil {
    		return err
    	}
    	if len(files) == 0 {
    		return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool Drive folder contains no video files")
    	}
    	runtimeAssets := append([]map[string]interface{}(nil), req.RuntimeAssets...)
    	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(runtimeAssets)+len(files))
    	for _, asset := range runtimeAssets {
    		if id, ok := asset["asset_id"].(string); ok {
    			seen[id] = struct{}{}
    		}
    	}
    	for _, file := range files {
    		if _, exists := seen[file.ID]; exists {
    			continue
    		}
    		asset := map[string]interface{}{
    			"asset_id": file.ID, "asset_key": file.ID, "drive_file_id": file.ID,
    			"url": "velox-drive://" + file.ID,
    			"source_uri": "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + file.ID,
    			"kind": "video", "stock_pool_member": true,
    		}
    		if file.Size > 0 { asset["size_bytes"] = file.Size }
    		if file.VideoMediaMetadata.DurationMillis > 0 { asset["duration_ms"] = file.VideoMediaMetadata.DurationMillis }
    		runtimeAssets = append(runtimeAssets, asset)
    		seen[file.ID] = struct{}{}
    	}
    	req.RuntimeAssets = runtimeAssets
    	// Ensure downstream payload projection sees the stable snapshot. The plan
    	// remains byte-for-byte hash-bound; retries reuse the accepted runtime list.
    	_, _ = json.Marshal(runtimeAssets)
    	return nil
    }
    
    var _ = drive.File{}

    // resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets is the one V2 folder-resolution boundary.
    // It lists metadata only; media bytes remain worker-owned transfers.
    func (h *Handlers) resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets(ctx context.Context, req *SubmitJobRequest) error {
        if req == nil || req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON == "" {
            return nil
        }
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON))
        if err != nil || plan.StockPool == nil {
            return err
        }
        if h.stockFolderLister == nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool requires the Master Drive folder-listing capability")
        }
        folderURL := "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID
        folderID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFolderID(folderURL)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        files, err := listStockFolderVideos(ctx, h.stockFolderLister, folderID.String(), 0, make(map[string]struct{}))
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
    
    // CompiledPlanVersionV2 identifies the producer-compiled execution-plan
    // contract. CompiledRenderPlanV2 intentionally lives beside, rather than
    // replacing, the existing V1 master/worker render-plan mirrors.
    const CompiledPlanVersionV2 = 2
    
    // AudioModeFinalAudioCopyV2 declares that the final audio asset is already
    // mixed and must be muxed without another audio mix or encode.
    const (
        // AudioModeFinalAudioCopy is the wire value for an already-finalized
        // audio asset that must be muxed without another mix or encode.
        AudioModeFinalAudioCopy = "FINAL_AUDIO_COPY"
    
        // AudioModeFinalAudioCopyV2 is retained as an explicit V2-named alias for
        // callers that prefer versioned constants; both names have one wire value.
        AudioModeFinalAudioCopyV2 = AudioModeFinalAudioCopy
    )
    
    // CompiledRenderPlanV2 is the canonical, producer-compiled execution plan.
    // It contains editorial decisions and verified asset identity only; job and
    // attempt identity remain in the surrounding TaskSpec so retries and workers
    // can consume the same plan bytes and plan hash.
    type CompiledRenderPlanV2 struct {
        PlanVersion      int              `json:"plan_version"`
        TimelineRevision int64            `json:"timeline_revision"`
        TimelineSHA256   string           `json:"timeline_sha256"`
        DurationUS       int64            `json:"duration_us"`
        Output           OutputContractV2 `json:"output"`
        FinalAudio       FinalAudioV2     `json:"final_audio"`

    func sliceRuntimePoolMembers(raw interface{}) []slicePoolMember {
        data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        var members []slicePoolMember
        _ = json.Unmarshal(data, &members)
        return members
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) compileStockPoolPlan(ctx context.Context, spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        if plan.StockPool == nil || plan.StockPool.Selection != "shuffle" {
            return nil, errors.New("unsupported stock_pool selection")
        }
        members := sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        ordered := make([]slicePoolMember, 0, len(members))
        for _, member := range members {
            if member.StockPoolMember {
                ordered = append(ordered, member)
            }
        }
        sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].DriveFileID < ordered[j].DriveFileID })
        seedBytes := sha256.Sum256([]byte(spec.JobID + ":" + plan.TimelineSHA256 + ":" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID))
        rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(seedBytes[:8]))))
        rng.Shuffle(len(ordered), func(i, j int) { ordered[i], ordered[j] = ordered[j], ordered[i] })
        want := slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan)
        compiled := *plan
        compiled.StockPool = nil
        compiled.Assets = append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        compiled.VideoTracks = append([]contract.VideoTrackV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks...)
        for i := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            compiled.VideoTracks[i].Segments = append([]contract.VideoSegmentV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks[i].Segments...)
        }
        compiled.VideoTracks[0].Segments = []contract.VideoSegmentV2{}
        var next int64
        var baseline *publisher.MediaProbe
        for _, member := range ordered {
            if next >= want {
                break
            }
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            binding, ok := bindings[assetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || binding.Size <= 0 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q has no verified worker cache binding", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("probe stock source %q: %w", member.DriveFileID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height || probe.VideoFPSNum != plan.Output.FPSNum || probe.VideoFPSDen != plan.Output.FPSDen || probe.VideoPixelFormat != plan.Output.PixelFormat || probe.VideoFrameCount <= 0 || probe.VideoExtradataHash == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q is incompatible with packet-copy output; refusing to transcode", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            if err := verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx, binding.Path); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q cannot be concatenated safely: %w", member.DriveFileID, err)
            }
            if baseline == nil {
                cp := probe
                baseline = &cp
            } else if !sameSliceCopySignature(*baseline, probe) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q codec parameters differ; refusing to transcode", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            count := probe.VideoFrameCount
            if count > want-next {
                count = want - next
            }
            asset := contract.AssetRefV2{AssetID: assetID, AssetKey: member.DriveFileID, SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: member.DriveFileID, SHA256: binding.SHA256, SizeBytes: binding.Size, Kind: "video", ProfileID: plan.Output.ProfileID, FrameCount: probe.VideoFrameCount, FirstFrameKeyframe: true, ClosedGOP: true, DurationUS: int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000), Width: probe.Width, Height: probe.Height}
            compiled.Assets = append(compiled.Assets, asset)
            compiled.VideoTracks[0].Segments = append(compiled.VideoTracks[0].Segments, contract.VideoSegmentV2{SegmentID: fmt.Sprintf("stock-%04d", len(compiled.VideoTracks[0].Segments)), AssetID: assetID, TimelineStartFrame: next, FrameCount: count, SourceDurationUS: count * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)})
            next += count
        }
        if next < want {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock pool has only %d compatible frames; output requires %d", next, want)
        }
        return &compiled, nil
    }
    
    func verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
        cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "packet=flags", "-read_intervals", "%+#1", "-of", "csv=p=0", path)
        out, err := cmd.Output()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("ffprobe first packet: %w", err)
        }
        if !strings.Contains(string(out), "K") {
            return errors.New("first video packet is not a keyframe")
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }

    package contract
    
    import (
        "crypto/sha256"
        "encoding/hex"

    func validPlanForValidation() *CompiledRenderPlanV2 {
        plan := testCompiledRenderPlanV2()
        // The canonical fixture uses a source offset of 33.2s, so provide a
        // source asset long enough to contain that trim window. Validation also
        // requires the timeline binding to be a real SHA256 value.
        plan.Assets[0].DurationUS = 40_000_000
        plan.TimelineSHA256 = strings.Repeat("c", 64)
        plan.FinalAudio.TimelineSHA256 = plan.TimelineSHA256
        return plan
    }
    
    func canonicalPlanForValidation(t *testing.T) ([]byte, *CompiledRenderPlanV2) {
        t.Helper()
        plan := validPlanForValidation()
        data, err := plan.CanonicalJSON()
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatalf("CanonicalJSON: %v", err)
        }
        return data, plan
    }
    
    func requireValidationPath(t *testing.T, err error, wantPath string) {
        t.Helper()
        if err == nil {
            t.Fatalf("validation returned nil, want violation at %s", wantPath)
        }
        var violations CompiledRenderPlanV2ValidationErrors
        if !errors.As(err, &violations) {
            t.Fatalf("error type = %T, want CompiledRenderPlanV2ValidationErrors: %v", err, err)
        }
        for _, violation := range violations {
            if violation.Path == wantPath {
                return
            }
        }
        t.Fatalf("validation paths = %v, want %s", validationPaths(violations), wantPath)
    }
    
    func validationPaths(violations CompiledRenderPlanV2ValidationErrors) []string {
        paths := make([]string, 0, len(violations))
        for _, violation := range violations {
            paths = append(paths, violation.Path)
        }
        return paths
    }
    
    func TestValidateCompiledRenderPlanV2_AcceptsValidPlan(t *testing.T) {
        plan := validPlanForValidation()
        if err := ValidateCompiledRenderPlanV2(plan); err != nil {
            t.Fatalf("valid plan rejected: %v", err)
        }
        canonical, err := plan.CanonicalJSON()
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatalf("CanonicalJSON: %v", err)
        }
        decoded, err := DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2(canonical)
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatalf("DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2: %v", err)
        }
        if decoded.PlanVersion != CompiledPlanVersionV2 || decoded.FinalAudio.Mode != AudioModeFinalAudioCopy {
            t.Fatalf("decoded plan identity = %+v", decoded)
        }
    }

    // futureAssetRuntimeBindings joins FINALIZE's direct byte locators to the
    // producer-compiled plan by asset_id. The plan intentionally carries only
    // immutable identity; worker-only source URIs remain in runtime_assets.
    func futureAssetRuntimeBindings(root interface{}) (map[string]string, map[string]string) {
        sourceURIs := make(map[string]string)
        planAssetKeys := make(map[string]string)
        var walk func(interface{})
        walk = func(value interface{}) {
            switch node := value.(type) {
            case []interface{}:
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            case map[string]interface{}:
                if rawPlan, ok := node[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string); ok {
                    if plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(rawPlan)); err == nil && plan != nil {
                        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
                            key := asset.AssetKey
                            if key == "" {
                                key = asset.AssetID
                            }
                            if asset.AssetID != "" && key != "" {
                                planAssetKeys[asset.AssetID] = key
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if runtimeAssets, ok := node["runtime_assets"].([]interface{}); ok {
                    for _, raw := range runtimeAssets {
                        asset, ok := raw.(map[string]interface{})
                        if !ok {
                            continue
                        }
                        id, _ := asset["asset_id"].(string)
                        uri, _ := asset["source_uri"].(string)
                        if strings.TrimSpace(uri) == "" {
                            uri, _ = asset["url"].(string)
                            lowerURI := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(uri))
                            if !strings.HasPrefix(lowerURI, "https://") && !strings.HasPrefix(lowerURI, "http://") {
                                uri = ""
                            }
                        }
                        if strings.TrimSpace(id) != "" && strings.TrimSpace(uri) != "" {
                            sourceURIs[strings.TrimSpace(id)] = strings.TrimSpace(uri)
                        }
                    }
                }
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            }
        }
        walk(root)
        return sourceURIs, planAssetKeys
    }
    
    func appendCompiledPlanAssetManifests(raw string, seen map[string]futureasset.AssetManifest, sourceURIs map[string]string) {
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(raw))
        if err != nil || plan == nil {
            return
        }
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            key := asset.AssetKey
            if key == "" {
                key = asset.AssetID
            }
            if key == "" || asset.SHA256 == "" || asset.SizeBytes <= 0 {
                continue
            }
            seen[key] = futureasset.AssetManifest{
                AssetKey: key, AssetID: asset.AssetID, SHA256: asset.SHA256,
                SizeBytes: asset.SizeBytes, MIMEType: asset.MIME, Role: asset.Kind,
                SourceURI: sourceURIs[asset.AssetID],
            }
        }
    }

    package grpcserver
    
    import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "sort"
        "strings"
    
        "velox-shared/assetref"
        "velox-shared/contract"
        "velox-shared/futureasset"
        "velox-shared/paths"
    )
    
    // futureAssetManifestsWithCatalog upgrades source-only Drive references with
    // identities learned from an earlier verified prefetch. The payload remains
    // authoritative when it already contains SHA-256 metadata.
    func (h *Handler) futureAssetManifestsWithCatalog(ctx context.Context, payload []byte) []futureasset.AssetManifest {
        assets := futureAssetManifests(payload)
        if h == nil || h.dbStore == nil {
            return assets
        }
        for i := range assets {
            if assets[i].SHA256 != "" || assets[i].AssetID == "" {
                continue
            }
            identity, found, err := h.dbStore.LookupAssetIdentity(ctx, assets[i].AssetID)
            if err != nil || !found {
                continue
            }
            assets[i].SHA256 = identity.SHA256
            assets[i].SizeBytes = identity.SizeBytes
        }
        return assets
    }
    
    // futureAssetManifests extracts all referenced asset manifests from a task
    // payload, walking nested JSON to collect {asset_key, sha256, size_bytes}
    // triples. The returned list is sorted deterministically by AssetKey for
    // stable placement decisions and cache comparisons.
    func futureAssetManifests(payload []byte) []futureasset.AssetManifest {
        var root interface{}
        if len(payload) == 0 || json.Unmarshal(payload, &root) != nil {
            return nil
        }
        if object, ok := root.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
            if pending, _ := object["runtime_assets_pending"].(bool); pending {
                return nil
            }
        }
        seen := make(map[string]futureasset.AssetManifest)
        sourceURIs, planAssetKeys := futureAssetRuntimeBindings(root)
        var walk func(interface{})
        walk = func(value interface{}) {
            switch node := value.(type) {
            case []interface{}:
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            case map[string]interface{}:
                if rawPlan, ok := node[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string); ok {
                    appendCompiledPlanAssetManifests(rawPlan, seen, sourceURIs)
                }
                // The canonical worker payload persists typed scenes in
                // scenes_json.  Keep manifest discovery recursive across that
                // boundary: otherwise stock assets survive in the task payload but
                // disappear from the future plan and are downloaded at runtime.
                if rawScenes, ok := node["scenes_json"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(rawScenes) != "" {
                    var scenes interface{}
                    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(rawScenes), &scenes); err == nil {
                        walk(scenes)
                    }
                }
                key, _ := node["asset_key"].(string)
                assetID, _ := node["asset_id"].(string)
                if assetID == "" {
                    assetID, _ = node["drive_file_id"].(string)
                }
                rawURL, _ := node["url"].(string)
                if strings.TrimSpace(rawURL) == "" {
                    rawURL, _ = node["drive_link"].(string)
                }
                if assetID == "" {
                    if driveID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFileID(rawURL); err == nil {
                        assetID = driveID.String()
                    }
                }
                sha, _ := node["sha256"].(string)
                if sha == "" {
                    sha, _ = node["asset_sha256"].(string)
                }
                var size int64
                switch n := node["size_bytes"].(type) {
                case float64:
                    size = int64(n)
                case int64:
                    size = n
                }
                if key == "" {
                    key = planAssetKeys[assetID]
                }
                if key == "" {
                    key = assetID
                }
                sourceURI, _ := node["source_uri"].(string)
                if sourceURI == "" && (strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)), "https://") || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)), "http://")) {
                    sourceURI = strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)
                }
                if sourceURI == "" {
                    if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)), "velox-drive://") {
                        sourceURI = "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + strings.TrimSpace(rawURL[len("velox-drive://"):])
                    } else if driveID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFileID(rawURL); err == nil {
                        sourceURI = "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + driveID.String()
                    }
                }
                // Producers may provide Drive's human-facing /file/d/.../view
                // locator in source_uri. FutureAssetPlan must carry a byte endpoint;
                // otherwise the worker receives HTML and can never certify the asset.
                if sourceURI != "" {
                    sourceURI = paths.NormalizeDriveURL(sourceURI)
                }
                if key != "" && assetID == "" {
                    assetID = key
                }
                // A deferred Drive manifest is intentionally not content-addressed
                // yet: the worker owns the direct Drive transfer and computes the
                // immutable SHA-256 before PREPARED. It is admitted only with a
                // trusted source locator and a positive Drive-reported size.
                complete := sha != "" && size > 0
                deferred := sourceURI != "" && assetID != "" && size > 0
                if key != "" && (complete || deferred) {
                    role, _ := node["role"].(string)
                    seen[key] = futureasset.AssetManifest{AssetKey: key, AssetID: assetID, SHA256: sha, SizeBytes: size, Role: role, SourceURI: sourceURI}
                }
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            }
        }
        walk(root)
        out := make([]futureasset.AssetManifest, 0, len(seen))
        for _, asset := range seen {
            out = append(out, asset)
        }
        sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
            return out[i].AssetKey < out[j].AssetKey
        })
        return out
    }

    $ sed -n '1,100p' deploy/velox-server.service; systemctl cat velox-server.service
    # Velox Master Server - Systemd Service
    # =============================================
    # Install: sudo ./deploy/install-server.sh
    # Manual:  sudo cp deploy/velox-server.service /etc/systemd/system/
    #          sudo systemctl daemon-reload
    #          sudo systemctl enable --now velox-server
    #
    # Logs:    journalctl -u velox-server -f
    # Status:  systemctl status velox-server
    #
    # Environment file: /etc/velox-server.env
    #   Configure all VELOX_* vars there, including VELOX_SERVER_IMAGE pinned to
    #   ghcr.io/<owner>/velox-server@sha256:<digest>.
    # =============================================
    
    [Unit]
    Description=Velox Master Server
    Documentation=https://codebuff.com/docs
    After=network-online.target
    Wants=network-online.target
    StartLimitIntervalSec=60
    StartLimitBurst=3
    
    [Service]
    Type=simple
    # The unit drives Docker itself, so it must run as root. The application
    # process still runs inside the container as the image's unprivileged user.
    EnvironmentFile=/etc/velox-server.env
    ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm -f velox-server
    ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/docker pull ${VELOX_SERVER_IMAGE}
    # Keep the existing production runtime/database path visible when the
    # converged env points at /opt/velox/current/.velox. The native service used
    # this path; switching to Docker must preserve the same DB rather than
    # creating or copying a second database under /var/lib/velox.
    # The production gRPC certificate paths are rooted at /opt/velox/certs;
    # expose that existing certificate tree read-only inside the container.
    ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --rm \
        --name velox-server \
        --network host \
        --env-file /etc/velox-server.env \
        --env VELOX_HTTP_PORT=${VELOX_MASTER_PORT} \
        --env VELOX_DATA_DIR=${VELOX_DATA_DIR} \
        --env VELOX_DB_PATH=${VELOX_DB_PATH} \
        --mount type=bind,src=/var/lib/velox,dst=/var/lib/velox \
        --mount type=bind,src=/opt/velox/current/.velox,dst=/opt/velox/current/.velox \
        --mount type=bind,src=/opt/velox/certs,dst=/opt/velox/certs,readonly \
        --mount type=bind,src=/etc/velox,dst=/etc/velox,readonly \
        ${VELOX_SERVER_IMAGE}
    ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker stop -t 60 velox-server
    ExecStopPost=-/usr/bin/docker rm -f velox-server
    
    # Restart behavior
    Restart=always
    RestartSec=10
    
    # Graceful shutdown — Stop() tears down gRPC immediately (workers hold
    # open bidirectional streams that would block GracefulStop forever).
    # 60s is a generous safety net; the actual shutdown completes in <5s.
    TimeoutStopSec=60
    KillMode=process
    KillSignal=SIGTERM
    
    # Resource limits
    LimitNOFILE=65536
    LimitNPROC=4096
    
    # Logging
    StandardOutput=journal
    StandardError=journal
    SyslogIdentifier=velox-server
    
    [Install]
    WantedBy=multi-user.target

    ---
    # PR E — Standardised worker runtime for the single co-located worker pair.
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # One worker runtime per host. The Compose project and container names are
    # fixed so systemd, Ansible, monitoring, and operators address the same
    # runtime everywhere. The image reference MUST be set by the operator via
    # `${VELOX_WORKER_IMAGE}` (typically exported by prepare-host.sh from a
    # CI digest artifact). The deploy-time gate in prepare-host.sh additionally
    # enforces sha256-pinning so :latest and other mutable refs are rejected.
    #
    # read-only root + tmpfs /tmp + cap_drop ALL + no-new-privileges are
    # deliberate hardening. NET_BIND_SERVICE is NOT granted — bind ports >=1024.
    # Adjust per-host resource ceilings below if a specific worker host has
    # tighter envelopes (then pull this file into a host-specific override).
    
    name: velox-worker
    
    services:
      velox-worker:
        image: ${VELOX_WORKER_IMAGE:?VELOX_WORKER_IMAGE must be set — pin to ghcr.io/<owner>/velox-worker@sha256:<digest>}
    
        container_name: velox-worker
    
        # Bound container stdout/stderr logs. Worker diagnostics remain available
        # in journald; Docker's json-file copy must not grow without limit.
        logging:
          driver: json-file
          options:
            labels: "service,version"
            max-size: "10m"
            max-file: "5"
    
        environment:
          VELOX_RENDER_BACKEND: ${VELOX_RENDER_BACKEND:-native}
          CHRONON3D_CLI: ${CHRONON3D_CLI:-/opt/chronon3d/bin/chronon3d_cli}
          # Production certification is fail-closed unless the runtime carries
          # explicit evidence that no privileged remote Docker build is allowed.
          VELOX_REMOTE_REBUILD_DISABLED: "true"
    
        # systemd velox-worker.service is the sole restart owner; Docker does not
        # independently re-arm this container.
        # Docker-injected minimal init reaps the C++ engine child processes on
        # shutdown — without this, orphans can survive `docker compose down`.
        init: true
    
        env_file:
          - /etc/velox-worker/worker.env
    
        # The Dockerfile default CMD is `["-master", "http://master:8000"]`. We
        # override here so the binary actually reads VELOX_MASTER_URL (the REST
        # base URL, e.g. http://master:8000) and VELOX_WORK_DIR from env_file.
        # The `-master` flag is the worker's MASTER_URL (REST), NOT the gRPC dial
        # target: passing VELOX_GRPC_MASTER_URL (host:port, no scheme) here makes
        # the worker refuse with `invalid master_url` at boot. The :? form
        # mirrors VELOX_WORKER_IMAGE below — a missing var fails loudly at
        # `docker compose config` time instead of silently dialing a default.
        command:
          - "-master"
          - "${VELOX_MASTER_URL:?VELOX_MASTER_URL must be set — REST base URL, e.g. http://master:8000}"
          - "-work-dir"
          - "${VELOX_WORK_DIR:-/var/lib/velox-worker/work}"
    
        # Bind the health endpoint to the host`s loopback on VELOX_HEALTH_PORT.
        # The compose healthcheck probes the container`s localhost directly; this
        # binding additionally lets `curl http://127.0.0.1:${VELOX_HEALTH_PORT}/health/ready`
        # from the host (used by deploy/runtime/checklist-verify.sh §12 and the
        # systemd ExecStartPost) reach the endpoint without `docker exec`. Bound
        # to 127.0.0.1 so it`s NEVER exposed on the public interface.
        #
        # The canonical runtime owns one worker per host, so the loopback port is
        # stable and is never derived from inventory hostnames or container names.
        ports:
          - "127.0.0.1:${VELOX_HEALTH_PORT:-8081}:${VELOX_HEALTH_PORT:-8081}"
    
        volumes:
          # Persistent state — survives container recreation. The explicit
          # VELOX_STATE_DIR is required so Compose, apply-local-worker-config,
          # prepare-host, and the worker all share one mutable-state boundary.
          # Mount host and container paths identically: a custom state root must
          # remain the same path in the worker config and inside the container.
          - ${VELOX_STATE_DIR:?VELOX_STATE_DIR must be set in /etc/velox-worker/worker.env}:${VELOX_STATE_DIR:?VELOX_STATE_DIR must be set in /etc/velox-worker/worker.env}
          # Worker config — bind-mounted read-only at the path the Go binary
          # expects by default (/opt/velox/worker_config.json, hard-coded in
          # main.go). The host-side file remains inside VELOX_STATE_DIR.
          - ${VELOX_STATE_DIR:?VELOX_STATE_DIR must be set in /etc/velox-worker/worker.env}/worker_config.json:/opt/velox/worker_config.json:ro
          # TLS certs and per-worker credentials — read-only mounts into /run.
          # prepare-host.sh chowns the host-side dirs to root:${IMAGE_GID} with
          # mode 0750 so the in-container velox user (uid 10001) can traverse;
          # worker.key + worker_credential are owned by uid 10001 at mode 0600
          # (RW-PROD-001 A2) so the container can read them through the mounts.
          - /etc/velox-worker/certs/current:/run/velox/certs:ro
          - /etc/velox-worker/secrets:/run/velox/secrets:ro
    
        # Hardened filesystem posture.
        read_only: true
        tmpfs:
          # /tmp is the working set for C++ engine + ffmpeg scratch. 4g is a
          # reasonable upper bound for normal jobs; bump per-host if larger
          # payloads are routinely processed.
          - /tmp:size=4g,mode=1777
          # Dedicated bounded RAM staging for Velox scratch and artifact output.
          # The worker config points both tmpfs placement classes here; the
          # storage resolver still reserves RAM and falls back to NVMe safely.
          - /dev/shm/velox-work:size=3g,mode=1777,noexec,nosuid,nodev
    
        security_opt:
          - no-new-privileges:true
    
        cap_drop:
          - ALL

    func validateAsset(violations *CompiledRenderPlanV2ValidationErrors, path string, asset AssetRefV2) {
        if strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID) == "" {
            violations.add(path+".asset_id", "required", "non-empty asset_id", asset.AssetID)
        }
        deferredDriveVideo := isDeferredDriveVideo(asset)
        if !deferredDriveVideo && !isLowerSHA256(asset.SHA256) {
            violations.add(path+".sha256", "invalid_sha256", "64 lowercase hexadecimal characters", asset.SHA256)
        }
        if asset.SizeBytes <= 0 && !deferredDriveVideo {
            violations.add(path+".size_bytes", "out_of_range", "positive bytes", fmt.Sprint(asset.SizeBytes))
        }
        if asset.SourceKind != "" && asset.SourceKind != "drive" {
            violations.add(path+".source_kind", "unsupported_value", "drive", asset.SourceKind)
        }
        if asset.SourceKind == "drive" && !deferredDriveVideo {
            violations.add(path+".drive_file_id", "invalid_drive_source", "Drive video asset with drive_file_id", asset.DriveFileID)
        }
        if strings.TrimSpace(asset.Kind) == "" {
            violations.add(path+".kind", "required", "non-empty asset kind", asset.Kind)
        }
        if asset.DurationUS < 0 {
            violations.add(path+".duration_us", "out_of_range", "non-negative microseconds", fmt.Sprint(asset.DurationUS))
        }
        if asset.Width < 0 || asset.Height < 0 {
            violations.add(path, "invalid_dimensions", "non-negative width and height", fmt.Sprintf("%dx%d", asset.Width, asset.Height))
        }
        if asset.Kind == "video" || asset.Kind == "prepared_video_fragment" || asset.Kind == "final_audio" {
            if asset.DurationUS <= 0 {
                violations.add(path+".duration_us", "required", "positive microseconds for media assets", fmt.Sprint(asset.DurationUS))
            }
        }
    }

    func isDeferredDriveVideo(asset AssetRefV2) bool {
        if asset.Kind != "video" {
            return false
        }
        if asset.SourceKind == "drive" && strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID) != "" {
            return true
        }
        return strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:")
    }
    
    func (e *CompiledRenderPlanV2ValidationErrors) add(path, issue, expected, observed string) {
        *e = append(*e, CompiledRenderPlanV2ValidationError{
            Path: path, Issue: issue, Expected: expected, Observed: observed,
        })
    }
    
    func isLowerSHA256(value string) bool {
        if len(value) != 64 || strings.ToLower(value) != value {
            return false
        }
        _, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
        return err == nil
    }
    
    func withinDuration(left, right, tolerance int64) bool {
        if left >= right {
            return left-right <= tolerance
        }
        return right-left <= tolerance
    }
    
    func nonNegativeSum(left, right int64) (int64, bool) {
        if left < 0 || right < 0 || left > int64(^uint64(0)>>1)-right {
            return 0, false
        }

    func verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
        cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "packet=flags", "-read_intervals", "%+#1", "-of", "csv=p=0", path)
        out, err := cmd.Output()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("ffprobe first packet: %w", err)
        }
        if !strings.Contains(string(out), "K") {
            return errors.New("first video packet is not a keyframe")
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }

    func verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
        cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "packet=flags", "-read_intervals", "%+#1", "-of", "csv=p=0", path)
        out, err := cmd.Output()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("ffprobe first packet: %w", err)
        }
        if !strings.Contains(string(out), "K") {
            return errors.New("first video packet is not a keyframe")
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    # Compatibility launcher for the single typed fleetctl implementation.
    # Bash owns only binary/token/environment resolution; HTTP, parsing, polling,
    # operation IDs, terminal states, rollout and job semantics live in Go.
    set -euo pipefail
    
    ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    MASTER_URL="${VELOX_MASTER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}"
    MASTER_URL="${MASTER_URL%/}"
    
    usage() {
        cat <<'EOF'
    Usage:
      scripts/fleetctl <command> [args]
    
    The command is executed by the typed Go client. Supported commands include:
      status inspect drain resume quarantine restart update rollback operations
      wait-ready rollout smoke ssh-check job doctor
    
    Environment:
      VELOX_MASTER_URL   Master base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000)
      VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN  Admin bearer token
      TOKEN_FILE         File containing VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN=<value>
      FLEETCTL_GO_BIN    Go fleetctl binary override
    EOF
    }
    
    die() {
        printf 'fleetctl: %s\n' "$*" >&2
        exit 2
    }
    
    resolve_token() {
        if [[ -n "${VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
            printf '%s' "$VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN"
            return
        fi
        if [[ -n "${TOKEN_FILE:-}" && -r "$TOKEN_FILE" ]]; then
            local token
            token="$(sed -n 's/^VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN=//p' "$TOKEN_FILE" | head -n 1 \
                | tr -d '\r' | sed "s/^['\"]//; s/['\"]$//")"
            [[ -n "$token" ]] || die "TOKEN_FILE does not contain VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN"
            printf '%s' "$token"
            return
        fi
        die 'VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN or TOKEN_FILE is required'
    }
    
    resolve_go_fleetctl() {
        local candidate="${FLEETCTL_GO_BIN:-$ROOT/DataServer/bin/fleetctl}"
        [[ -x "$candidate" ]] || die "Go fleetctl binary not found: $candidate (set FLEETCTL_GO_BIN or build DataServer/cmd/fleetctl)"
        printf '%s' "$candidate"
    }
    
    if [[ $# -eq 0 || "${1:-}" == "help" || "${1:-}" == "--help" || "${1:-}" == "-h" ]]; then
        usage
        [[ $# -eq 0 ]] && exit 2 || exit 0
    fi
    
    binary="$(resolve_go_fleetctl)"
    export VELOX_MASTER_URL="$MASTER_URL"
    if [[ -z "${VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        export VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN="$(resolve_token)"
    fi
    exec "$binary" "$@" "--master=$MASTER_URL"

        "os"
        "strings"
        "time"
    )
    
    // runJobSubmit implements `job submit` (wait=false) and `job certify`
    // (wait=true). Returns the canonical fleetctl exit code.
    func runJobSubmit(client *fleetClient, args []string, certify bool) int {
        opts, err := parseJobSubmitArgs(args)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "%v", err))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
        payloadFile := opts.payloadFile
        raw, err := os.ReadFile(payloadFile)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "read job payload file: %v", err))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
        var payload map[string]any
        if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload); err != nil || payload == nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "job payload must be a JSON object: %v", err))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
    
        workers, err := resolveWorkerIDs(client, opts.selection)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
            return ExitUnexpected
        }
        if len(workers) == 0 {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "no workers selected"))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
    
        // Ephemeral M2M key lifecycle. The Bash bridge used a trap; Go uses
        // defer so the key is disabled even on partial-failure exits.
        m2mToken, cleanup, err := issueM2MKey(client, opts.idemPrefix)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
            return ExitUnexpected
        }
        defer cleanup()
    
        m2mClient := client.withToken(m2mToken)
    
        jobIDs := make([]string, 0, len(workers))
        for _, workerID := range workers {
            requestCtx, requestCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
            key := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%d", opts.idemPrefix, workerID, time.Now().UnixNano())
            jobID, err := submitOneJob(requestCtx, m2mClient, payload, workerID, key)
            requestCancel()
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
                return ExitUnexpected
            }
            jobIDs = append(jobIDs, jobID)
            fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fleetctl: submitted job=%s worker=%s\n", jobID, workerID)
        }
    
        if !opts.wait && !certify {
            for _, jobID := range jobIDs {
                fmt.Println(jobID)
            }
            return ExitOK
        }
    
        // --wait / certify: poll each job to terminal state, then print the
        // final admin snapshot (same surface the legacy print_job_card used).
        overall := ExitOK
        for _, jobID := range jobIDs {
            if err := waitForJob(context.Background(), m2mClient, jobID); err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
                overall = ExitUnexpected
                continue
            }
            if err := printFinalJobSnapshot(client, jobID); err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
                overall = ExitUnexpected
            }
        }
        return overall
    }
    
    // jobSubmitOptions holds the parsed `job submit` flags.
    type jobSubmitOptions struct {
        payloadFile string
        selection   string // "all" or a comma-separated worker_id list
        idemPrefix  string
        wait        bool
    }
    }
    
    func parseJobSubmitArgs(args []string) (jobSubmitOptions, error) {
        opts := jobSubmitOptions{
            selection:  "all",
            idemPrefix: fmt.Sprintf("fleetctl-%d", time.Now().Unix()),
        }
        for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
            arg := args[i]
            switch {
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--payload="):
                opts.payloadFile = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--payload=")
            case arg == "--payload":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New("--payload requires a file")
                }
                i++
                opts.payloadFile = args[i]
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--workers="):
                opts.selection = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--workers=")
            case arg == "--workers":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New("--workers requires all or a comma-separated worker_id list")
                }
                i++
                opts.selection = args[i]
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--idempotency-prefix="):
                opts.idemPrefix = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--idempotency-prefix=")
            case arg == "--idempotency-prefix":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New("--idempotency-prefix requires a value")
                }
                i++
                opts.idemPrefix = args[i]
            case arg == "--wait":
                opts.wait = true
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--master=") || strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--token-file=") || arg == "--verbose":
                // global flags already consumed by loadClientConfig
            case arg == "--master" || arg == "--token-file":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New(arg + " requires a value")
                }
                i++
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-"):
                return opts, fmt.Errorf("unknown job submit option %q", arg)
            default:
                return opts, fmt.Errorf("unexpected job submit argument %q", arg)
            }
        }
        if opts.payloadFile == "" {
            return opts, errors.New("job payload file is required and must be readable")
        }
        return opts, nil
    }

            delCtx, delCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
            defer delCancel()
            // Best-effort: ignore errors so the operator's primary exit
            // code is not masked by a cleanup failure.
            _, _ = client.doJSON(delCtx, "DELETE", "/api/v1/admin/m2m/keys/"+url.PathEscape(response.ClientID), nil, nil)
        }
        return response.PlaintextSecret, cleanup, nil
    }
    
    // submitOneJob POSTs the payload augmented with idempotency_key and
    // placement_pin_worker_id to /api/v1/jobs using the M2M token.
    func submitOneJob(ctx context.Context, m2m *fleetClient, payload map[string]any, workerID, key string) (string, error) {
        augmented := make(map[string]any, len(payload)+2)
        for k, v := range payload {
            augmented[k] = v
        }
        augmented["idempotency_key"] = key
        augmented["placement_pin_worker_id"] = workerID
    
        var response map[string]any
        status, err := m2m.doJSON(ctx, "POST", "/api/v1/jobs", augmented, &response)
        if err != nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("submit job worker=%s: %w", workerID, err)
        }
        if status != httpOK && status != 202 {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("submit job worker=%s status=%d", workerID, status)
        }
        jobID, _ := response["job_id"].(string)
        if jobID == "" {
            if id, ok := response["id"].(string); ok {
                jobID = id
            }
        }
        if jobID == "" {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("submit job worker=%s returned no job_id", workerID)
        }
        return jobID, nil
    }
    
    // waitForJob polls /api/v1/jobs/{id} with the M2M token until the job
    // reaches a terminal lifecycle state or the 1h default / explicit env
    // timeout elapses.
    func waitForJob(ctx context.Context, m2m *fleetClient, jobID string) error {
        timeout := envSeconds("FLEETCTL_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 3600)
        poll := envSeconds("FLEETCTL_JOB_POLL_SECONDS", 5)
        deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
        for {
            requestCtx, requestCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
            var response struct {
                Status string `json:"status"`
                State  string `json:"state"`
            }
            status, err := m2m.doJSON(requestCtx, "GET", "/api/v1/jobs/"+url.PathEscape(jobID), nil, &response)
            requestCancel()
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("poll job %s: %w", jobID, err)
            }
            if status != httpOK {
                return fmt.Errorf("poll job %s status=%d", jobID, status)
            }
            current := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(response.Status))
            if current == "" {
                current = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(response.State))
            }
            fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fleetctl: job=%s status=%s\n", jobID, current)
            switch current {
            case "SUCCEEDED":
                return nil
            case "COMPLETED":
                return fmt.Errorf("job %s returned ambiguous COMPLETED status; expected SUCCEEDED", jobID)
            case "FAILED", "CANCELLED":
                return fmt.Errorf("job %s ended %s", jobID, current)
            }

        root=json.loads(db.execute("select request_json from jobs where job_id='job_5c19e077b0482db2'").fetchone()[0])
        plan=json.loads(root['compiled_render_plan_json'])
        runtime=root.get('runtime_assets',[])
        by_id={a.get('asset_id'):a for a in runtime if a.get('asset_id')}
        stock_ids={aid for aid,a in by_id.items() if a.get('role')=='stock'}
        static_ids=set()
        for track in plan['video_tracks']:
            updated=[]
            for old in track['segments']:
                item=by_id.get(old.get('asset_id'),{})
                if item.get('role')=='stock':
                    updated.append({
                        'segment_id':old['segment_id'],'stock_pool_slot':True,'asset_id':'','sha256':'',
                        'timeline_start_frame':old['timeline_start_frame'],'frame_count':old['frame_count'],
                        'source_in_us':0,'source_duration_us':0,
                    })
                else:
                    updated.append(old); static_ids.add(old.get('asset_id'))
            track['segments']=updated
        static_ids.add(plan['final_audio']['asset_id'])
        plan['assets']=[a for a in plan['assets'] if a['asset_id'] in static_ids]
        plan['assets'].sort(key=lambda a:a['asset_id'])
        # The plan's own order is the V2 struct order; preserve its exact object field order.
        plan['stock_pool']={'source_kind':'drive','drive_folder_id':folder,'selection':'shuffle'}
        ordered_plan={k:plan[k] for k in ('plan_version','timeline_revision','timeline_sha256','duration_us','output','final_audio','video_tracks','stock_pool','assets')}
        plan_json=json.dumps(ordered_plan,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)
        kept=[a for a in runtime if a.get('role')!='stock']
        payload={

         'compiled_render_plan_json':plan_json,

         'runtime_assets':kept,
         'runtime_payload':root.get('runtime_payload',{}),
        }
        out=pathlib.Path('.tmp-stockpool-job.json')

        print('payload',out,'bytes',out.stat().st_size)

    package main
    
    import (
    	"encoding/json"
    	"fmt"
    	"os"
    
    	"velox-shared/contract"
    )
    
    func main() {
    	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
    	if err != nil { panic(err) }
    	var payload map[string]any
    	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &payload); err != nil { panic(err) }
    	raw := []byte(payload[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string))
    	plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2(raw)
    	if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err); os.Exit(1) }
    	fmt.Printf("canonical plan ok: %d assets, %d segments, stock_pool=%t\n", len(plan.Assets), len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments), plan.StockPool != nil)
    }

    //
    // SmokeRunHealthChecker implements BackendSmokeRunner by reading the
    // LATEST smoke run from the smoke_runs analytics table. It does NOT
    // trigger a new smoke — the on-demand POST /api/v1/admin/workers/
    // {id}/smoke endpoint drives new smoke runs via the FleetController

    // FreshSmokeRunner adapts the real Level-D operation executor to the update
    // pipeline. It always executes a new smoke operation before reading its
    // durable result; an older smoke can never satisfy a post-update gate.
    type FreshSmokeRunner struct {
        executor OperationExecutor
        runs     BackendSmokeRuns
        assetID  string
    }
    
    // NewFreshSmokeRunnerWithAsset binds the production smoke gate to an
    // operator-configured READY asset; production wiring must provide
    // VELOX_SMOKE_ASSET_ID.
    func NewFreshSmokeRunnerWithAsset(executor OperationExecutor, runs BackendSmokeRuns, assetID string) *FreshSmokeRunner {
        return &FreshSmokeRunner{executor: executor, runs: runs, assetID: strings.TrimSpace(assetID)}
    }
    
    func (r *FreshSmokeRunner) RunLevelD(ctx context.Context, workerID string) (string, error) {
        if r == nil || r.executor == nil || r.runs == nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("fresh smoke runner: real executor not wired")
        }
        payload, err := json.Marshal(SmokePayload{AssetID: smokeAssetID(r.assetID), Reason: "worker update Level D smoke gate"})
        if err != nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("fresh smoke payload: %w", err)
        }
        op := &store.Operation{
            OperationID: fmt.Sprintf("update-smoke-%s-%d", workerID, time.Now().UnixNano()),
            WorkerID:    workerID, Op: OperationKindSmoke, RequestedBy: "update-executor",
            Reason: "worker update Level D smoke gate", Payload: payload,
            Status: store.OperationStatusRunning, QueuedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
        }
        if err := r.executor.Execute(ctx, op); err != nil {
            return "", err
        }
        return NewSmokeRunHealthChecker(r.runs).RunLevelD(ctx, workerID)
    }
    
    // SmokeRunHealthChecker reads the latest smoke run for a worker from
    // the smoke_runs table and surfaces it as a BackendSmokeRunner so
    // ProbeLevelD can report the real status.
    type SmokeRunHealthChecker struct {
        runs BackendSmokeRuns
    }
    
    // Compile-time assertion: SmokeRunHealthChecker satisfies BackendSmokeRunner.
    var _ BackendSmokeRunner = (*SmokeRunHealthChecker)(nil)
    
    // NewSmokeRunHealthChecker returns a ready-to-use checker.
    func NewSmokeRunHealthChecker(runs BackendSmokeRuns) *SmokeRunHealthChecker {
        return &SmokeRunHealthChecker{runs: runs}
    }

    func (s *AssetService) ResolveExternalSource(ctx context.Context, assetID string) (*Source, error) {
        if s == nil || s.repo == nil || s.registry == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("asset external source resolution unavailable")
        }
        assetID = strings.TrimSpace(assetID)
        asset, err := s.Get(ctx, assetID)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        if asset == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("asset %s not found", assetID)
        }
        if asset.Status != AssetStatusReady {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("asset %s is not READY", assetID)
        }
        reader, ok := s.repo.(assetSourceReader)

        }

    func (s *AssetService) ResolveDeferredDriveSource(ctx context.Context, fileID string) (*Source, error) {
        if s == nil || s.registry == nil {

        deferred, err := assetref.NewDeferredDrive(strings.TrimSpace(fileID))
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid deferred Drive asset: %w", err)
        }
        reference := "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + url.QueryEscape(deferred.ID())
        if !s.registry.SupportsReference(reference) {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("Drive resolver unavailable")
        }
        resolved, err := s.registry.ResolveByInference(ctx, reference)

            return nil, fmt.Errorf("deferred Drive asset %s unavailable: %w", deferred.ID(), err)
        }

    // registry facts before they are streamed to a worker. Resolver downloads are
    // staged in seekable temporary files, so the verification pass can rewind the

        if source == nil || source.Reader == nil || asset == nil {

        seeker, ok := source.Reader.(io.Seeker)
        if !ok {

        }

    }

    const canonicalDriveSliceExecutor = "video.assemble.slice.v1@1"
    
    func normalizeSceneVideoPayload(payloadMap map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
        return normalizeSceneVideoPayloadContext(context.Background(), payloadMap)
    }
    
    // normalizeSceneVideoPayloadContext validates and wraps producer-owned V2
    // bytes. It deliberately has no scene, overlay, media, or manifest compiler.
    func normalizeSceneVideoPayloadContext(ctx context.Context, payloadMap map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
        if payloadMap == nil {
            return nil, errors.New("compiled_render_plan_v2: payload is required")
        }
        for _, key := range []string{"scenes", "scenes_json", "render_manifest", "manifest_ref", "layers", "overlays", "visual_replacements", "items", "clips", "images", "voiceover_paths", "voiceover_path", "audio_path"} {
            if _, exists := payloadMap[key]; exists {
                return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationError(key, "is retired; submit the producer-compiled CompiledRenderPlanV2")
            }
        }
        base, err := contract.NewJobPayloadV2Checked(payloadMap)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        if err := contract.ValidateCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(payloadMap); err != nil {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationErrorWrapped("compiled_render_plan_v2", "producer plan validation failed", err)
        }
        if !compiledRenderPlanV2Present(payloadMap) {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationError("compiled_render_plan_v2", "producer-compiled plan and SHA are required")
        }
        base.VideoName = strings.TrimSpace(base.VideoName)
        if base.VideoName == "" {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationError("video_name", "is required")
        }
        base.ScriptText = strings.TrimSpace(base.ScriptText)
        if base.ScriptText == "" {
            base.ScriptText = base.VideoName
        }
        base.SetIdentity(base.JobID, base.JobRunID, base.CorrelationID)
        base.Version = "v2"
        base.Status = contract.InputAssemblyPending
        base.JobFingerprint = sceneVideoFingerprintContext(ctx, base.JobID, base.VideoName, base.ScriptText, base.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256)
    
        out, err := base.ToMap()
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        // These fields are control-plane or runtime binding metadata. Preserve
        // them without interpreting or modifying the compiled timeline.
        for key, value := range payloadMap {
            if strings.HasPrefix(key, "runtime_") || key == "publications" || key == "assembly" ||
                key == "_internal_forwarding_key" || key == "_placement_pin_worker_id" ||
                key == "source_provider" || key == "source_job_id" || key == "target_executor_id" || key == "delivery_plan" || key == "render_only" {
                if key == "_placement_pin_worker_id" {
                    if pin, ok := value.(string); ok {
                        value = strings.TrimSpace(pin)
                    }
                }
                out[key] = value
            }
        }
        if err := contract.ValidateCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(out); err != nil {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationErrorWrapped("compiled_render_plan_v2", "normalized plan validation failed", err)
        }
        return out, nil
    }
    
    func compiledRenderPlanV2Present(payloadMap map[string]interface{}) bool {
        if payloadMap == nil {
            return false
        }
        _, hasJSON := payloadMap[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON]
        _, hasSHA := payloadMap[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanSHA]
        return hasJSON || hasSHA
    }
    
    func resolveInternalExecutorID(payloadMap map[string]interface{}) string {
        if !compiledRenderPlanV2Present(payloadMap) {
            return ""
        }
        // Final-job Producers may keep the immutable compiled plan free of
        // transport locators and attach Drive file IDs in runtime_assets instead.
        // Join those locators by the stable asset_id before selecting the executor;
        // otherwise stock-sha256-* assets are misrouted to the copy-only executor.
        runtimeDriveIDs := runtimeDriveFileIDs(payloadMap["runtime_assets"])
        if raw, ok := payloadMap[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string); ok {
            var plan struct {
                StockPool *contract.StockPoolV2 `json:"stock_pool"`
                Assets    []struct {
                    SourceKind  string `json:"source_kind"`
                    DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
                    AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
                    AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
                    Kind        string `json:"kind"`
                } `json:"assets"`
            }
            if json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &plan) == nil {
                if plan.StockPool != nil {
                    return canonicalDriveSliceExecutor
                }
                for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
                    driveFileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
                    if driveFileID == "" {
                        driveFileID = runtimeDriveIDs[strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)]
                    }
                    if driveFileID == "" {
                        driveFileID = runtimeDriveIDs[strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetKey)]
                    }
                    if asset.Kind == "video" && (asset.SourceKind == "drive" || driveFileID != "" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:")) {
                        return canonicalDriveSliceExecutor
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return canonicalCompiledPlanExecutor
    }
    
    func runtimeDriveFileIDs(raw interface{}) map[string]string {
        encoded, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || string(encoded) == "null" {
            return nil
        }
        var assets []struct {
            AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
            AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
            DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
        }
        if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &assets); err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        byIdentity := make(map[string]string, len(assets)*2)
        for _, asset := range assets {
            fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
            if fileID == "" {
                continue
            }
            for _, identity := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
                if identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity); identity != "" {
                    byIdentity[identity] = fileID
                }
            }
        }
        return byIdentity
    }
    
    func resolveRequiredCapabilities(executorID string) []string {
        if strings.HasPrefix(executorID, "video.assemble.copy.v1") || strings.HasPrefix(executorID, "video.assemble.slice.v1") {
            return []string{"artifact.commit.v1"}
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func sceneVideoFingerprintContext(ctx context.Context, parts ...interface{}) string {
        h := sha256.New()
        for _, part := range parts {
            switch value := part.(type) {
            case string:
                if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value); trimmed != "" {
                    h.Write([]byte(trimmed))
                }
            default:
                if part == nil {
                    continue
                }
                telemetry.RecordEnqueueJSONMarshal(ctx)
                if data, err := json.Marshal(part); err == nil {
                    h.Write(data)
                }
            }
            h.Write([]byte{0})
        }
        return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))[:32]
    }

    package pipeline
    
    import (
        "velox-shared/contract/assembly"
        "velox-shared/contract/deliveryplan"
