    // ExternalAPISourceProvider is the stable source-provider identity for POST /api/v1/jobs.
    const ExternalAPISourceProvider = "external_api"
    
    // JobSubmitTargetExecutorID is the sole worker executor for compiled V2
    // video plans. The Master validates and routes the plan; it does not render.
    const JobSubmitTargetExecutorID = "video.assemble.copy.v1"
    
    func (h *Handlers) NormalizeExternalJobSubmission(req SubmitJobRequest) *CanonicalCompletedPayload {
        rawPayload := submitRequestToRawPayload(&req)
        workerPayload, err := projectWorkerPayload(&req)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
    
        var assemblyJob *assembly.AssemblyJobV1
        if req.Assembly != nil {
            assemblyJob, _ = req.Assembly.Normalize(req.IdempotencyKey)
        }
        targetExecutorID := targetExecutorForJobType(req.JobType)
        deliveryEnvelope := deliveryplan.ExtractEnvelope(rawPayload)
        if req.RenderOnly {
            // Render-only jobs have no external delivery route. Keep only the
            // opt-out marker in the control-plane envelope, even if a legacy or
            // defaulted intake DTO carried an empty delivery-plan entry.
            deliveryEnvelope = map[string]interface{}{"render_only": true}
        }
        return &CanonicalCompletedPayload{
            SourceProvider:   ExternalAPISourceProvider,
            SourceJobID:      req.IdempotencyKey,
            TargetExecutorID: targetExecutorID,
            WorkerPayload:    workerPayload,
            DeliveryPlan:     deliveryEnvelope,
            PublicationSpecs: projectPublicationSpecs(req.Publications),
            Assembly:         assemblyJob,
            StatusDomains:    inputAssemblyStatusDomain(workerPayload),
        }
    }
    
    func targetExecutorForJobType(jobType string) string {
        // Recipe names are decoupled from worker executor IDs. Every admitted
        // video request is normalized to CompiledRenderPlanV2 before dispatch.
        _ = jobType
        return JobSubmitTargetExecutorID
    }
    
    // projectPublicationSpecs converts intake DTOs into the canonical control-plane
    // contract. These specs are retained on CanonicalCompletedPayload and are never
    // merged into WorkerPayload: the renderer only needs render inputs, while the
    // delivery pipeline owns publication metadata and destinations.
    func projectPublicationSpecs(publications []SubmitPublication) []publication.Spec {
        if len(publications) == 0 {
            return nil
        }
        specs := make([]publication.Spec, 0, len(publications))
        for _, input := range publications {
            spec := submitPublicationToSharedSpec(input)
            if normalized, err := spec.Normalize(); err == nil {
                spec = normalized
            }
            specs = append(specs, spec)
        }
        return specs
    }

    // manifest-reference regexes, structured validation error, and

    // intake_types.go so the wire contract stays separate from its rules.
    //
    // All bool-returned validation paths return FALSE on the happy path so
    // handlers can write `if verr, bad := …; bad { ... }`. Cross-field failures
    // are aggregated into a single 4xx envelope so a client can correct them
    // in one round trip.
    //
    // Caller in this package: job_submit.go (thin composer).
    package pipeline
    
    import (
        "fmt"
        "strings"
    
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    )
    
    // ValidateSubmitJobRequest is the canonical programmatically-invoked
    // validator for SubmitJobRequest. It runs AFTER the strict JSON decoder
    // has populated the struct, so every field is present (or zero-value)
    // by the time this runs. It is the single source of truth for the
    // [P1] OpenAPI-aligned cross-field constraints; the OpenAPI Python
    // validator script confirms the same set of constraints at the spec
    // level.
    //
    // The function accumulates ALL field-level violations into a single
    // SubmitJobValidationError so the client can correct them in one round
    // trip ("fix these 4 fields and resubmit") rather than learning about
    // them one at a time across multiple requests.
    //
    // All bool-returned-from-validation paths return false on the happy
    // path so the handler can write `if verr, bad := …; bad { ... }`.
    //
    // ValidateIdempotencyKey runs separately at the byte level (it is
    // invoked BEFORE this helper at the handler level so a cheap byte-level
    // rejected request never has its body fully traversed here).
    func ValidateSubmitJobRequest(req SubmitJobRequest) (*SubmitJobValidationError, bool) {
        var details []gin.H
    
        // VideoName byte-length cap. Trimmed to match canonical identity-
        // field trim policy in submitRequestToRawPayload (TrimSpace).
        if v := strings.TrimSpace(req.VideoName); len(v) > MaxVideoNameBytes {
            details = append(details, gin.H{
                "path":     "video_name",
                "issue":    "max_length",
                "max":      MaxVideoNameBytes,
                "observed": len(v),
            })
        }
    
        // Every admitted video submission must be a producer-compiled V2 plan.
        // Scene arrays and manifest_ref are legacy authoring inputs; the Master no
        // longer rebuilds a timeline or downloads a manifest on the dispatch path.
        if !hasCompiledRenderPlan(req) {
            details = append(details, gin.H{"path": "compiled_render_plan_json", "issue": "required_v2_plan"})
        }
        if len(req.Scenes) > 0 {
            details = append(details, gin.H{
                "path":  "scenes",
                "issue": "legacy_scene_input_removed",
            })
        }
        if req.ManifestRef != nil {
            details = append(details, gin.H{"path": "manifest_ref", "issue": "legacy_manifest_input_removed; submit compiled_render_plan_json and compiled_render_plan_sha256"})
        }
        if len(req.Layers) > 0 || len(req.Overlays) > 0 || len(req.VisualReplacements) > 0 {
            details = append(details, gin.H{"path": "layers/overlays/visual_replacements", "issue": "include all visuals in the producer-compiled V2 plan"})
        }
        details = append(details, validateSubmitOverlays(req.Overlays)...)
        details = append(details, validateSubmitOverlayClipCollisions(req)...)
    
        details = append(details, validateSubmitDelivery(req)...)
    
        // Publications are validated against the shared canonical contract.
        // This remains separate from the renderer payload and adds the
        // request-level uniqueness/provider-options checks that the shared
        // package cannot know about.
        details = append(details, validateSubmitPublications(req.Publications)...)
    
        details = append(details, validateSubmitCompiledPlan(req)...)
    
        if len(details) == 0 {
            return nil, false
        }
    
        return &SubmitJobValidationError{
            Code:    "invalid_payload",
            Reason:  "validation_failed",
            Message: fmt.Sprintf("request body has %d validation failure(s) (see details)", len(details)),
            Details: details,
        }, true
    }
    
    func hasCompiledRenderPlan(req SubmitJobRequest) bool {
        return strings.TrimSpace(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(req.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256) != ""
    }
    
    func validateSubmitCompiledPlan(req SubmitJobRequest) []gin.H {
        jsonPresent := strings.TrimSpace(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON) != ""
        shaPresent := strings.TrimSpace(req.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256) != ""
        if !jsonPresent && !shaPresent {
            return nil
        }
    
        var details []gin.H
        if !jsonPresent {
            details = append(details, gin.H{
                "path":  "compiled_render_plan_json",
                "issue": "required_with_compiled_render_plan_sha256",
            })
        }
        if !shaPresent {
            details = append(details, gin.H{
                "path":  "compiled_render_plan_sha256",
                "issue": "required_with_compiled_render_plan_json",
            })
        } else if !manifestRefSHA256Regexp.MatchString(strings.TrimSpace(req.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256)) {
            details = append(details, gin.H{
                "path":     "compiled_render_plan_sha256",
                "issue":    "malformed",
                "observed": req.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256,
                "expected": "64 lowercase hex characters ([0-9a-f]{64})",
            })
        }
        return details
    }
    
    // SubmitJob handles POST /api/v1/jobs.
    //
    // This is the simplified, external-friendly entry point for job
    // submission. It converts the flat request into the Creator-push
    // format and delegates to the same resolver machinery.
    //
    // The identity tuple is derived from the idempotency_key with stable
    // cardinality:
    //   - source_provider:    ExternalAPISourceProvider ("external_api")
    //   - source_job_id:      the (validated) idempotency_key
    //   - target_executor_id: JobSubmitTargetExecutorID ("video.assemble.copy.v1")
    //
    // Stable provider cardinality is a deliberate invariant: it lets
    // dashboards aggregate "all external_api jobs" without scanning
    // per-key labels, and keeps future M2M-auth client_ids additive
    // rather than redefining the provider dimension.
    //
    // Decoding strategy: the handler uses json.NewDecoder(...).Decode
    // with DisallowUnknownFields — NOT c.ShouldBindJSON. The strict
    // decoder rejects any field name not on the struct, so a typo'd
    // json blob (e.g. {"ideliverency_key": "...", ...}) fails with 400
    // invalid_json BEFORE we touch downstream code. Gin's binding tag
    // machinery is permissive for cross-field validation and silently
    // accepts unknown fields, which is the wrong default for an
    // external-API surface.

    // intakeProjectLabel picks a bounded operator-facing project label from the
    // request or its renderer projection. The quoted log field safely escapes
    // control characters; truncation keeps unusually large user input bounded.
    func intakeProjectLabel(req SubmitJobRequest, payload map[string]interface{}) string {
        for _, fields := range []map[string]interface{}{req.Spec, req.RuntimePayload, payload} {
            for _, key := range []string{"project", "project_name", "project_id"} {
                if value, ok := fields[key].(string); ok {
                    value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
                    if value != "" {
                        if len(value) > 96 {
                            value = value[:96]
                        }
                        return value
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ""
    }
    
    // reject builds a rejection envelope WITHOUT a `details` key. Use it where the
    // historical envelope omitted details entirely.
    func reject(status int, code, message string) intakeResponse {
        return intakeResponse{Status: status, Body: gin.H{
            "ok":      false,
            "error":   code,
            "message": message,
        }}
    }
    
    // rejectWithDetails builds a rejection envelope that ALWAYS carries the
    // `details` key — including `"details":null` when the source slice is nil —
    // so the wire shape stays byte-identical to the historical handler envelope.
    func rejectWithDetails(status int, code, message string, details any) intakeResponse {
        return intakeResponse{Status: status, Body: gin.H{
            "ok":      false,
            "error":   code,
            "message": message,
            "details": details,
        }}
    }

        canonical := (&Handlers{}).NormalizeExternalJobSubmission(req)
        if canonical == nil {

        }

            t.Fatalf("unexpected canonical identity: %#v", canonical)

    +func targetExecutorForRequest(req SubmitJobRequest) string {
    +	var plan struct {
    +		StockPool *struct {
    +			SourceKind   string `json:"source_kind"`
    +			DriveFolderID string `json:"drive_folder_id"`
    +			Selection    string `json:"selection"`
    +		} `json:"stock_pool"`
    +	}
    +	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimSpace(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON)), &plan) == nil &&
    +		plan.StockPool != nil &&
    +		strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(plan.StockPool.SourceKind), "drive") &&
    +		strings.TrimSpace(plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID) != "" &&
    +		strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(plan.StockPool.Selection), "shuffle") {
    +		return JobSubmitDriveStockPoolExecutorID
    +	}
    +	return targetExecutorForJobType(req.JobType)
    +}

## Assistant

Ho individuato un difetto concreto: il piano con `stock_pool` arrivava al Master, ma l’intake lo etichettava ancora come `video.assemble.copy.v1`; così il dispatch non poteva usare l’executor che risolve e prepara il pool. Sto correggendo la scelta dell’executor all’ingresso, poi ricostruisco il Master locale e sostituisco il job rimasto in attesa.

    // futureasset_reservations.go builds the desired reservation list from
    // candidates and handles reconciliation with the store.  It also owns
    // the post-send reservation state transitions (RESERVED → PLANNING).
    
    import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "strings"
        "time"
    
        "velox-server/internal/logging"
        "velox-server/internal/placement"
        "velox-server/internal/taskgraph"
        "velox-shared/contract/assembly"
        "velox-shared/futureasset"
    )
    
    // buildDesiredReservations iterates candidates and produces the desired
    // reservation list and job manifest list.  Existing ownership is sticky;
    // new reservations are acquired via TryReserveFutureTask only within the
    // prefetch horizon.
    func (h *Handler) buildDesiredReservations(
        ctx context.Context,
        workerID string,
        candidates []placement.TaskCandidate,
        owned map[string]taskgraph.FutureReservationWithPayload,
        reservedByOther map[string]struct{},
        snapshot placement.WorkerSnapshot,
        warmSnapshots []assembly.WorkerPlacementSnapshot,
        store taskgraph.FutureReservationStore,
        prefetchLimit int,
        protectionLimit int,
        skipCounts *prefetchSkipCounter,
        currentJobID string,
    ) (
        desired []taskgraph.FutureReservation,
        jobs []futureasset.Job,
    ) {
        // The job that triggered PREPARE/FINALIZE must win the first hard
        // reservation slot.  Without this ordering, an already-populated
        // prefetch horizon can include the new task only as a protection job
        // (reservation_id=""), which sends a plan but leaves the preparation gate
        // with no worker-affinity lease to advance or claim.
        candidates = prioritizeCurrentJobCandidates(candidates, currentJobID)
        desired = make([]taskgraph.FutureReservation, 0, prefetchLimit)
        jobs = make([]futureasset.Job, 0, protectionLimit)
    
        for _, candidate := range candidates {
            if len(jobs) >= protectionLimit {
                break
            }
            if _, blocked := reservedByOther[candidate.TaskID]; blocked {
                skipCounts.add(SkipReservedByOther)
                continue
            }
            if existing, exists := owned[candidate.TaskID]; exists {
                // Existing ownership is sticky until TTL/reconciliation, but its
                // payload is only the snapshot captured when PREPARE reserved it.
                // FINALIZE patches runtime_assets (including direct HTTPS locators)
                // on the task spec, so a refresh must read that current payload rather
                // than replaying the stale PREPARE snapshot to the worker.
                payload := latestFutureTaskPayload(ctx, store, candidate.TaskID, existing.Payload)
                reservation := existing.FutureReservation
                reservation.Distance = len(jobs) + 1
                // Keep the same reservation lineage while certifying the expanded
                // manifest against the revision placement will actually claim.
                reservation.TaskRevision = candidate.Revision
                desired = append(desired, reservation)
                jobs = append(jobs, futureasset.Job{
                    JobID:         existing.JobID,
                    TaskID:        existing.TaskID,
                    ReservationID: existing.ReservationID,
                    TaskRevision:  candidate.Revision,
                    Assets:        h.futureAssetManifestsWithCatalog(ctx, payload),
                })
                continue
            }
    
            payload, err := store.FutureTaskPayload(ctx, candidate.TaskID)
            if err != nil {
                skipCounts.add(SkipPayloadUnavailable)
                continue
            }
            assets := h.futureAssetManifestsWithCatalog(ctx, payload)
            candidateWarmSnapshots := warmSnapshots
            if candidate.Executor.Valid() {
                candidateWarmSnapshots = h.warmPlacementSnapshotsForExecutor(candidate.Executor)
            }
            decision, err := selectWarmPlacement(candidateWarmSnapshots, assets)
            // The task currently being dispatched is already owned by the normal
            // placement decision.  It must be allowed to establish its own
            // preparation reservation on that worker; applying warm-cache affinity
            // here can make every worker reject the same first job and strand it in
            // reservation_pending forever.  Cache affinity remains authoritative for
            // lookahead tasks.
            if candidate.JobID != currentJobID && (err != nil || decision.WorkerID != workerID) {
                skipCounts.add(SkipDifferentWarmWorker)
                continue
            }
            match := h.placementMatcher.Select(snapshot, []placement.TaskCandidate{candidate})
            if match.Candidate == nil {
                skipCounts.add(SkipPlacementRejected)
                continue
            }
            reservation := taskgraph.FutureReservation{
                TaskID:        candidate.TaskID,
                JobID:         candidate.JobID,
                WorkerID:      workerID,
                ReservationID: fmt.Sprintf("future:%s:%s", workerID, candidate.TaskID),
                TaskRevision:  candidate.Revision,
                Distance:      len(jobs) + 1,
                State:         taskgraph.ReservationReserved,
                ExpiresAt:     time.Now().UTC().Add(h.futureAssetPlanTTL()),
            }
            if len(jobs) < prefetchLimit {
                acquired, err := store.TryReserveFutureTask(ctx, reservation)
                if err != nil {
                    logGRPCf(ctx, logging.LevelError, logging.CodeGRPCPrefetchFailed,
                        "[PREFETCH] reserve worker=%s task=%s: %v", workerID, candidate.TaskID, err)
                    continue
                }
                if !acquired {
                    skipCounts.add(SkipReservationConflict)
                    continue
                }
                logGRPCf(ctx, logging.LevelInfo, logging.CodeGRPCPrefetch,
                    "[PREFETCH_TIMING] event=reservation_created worker=%s task=%s at=%s",
                    workerID, candidate.TaskID, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
                h.persistReservationCreated(ctx, candidate.JobID, workerID, candidate.TaskID, reservation.ReservationID, reservation.Distance)
            } else {
                // N+4..N+10 are retention forecasts only — no hard reservation.
                reservation.ReservationID = ""
            }
            if reservation.ReservationID != "" {
                desired = append(desired, reservation)
            }
            jobs = append(jobs, futureasset.Job{
                JobID:         candidate.JobID,
                TaskID:        candidate.TaskID,
                ReservationID: reservation.ReservationID,
                TaskRevision:  candidate.Revision,
                Assets:        assets,
            })
        }
        return desired, jobs
    }
    
    func prioritizeCurrentJobCandidates(candidates []placement.TaskCandidate, currentJobID string) []placement.TaskCandidate {
        if currentJobID == "" || len(candidates) < 2 {
            return candidates
        }
        prioritized := make([]placement.TaskCandidate, 0, len(candidates))
        rest := make([]placement.TaskCandidate, 0, len(candidates))
        for _, candidate := range candidates {
            if candidate.JobID == currentJobID {
                prioritized = append(prioritized, candidate)
                continue
            }
            rest = append(rest, candidate)
        }
        if len(prioritized) == 0 {
            return candidates
        }
        return append(prioritized, rest...)
    }
    
    // reconcileReservations persists the desired reservation list and returns
    // the post-reconciliation timestamp.
    func (h *Handler) reconcileReservations(
        ctx context.Context,
        workerID string,
        store taskgraph.FutureReservationStore,
        desired []taskgraph.FutureReservation,
    ) (time.Time, bool) {
        if err := store.ReconcileFutureReservations(ctx, workerID, desired); err != nil {
            logGRPCf(ctx, logging.LevelError, logging.CodeGRPCPrefetchFailed,
                "[PREFETCH] reconcile worker=%s: %v", workerID, err)
            return time.Time{}, false
        }
        return time.Now().UTC(), true
    }
    
    // updateReservationStates advances only freshly-created RESERVED reservations
    // to PLANNING after the plan has been sent. Existing PLANNING/PREPARING/
    // PREPARED reservations are deliberately left untouched: a refresh is not a
    // lifecycle reset and must never downgrade already-prepared evidence.
    func (h *Handler) updateReservationStates(
        ctx context.Context,
        store taskgraph.FutureReservationStore,
        desired []taskgraph.FutureReservation,
    ) {
        for _, r := range desired {
            if r.ReservationID == "" {
                continue
            }
            if r.State != "" && r.State != taskgraph.ReservationReserved {
                continue
            }
            _ = store.UpdateReservationState(ctx, r.ReservationID, taskgraph.ReservationPlanning)
        }
    }
    
    // latestFutureTaskPayload refreshes the snapshot held by a reservation after
    // PREPARE/FINALIZE payload patches. The fallback preserves legacy callers if
    // the task payload lookup is temporarily unavailable.
    func latestFutureTaskPayload(ctx context.Context, store taskgraph.FutureReservationStore, taskID string, fallback []byte) []byte {
        if store == nil || strings.TrimSpace(taskID) == "" {
            return fallback
        }
        if latest, err := store.FutureTaskPayload(ctx, taskID); err == nil && len(latest) > 0 {
            return latest
        }
        return fallback
    }

    func candidateHasJob(candidates []placement.TaskCandidate, jobID string) bool {

    // PrefetchSubmittedJob is the low-latency submission hook. It resolves the

    func (h *Handler) PrefetchSubmittedJob(ctx context.Context, jobID string) {

            return

            if candidates[i].JobID == jobID {
                copyCandidate := candidates[i]
                candidate = &copyCandidate

        if candidate == nil {
            if loader, supported := h.taskRepo.(futureTaskCandidateLoader); supported {
                loaded, found, loadErr := loader.FutureTaskCandidateByJobID(ctx, jobID)
                if loadErr != nil {
                    logGRPCf(ctx, logging.LevelWarn, logging.CodeGRPCPrefetchFailed, "[PREFETCH] submission hook candidate job=%s: %v", jobID, loadErr)

                return

                    WorkerID:      decision.WorkerID,
                    ReservationID: "future:" + decision.WorkerID + ":" + candidate.TaskID,

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    # Compatibility launcher for the single typed fleetctl implementation.
    # Bash owns only binary/token/environment resolution; HTTP, parsing, polling,
    # operation IDs, terminal states, rollout and job semantics live in Go.
    set -euo pipefail
    
    ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    MASTER_URL="${VELOX_MASTER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}"
    MASTER_URL="${MASTER_URL%/}"
    
    usage() {
        cat <<'EOF'
    Usage:
      scripts/fleetctl <command> [args]
    
    The command is executed by the typed Go client. Supported commands include:
      status inspect drain resume quarantine restart update rollback operations
      wait-ready rollout smoke ssh-check job doctor
    
    Environment:
      VELOX_MASTER_URL   Master base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000)
      VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN  Admin bearer token
      TOKEN_FILE         File containing VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN=<value>
      FLEETCTL_GO_BIN    Go fleetctl binary override
    EOF
    }
    
    die() {
        printf 'fleetctl: %s\n' "$*" >&2
        exit 2
    }
    
    resolve_token() {
        if [[ -n "${VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
            printf '%s' "$VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN"
            return
        fi
        if [[ -n "${TOKEN_FILE:-}" && -r "$TOKEN_FILE" ]]; then
            local token
            token="$(sed -n 's/^VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN=//p' "$TOKEN_FILE" | head -n 1 \
                | tr -d '\r' | sed "s/^['\"]//; s/['\"]$//")"
            [[ -n "$token" ]] || die "TOKEN_FILE does not contain VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN"
            printf '%s' "$token"
            return
        fi
        die 'VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN or TOKEN_FILE is required'
    }
    
    resolve_go_fleetctl() {
        local candidate="${FLEETCTL_GO_BIN:-$ROOT/DataServer/bin/fleetctl}"
        [[ -x "$candidate" ]] || die "Go fleetctl binary not found: $candidate (set FLEETCTL_GO_BIN or build DataServer/cmd/fleetctl)"
        printf '%s' "$candidate"
    }
    
    if [[ $# -eq 0 || "${1:-}" == "help" || "${1:-}" == "--help" || "${1:-}" == "-h" ]]; then
        usage
        [[ $# -eq 0 ]] && exit 2 || exit 0
    fi
    
    binary="$(resolve_go_fleetctl)"
    export VELOX_MASTER_URL="$MASTER_URL"
    if [[ -z "${VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        export VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN="$(resolve_token)"
    fi
    exec "$binary" "$@" "--master=$MASTER_URL"

    // handlers_jobs.go — job diagnostics and production doctor handlers.
    package main
    
    import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "net/url"
        "os"
        "strings"
        "time"
    
        "velox-server/internal/jobs"
    )
    
    func runJob(client *fleetClient, args []string) int {
        if len(args) < 2 {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "job requires inspect, metrics, or watch plus a job_id"))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
        switch args[0] {
        case "submit":
            return runJobSubmit(client, args[1:], false)
        case "certify":
            return runJobSubmit(client, args[1:], true)
        case "cancel":
            return runJobCancel(client, args[1:])
        case "inspect":
            jobID, jsonOutput, waterfallOnly, err := parseJobInspectArgs(args[1:])
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "%v", err))
                return ExitMisuse
            }
            return runJobInspect(client, jobID, jsonOutput, waterfallOnly)
        case "metrics":
            jobID, _, err := parseJobReadArgs(args[1:], "metrics")
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "%v", err))
                return ExitMisuse
            }
            return runJobMetrics(client, jobID)
        case "watch":
            jobID, timeout, interval, jsonOutput, err := parseJobWatchArgs(args[1:])
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "%v", err))
                return ExitMisuse
            }
            return runJobWatchWithInterval(client, jobID, timeout, interval, jsonOutput)
        default:
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "unknown job command %q", args[0]))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
    }
    
    func runJobCancel(client *fleetClient, args []string) int {
        var jobID, reason string
        for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
            switch {
            case args[i] == "--reason":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "--reason requires a value"))
                    return ExitMisuse
                }
                i++
                reason = args[i]
            case strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "--reason="):
                reason = strings.TrimPrefix(args[i], "--reason=")
            case strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "--master=") || strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "--token-file=") || args[i] == "--verbose":
            case args[i] == "--master" || args[i] == "--token-file":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "%s requires a value", args[i]))
                    return ExitMisuse
                }
                i++
            case strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "-"):
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "unknown job cancel option %q", args[i]))
                return ExitMisuse
            default:
                if jobID != "" {
                    fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "job cancel accepts exactly one job_id"))
                    return ExitMisuse
                }
                jobID = args[i]
            }
        }
        if jobID == "" {

        }

        defer cancel()

        status, err := client.doJSON(ctx, "POST", "/api/v1/admin/jobs/"+url.PathEscape(jobID)+"/cancel", map[string]any{"reason": reason}, &response)
        if err != nil {

        }
        if status != httpOK {
            ec := MapHTTPStatusToOpExit(status)
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ec, "POST /api/v1/admin/jobs/%s/cancel status=%d", jobID, status))
            return ec
        }

        fmt.Println(string(encoded))

    func parseJobReadArgs(args []string, command string) (string, bool, error) {
        var jobID string
        jsonOutput := false
        for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
            switch {
            case args[i] == "--json":
                jsonOutput = true
            case strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "--master=") || strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "--token-file=") || args[i] == "--verbose":
            case args[i] == "--master" || args[i] == "--token-file":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return "", false, fmt.Errorf("%s requires a value", args[i])
                }
                i++
            case strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "-"):
                return "", false, fmt.Errorf("unknown job %s option %q", command, args[i])
            default:
                if jobID != "" {
                    return "", false, fmt.Errorf("job %s accepts exactly one job_id", command)
                }
                jobID = args[i]
            }
        }
        if jobID == "" {
            return "", false, fmt.Errorf("job %s requires a job_id", command)
        }
        if command == "metrics" && jsonOutput {
            return "", false, errors.New("job metrics does not support --json")
        }
        return jobID, jsonOutput, nil
    }

    func NewVideoAssembleSlice(outputRoot string, runner ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRunner) executor.Executor {
        if strings.TrimSpace(outputRoot) == "" {
            outputRoot = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "velox", "video-assemble-slice")
        }
        if runner == nil {
            runner = ffmpegrunner.NewProcessRunner()
        }
        return &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: ffprobeSliceMediaProber{}, outputRoot: outputRoot}
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Descriptor() executor.Descriptor {
        return executor.Descriptor{
            ID: VideoAssembleSliceID, Version: VideoAssembleSliceVersion,
            InputTypes: []string{"render.compiled.v2.drive"}, OutputTypes: []string{"video/mp4"},
            ResourceClass: executor.ResourceCPU, Deterministic: true, Cacheable: true,
            TemporalMode: executor.TemporalGlobal,
        }
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Validate(spec executor.TaskSpec) error {
        if spec.ExecutorID != VideoAssembleSliceID {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: executor_id must be %q", VideoAssembleSliceID)
        }
        if e == nil || e.runner == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFmpeg runner is not configured")
        }
        if e.prober == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFprobe media validation is not configured")
        }
        plan, err := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: invalid CompiledRenderPlanV2: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: canonical output profile required: %w", err)
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        hasDrive := plan.StockPool != nil
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
            driveSource := asset.Kind == "video" && isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs)
            hasDrive = hasDrive || driveSource
        }
        if !hasDrive {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: plan must contain at least one Drive video source")
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || (len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 && plan.StockPool == nil) {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: exactly one video track is required; segments or stock_pool must be supplied")
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            members := 0
            for _, item := range sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"]) {
                if item.StockPoolMember && strings.TrimSpace(item.DriveFileID) != "" {
                    members++
                }
            }
            if members == 0 {
                return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: Master did not resolve any stock_pool files")
            }
        }
        var nextFrame int64
        stockPoolSlots := 0
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            if segment.StockPoolSlot {
                if plan.StockPool == nil {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q has stock_pool_slot without stock_pool", segment.SegmentID)
                }
                stockPoolSlots++
                if segment.FrameCount <= 0 {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: stock pool slot %q has invalid frame count", segment.SegmentID)
                }
            } else {
                asset, ok := assets[segment.AssetID]
                if !ok || (asset.Kind != "video" && asset.Kind != "prepared_video_fragment") {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q must reference a video asset", segment.SegmentID)
                }
                if asset.ProfileID != plan.Output.ProfileID || asset.FrameCount <= 0 || !asset.FirstFrameKeyframe || !asset.ClosedGOP {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: asset %q is not certified for packet-copy assembly", segment.AssetID)
                }
                if segment.SourceInUS != 0 {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q starts at a non-keyframe offset (%d us); packet-copy is unsafe", segment.SegmentID, segment.SourceInUS)
                }
                if segment.FrameCount <= 0 || segment.FrameCount > asset.FrameCount {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q frame count %d exceeds certified source frames %d", segment.SegmentID, segment.FrameCount, asset.FrameCount)
                }
            }
            if segment.TimelineStartFrame != nextFrame {
                return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q leaves a timeline gap or overlap at frame %d", segment.SegmentID, nextFrame)
            }
            nextFrame += segment.FrameCount
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil && stockPoolSlots == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: stock_pool requires at least one stock slot")
        }
        framesNum := int64(plan.DurationUS) * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        framesDen := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        wantFrames := (framesNum + framesDen - 1) / framesDen
        if nextFrame != wantFrames {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: timeline has %d frames, plan duration requires %d", nextFrame, wantFrames)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Execute(ctx context.Context, execCtx executor.ExecutionContext, spec executor.TaskSpec) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
        started := time.Now().UTC()
        fail := func(code string, err error) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
            return executor.ExecutionResult{Status: "failed", ErrorCode: code, ErrorDetail: err.Error(), StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC()}, nil
        }
        if err := e.Validate(spec); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        plan, _ := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        bindings, ok := runtimeassets.FromContext(ctx)
        if !ok {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_MISSING", errors.New("verified runtime asset bindings are required"))
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            compiled, err := e.compileStockPoolPlan(ctx, spec, plan, bindings)
            if err != nil {
                return fail("DRIVE_STOCK_POOL_INCOMPATIBLE", err)
            }
            plan = compiled
        }
        if err := e.verifyCopyInputs(ctx, plan, bindings); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_COPY_INCOMPATIBLE", err)
        }
        audio, ok := bindings[plan.FinalAudio.AssetID]
        if !ok || !audio.Verified || audio.Size <= 0 || audio.SHA256 == "" || audio.SHA256 != plan.FinalAudio.SHA256 || audio.Size != plan.FinalAudio.SizeBytes {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", errors.New("final audio integrity binding does not match the plan"))
        }
        if info, statErr := os.Stat(audio.Path); statErr != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != audio.Size {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", errors.New("final audio local file identity is invalid"))
        }
        jobID, err := safeOutputJobID(spec.JobID)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("INVALID_JOB_ID", err)
        }
        outputPath := filepath.Join(e.outputRoot, jobID+".mp4")
        if resolver := storageResolverFromExecutionContext(execCtx); resolver != nil {
            if placement, placeErr := resolver.Place(storage.ArtifactStaging, jobID+".mp4", estimateOutputBytesFromDuration(plan.DurationUS)); placeErr == nil {
                outputPath = placement.Path
            }
        }
        if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(outputPath), 0o750); err != nil {
            return fail("OUTPUT_DIRECTORY", err)
        }
        // The concat manifest is the only temporary file. Video packets are copied
        // directly from the verified cache; this executor never invokes an encoder.
        workRoot := filepath.Dir(outputPath)
        if resolver := storageResolverFromExecutionContext(execCtx); resolver != nil {
            workRoot = resolver.Config().TempDir
        }
        if strings.TrimSpace(workRoot) == "" {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_STORAGE_INVALID", errors.New("disk-backed slice work directory is not configured"))
        }
        tempDir, err := os.MkdirTemp(workRoot, "drive-slice-copy-"+jobID+"-")
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_STORAGE_INVALID", err)
        }
        defer os.RemoveAll(tempDir)
        listPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "segments.ffconcat")
        if err := writeSliceConcatList(listPath, plan, bindings); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_STORAGE_INVALID", err)
        }
        args, err := sliceConcatMuxArgs(listPath, audio.Path, outputPath, plan)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", err)
        }
        metrics, renderErr := e.runner.Run(ctx, ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRequest{Operation: ffmpegrunner.OperationEncode, Args: args})
        if renderErr != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_COPY_FAILED", fmt.Errorf("stream-copy concat/mux: %w", renderErr))
        }
        if err := e.verifyFinalMedia(ctx, outputPath, plan); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        artifact, err := artifactFromFile("video/mp4", outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("FINAL_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        raw := rawMetricsFromFFmpegResult(metrics)
        raw.OutputBytes = artifact.SizeBytes
        raw.OutputFileSize = artifact.SizeBytes
        raw.OutputSha256 = artifact.Hash
        raw.EncodePasses = 0
        raw.ConcatMode = "stream_copy"
        raw.FinalConcatStreamCopy = true
        raw.MediaDurationSeconds = float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        raw.WallClockSeconds = float64(metrics.ProcessWallMS) / 1000
        return executor.ExecutionResult{
            Status: "succeeded", Outputs: []executor.ArtifactRef{artifact}, RawMetrics: raw,
            StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
        }, nil
    }
    
    type slicePoolMember struct {
        AssetID         string `json:"asset_id"`
        DriveFileID     string `json:"drive_file_id"`
        StockPoolMember bool   `json:"stock_pool_member"`
    }
    
    func sliceRuntimePoolMembers(raw interface{}) []slicePoolMember {
        data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        var members []slicePoolMember
        _ = json.Unmarshal(data, &members)
        return members
    }

    // resolveCompiledRenderPlanAssets is an adapter/orchestrator around the
    // existing common asset resolver. It deliberately does not download bytes or
    // write cache rows itself: resolveCommonAssetPayload owns that verified path.
    //
    // The synthetic payload exists only in memory so the common resolver can
    // consume the typed V2 references. Local paths returned by that resolver are
    // projected into runtimeassets.Bindings and never written back into the
    // canonical CompiledRenderPlanV2 JSON.
    func (w *Worker) resolveCompiledRenderPlanAssets(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) (runtimeassets.Bindings, error) {
        if payload == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: payload is required")
        }
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(payload)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: decode: %w", err)
        }
        if plan == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: %q is required", contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON)
        }
    
        // This structure is an adapter input, not a replacement plan. The
        // resolver understands the existing asset envelope and returns verified
        // worker-local paths for each uri. AssetKey is the canonical cache/transfer
        // identity when supplied; AssetID remains the stable plan/binding identity.
        planAssets := append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        // Folder members are a Master-resolved runtime snapshot, not editorial
        // per-file assignments in the immutable plan. Resolve them through the same
        // verified cache path as every other V2 asset.
        var runtimePool []struct {
            AssetID         string `json:"asset_id"`
            DriveFileID     string `json:"drive_file_id"`
            SizeBytes       int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
            StockPoolMember bool   `json:"stock_pool_member"`

            _ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &runtimePool)

        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            for _, item := range runtimePool {
                if !item.StockPoolMember || strings.TrimSpace(item.DriveFileID) == "" {
                    continue

                planAssets = append(planAssets, contract.AssetRefV2{
                    AssetID: "stockpool:" + item.DriveFileID, AssetKey: item.DriveFileID,
                    SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: item.DriveFileID,
                    Kind: "video", SizeBytes: item.SizeBytes,
                })

            identity := compiledAssetIdentity(asset)
            if identity == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: asset %q has no canonical identity", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if previous, exists := seenIdentities[identity]; exists && previous != asset.AssetID {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: assets %q and %q share canonical identity %q", previous, asset.AssetID, identity)

                    driveID = strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID[len("drive:"):])

    // futureAssetManifestsWithCatalog upgrades source-only Drive references with
    // identities learned from an earlier verified prefetch. The payload remains
    // authoritative when it already contains SHA-256 metadata.
    func (h *Handler) futureAssetManifestsWithCatalog(ctx context.Context, payload []byte) []futureasset.AssetManifest {
        assets := futureAssetManifests(payload)
        if h == nil || h.dbStore == nil {
            return assets
        }
        for i := range assets {
            if assets[i].SHA256 != "" || assets[i].AssetID == "" {
                continue
            }
            identity, found, err := h.dbStore.LookupAssetIdentity(ctx, assets[i].AssetID)
            if err != nil || !found {
                continue
            }
            assets[i].SHA256 = identity.SHA256
            assets[i].SizeBytes = identity.SizeBytes
        }
        return assets
    }
    
    // futureAssetManifests extracts all referenced asset manifests from a task
    // payload, walking nested JSON to collect {asset_key, sha256, size_bytes}
    // triples. The returned list is sorted deterministically by AssetKey for
    // stable placement decisions and cache comparisons.
    func futureAssetManifests(payload []byte) []futureasset.AssetManifest {
        var root interface{}
        if len(payload) == 0 || json.Unmarshal(payload, &root) != nil {
            return nil
        }
        if object, ok := root.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
            if pending, _ := object["runtime_assets_pending"].(bool); pending {
                return nil
            }
        }
        seen := make(map[string]futureasset.AssetManifest)
        sourceURIs, planAssetKeys := futureAssetRuntimeBindings(root)
        var walk func(interface{})
        walk = func(value interface{}) {
            switch node := value.(type) {
            case []interface{}:
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            case map[string]interface{}:
                if rawPlan, ok := node[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string); ok {
                    appendCompiledPlanAssetManifests(rawPlan, seen, sourceURIs)
                }
                // The canonical worker payload persists typed scenes in
                // scenes_json.  Keep manifest discovery recursive across that
                // boundary: otherwise stock assets survive in the task payload but
                // disappear from the future plan and are downloaded at runtime.
                if rawScenes, ok := node["scenes_json"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(rawScenes) != "" {
                    var scenes interface{}
                    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(rawScenes), &scenes); err == nil {
                        walk(scenes)
                    }
                }
                key, _ := node["asset_key"].(string)
                assetID, _ := node["asset_id"].(string)
                if assetID == "" {
                    assetID, _ = node["drive_file_id"].(string)
                }
                rawURL, _ := node["url"].(string)
                if strings.TrimSpace(rawURL) == "" {
                    rawURL, _ = node["drive_link"].(string)
                }
                if assetID == "" {
                    if driveID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFileID(rawURL); err == nil {
                        assetID = driveID.String()
                    }
                }
                sha, _ := node["sha256"].(string)
                if sha == "" {
                    sha, _ = node["asset_sha256"].(string)
                }
                var size int64
                switch n := node["size_bytes"].(type) {
                case float64:
                    size = int64(n)
                case int64:
                    size = n
                }
                if key == "" {
                    key = planAssetKeys[assetID]
                }
                if key == "" {
                    key = assetID
                }
                sourceURI, _ := node["source_uri"].(string)
                if sourceURI == "" && (strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)), "https://") || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)), "http://")) {
                    sourceURI = strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)
                }
                if sourceURI == "" {
                    if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)), "velox-drive://") {
                        sourceURI = "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + strings.TrimSpace(rawURL[len("velox-drive://"):])
                    } else if driveID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFileID(rawURL); err == nil {
                        sourceURI = "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + driveID.String()
                    }
                }
                // Producers may provide Drive's human-facing /file/d/.../view
                // locator in source_uri. FutureAssetPlan must carry a byte endpoint;
                // otherwise the worker receives HTML and can never certify the asset.
                if sourceURI != "" {
                    sourceURI = paths.NormalizeDriveURL(sourceURI)
                }
                if key != "" && assetID == "" {
                    assetID = key
                }
                // A deferred Drive manifest is intentionally not content-addressed
                // yet: the worker owns the direct Drive transfer and computes the
                // immutable SHA-256 before PREPARED. It is admitted only with a
                // trusted source locator and a positive Drive-reported size.
                complete := sha != "" && size > 0
                deferred := sourceURI != "" && assetID != "" && size > 0
                if key != "" && (complete || deferred) {
                    role, _ := node["role"].(string)
                    seen[key] = futureasset.AssetManifest{AssetKey: key, AssetID: assetID, SHA256: sha, SizeBytes: size, Role: role, SourceURI: sourceURI}
                }
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            }
        }
        walk(root)
        out := make([]futureasset.AssetManifest, 0, len(seen))
        for _, asset := range seen {
            out = append(out, asset)
        }
        sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
            return out[i].AssetKey < out[j].AssetKey
        })
        return out
    }
    
    // futureAssetRuntimeBindings joins FINALIZE's direct byte locators to the
    // producer-compiled plan by asset_id. The plan intentionally carries only
    // immutable identity; worker-only source URIs remain in runtime_assets.
    func futureAssetRuntimeBindings(root interface{}) (map[string]string, map[string]string) {
        sourceURIs := make(map[string]string)
        planAssetKeys := make(map[string]string)
        var walk func(interface{})
        walk = func(value interface{}) {
            switch node := value.(type) {
            case []interface{}:
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            case map[string]interface{}:
                if rawPlan, ok := node[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string); ok {
                    if plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(rawPlan)); err == nil && plan != nil {
                        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
                            key := asset.AssetKey
                            if key == "" {
                                key = asset.AssetID
                            }
                            if asset.AssetID != "" && key != "" {
                                planAssetKeys[asset.AssetID] = key
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if runtimeAssets, ok := node["runtime_assets"].([]interface{}); ok {
                    for _, raw := range runtimeAssets {
                        asset, ok := raw.(map[string]interface{})
                        if !ok {
                            continue
                        }
                        id, _ := asset["asset_id"].(string)
                        uri, _ := asset["source_uri"].(string)
                        if strings.TrimSpace(uri) == "" {
                            uri, _ = asset["url"].(string)
                            lowerURI := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(uri))
                            if !strings.HasPrefix(lowerURI, "https://") && !strings.HasPrefix(lowerURI, "http://") {
                                uri = ""
                            }
                        }
                        if strings.TrimSpace(id) != "" && strings.TrimSpace(uri) != "" {
                            sourceURIs[strings.TrimSpace(id)] = strings.TrimSpace(uri)
                        }
                    }
                }
                for _, child := range node {
                    walk(child)
                }
            }
        }
        walk(root)
        return sourceURIs, planAssetKeys
    }

    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) compileStockPoolPlan(ctx context.Context, spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        if plan.StockPool == nil || plan.StockPool.Selection != "shuffle" {
            return nil, errors.New("unsupported stock_pool selection")
        }
        members := sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        ordered := make([]slicePoolMember, 0, len(members))
        for _, member := range members {
            if member.StockPoolMember {
                ordered = append(ordered, member)
            }
        }
        if len(ordered) == 0 {
            return nil, errors.New("stock_pool has no resolved video files")
        }
        sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].DriveFileID < ordered[j].DriveFileID })
        probes := make(map[string]publisher.MediaProbe, len(ordered))
        var baseline *publisher.MediaProbe
        // Validate the complete folder snapshot before selecting any clips. A
        // mixed/incompatible pool fails the job without starting ffmpeg.
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            binding, ok := bindings[assetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || binding.Size <= 0 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q has no verified worker cache binding", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("probe stock source %q: %w", member.DriveFileID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height || probe.VideoFPSNum != plan.Output.FPSNum || probe.VideoFPSDen != plan.Output.FPSDen || probe.VideoPixelFormat != plan.Output.PixelFormat || probe.VideoFrameCount <= 0 || probe.VideoExtradataHash == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q is incompatible with packet-copy output; refusing to transcode", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            if err := verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx, binding.Path); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q cannot be concatenated safely: %w", member.DriveFileID, err)
            }
            if baseline == nil {
                cp := probe
                baseline = &cp
            } else if !sameSliceCopySignature(*baseline, probe) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q codec parameters differ; refusing to transcode", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            probes[member.DriveFileID] = probe
        }
        seedBytes := sha256.Sum256([]byte(spec.JobID + ":" + plan.TimelineSHA256 + ":" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID))
        rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(seedBytes[:8]))))
        rng.Shuffle(len(ordered), func(i, j int) { ordered[i], ordered[j] = ordered[j], ordered[i] })
        compiled := *plan
        compiled.StockPool = nil
        compiled.Assets = append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        compiled.VideoTracks = append([]contract.VideoTrackV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks...)
        for i := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            compiled.VideoTracks[i].Segments = append([]contract.VideoSegmentV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks[i].Segments...)
        }
        assetByID := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(ordered))
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            binding := bindings[assetID]
            probe := probes[member.DriveFileID]
            assetByID[assetID] = contract.AssetRefV2{AssetID: assetID, AssetKey: member.DriveFileID, SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: member.DriveFileID, SHA256: binding.SHA256, SizeBytes: binding.Size, Kind: "video", ProfileID: plan.Output.ProfileID, FrameCount: probe.VideoFrameCount, FirstFrameKeyframe: true, ClosedGOP: true, DurationUS: int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000), Width: probe.Width, Height: probe.Height}
            compiled.Assets = append(compiled.Assets, assetByID[assetID])
        }
        poolCursor := 0
        for trackIndex := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            segments := make([]contract.VideoSegmentV2, 0, len(compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments))
            for _, segment := range compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments {
                if segment.StockPoolSlot {
                    remaining, timelineFrame := segment.FrameCount, segment.TimelineStartFrame
                    part := 0
                    for remaining > 0 {
                        member := ordered[poolCursor%len(ordered)]
                        poolCursor++
                        part++
                        assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
                        asset := assetByID[assetID]
                        count := probes[member.DriveFileID].VideoFrameCount
                        if count > remaining {
                            count = remaining
                        }
                        segments = append(segments, contract.VideoSegmentV2{SegmentID: fmt.Sprintf("%s-source-%03d", segment.SegmentID, part), AssetID: assetID, SHA256: asset.SHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FrameCount: count, SourceDurationUS: count * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)})
                        remaining -= count
                        timelineFrame += count
                    }
                    continue
                }
                segments = append(segments, segment)
            }
            compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments = segments
        }

    }
    
    func verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
        cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "packet=flags", "-read_intervals", "%+#1", "-of", "csv=p=0", path)
        out, err := cmd.Output()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("ffprobe first packet: %w", err)
        }
        if !strings.Contains(string(out), "K") {
            return errors.New("first video packet is not a keyframe")
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyCopyInputs(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        probes := make(map[string]publisher.MediaProbe)
        var baseline *publisher.MediaProbe
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if _, done := seen[asset.AssetID]; done {
                continue
            }
            seen[asset.AssetID] = struct{}{}
            binding := bindings[asset.AssetID]
            if !binding.Verified || binding.SHA256 != asset.SHA256 || binding.Size != asset.SizeBytes || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q is not integrity-verified against the plan", asset.AssetID)
            }
            info, statErr := os.Stat(binding.Path)
            if statErr != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != binding.Size {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q local file identity is invalid", asset.AssetID)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("probe source %q: %w", asset.AssetID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.DurationSec <= 0 || asset.ProfileID != plan.Output.ProfileID || !asset.FirstFrameKeyframe || !asset.ClosedGOP {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q lacks certified keyframe/closed-GOP assembly metadata", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if probe.VideoFrameCount <= 0 || probe.VideoFrameCount != asset.FrameCount {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q has %d frames but its plan certifies %d; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID, probe.VideoFrameCount, asset.FrameCount)
            }
            wantLevel, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.ReplaceAll(plan.Output.CodecLevel, ".", ""))
            if probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || !strings.EqualFold(probe.VideoProfile, plan.Output.CodecProfile) || probe.VideoLevel != wantLevel || probe.VideoBFrames != plan.Output.BFrames || probe.VideoExtradataHash == "" || probe.VideoTimeBaseNum <= 0 || probe.VideoTimeBaseDen <= 0 || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height || probe.VideoFPSNum != plan.Output.FPSNum || probe.VideoFPSDen != plan.Output.FPSDen || probe.VideoPixelFormat != plan.Output.PixelFormat {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q media profile differs from the output; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if baseline == nil {
                copy := probe
                baseline = &copy
            } else if !sameSliceCopySignature(*baseline, probe) {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q codec parameters/time base differ from the other inputs; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID)
            }
            probes[asset.AssetID] = probe
        }
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            probe := probes[segment.AssetID]
            actualUS := int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000)
            windowEnd := segment.SourceInUS + segment.SourceDurationUS
            frameUS := int64(1_000_000 * plan.Output.FPSDen / plan.Output.FPSNum)
            if windowEnd > actualUS+frameUS {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q window ends at %d us beyond probed duration %d us", segment.AssetID, windowEnd, actualUS)
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    // handlers_jobs_submit.go — typed job submit/certify flow for fleetctl.
    //
    // The flow mirrors the legacy Bash exactly:
    //
    //  1. Parse --payload/--workers/--idempotency-prefix/--wait.
    //  2. Resolve worker selection ("all" → GET /api/v1/admin/workers,
    //     otherwise the comma-separated list).
    //  3. Issue an ephemeral M2M key (POST /api/v1/admin/m2m/keys,
    //     scopes=["jobs.submit"]) authenticated with the ADMIN token.
    //  4. For each worker, POST /api/v1/jobs with the payload augmented by
    //     idempotency_key=<prefix>-<worker>-<ns> and
    //     placement_pin_worker_id=<worker>, authenticated with the M2M
    //     token (least-privilege: the admin token never submits jobs).
    //  5. DELETE the ephemeral M2M key on exit (defer — the Bash trap).
    //  6. With --wait (always on for certify), poll /api/v1/jobs/{id} with
    //     the M2M token until terminal, then print the final admin snapshot.
    package main
    
    import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "net/url"
        "os"
        "strings"
        "time"
    )
    
    // runJobSubmit implements `job submit` (wait=false) and `job certify`
    // (wait=true). Returns the canonical fleetctl exit code.
    func runJobSubmit(client *fleetClient, args []string, certify bool) int {
        opts, err := parseJobSubmitArgs(args)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "%v", err))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
        payloadFile := opts.payloadFile
        raw, err := os.ReadFile(payloadFile)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "read job payload file: %v", err))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
        var payload map[string]any
        if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload); err != nil || payload == nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "job payload must be a JSON object: %v", err))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
    
        workers, err := resolveWorkerIDs(client, opts.selection)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
            return ExitUnexpected
        }
        if len(workers) == 0 {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitMisuse, "no workers selected"))
            return ExitMisuse
        }
    
        // Ephemeral M2M key lifecycle. The Bash bridge used a trap; Go uses
        // defer so the key is disabled even on partial-failure exits.
        m2mToken, cleanup, err := issueM2MKey(client, opts.idemPrefix)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
            return ExitUnexpected
        }
        defer cleanup()
    
        m2mClient := client.withToken(m2mToken)
    
        jobIDs := make([]string, 0, len(workers))
        for _, workerID := range workers {
            requestCtx, requestCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
            key := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%d", opts.idemPrefix, workerID, time.Now().UnixNano())
            jobID, err := submitOneJob(requestCtx, m2mClient, payload, workerID, key)
            requestCancel()
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
                return ExitUnexpected
            }
            jobIDs = append(jobIDs, jobID)
            fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fleetctl: submitted job=%s worker=%s\n", jobID, workerID)
        }
    
        if !opts.wait && !certify {
            for _, jobID := range jobIDs {
                fmt.Println(jobID)
            }
            return ExitOK
        }
    
        // --wait / certify: poll each job to terminal state, then print the
        // final admin snapshot (same surface the legacy print_job_card used).
        overall := ExitOK
        for _, jobID := range jobIDs {
            if err := waitForJob(context.Background(), m2mClient, jobID); err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
                overall = ExitUnexpected
                continue
            }
            if err := printFinalJobSnapshot(client, jobID); err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, fmtExit(ExitUnexpected, "%v", err))
                overall = ExitUnexpected
            }
        }
        return overall
    }
    
    // jobSubmitOptions holds the parsed `job submit` flags.
    type jobSubmitOptions struct {
        payloadFile string
        selection   string // "all" or a comma-separated worker_id list
        idemPrefix  string
        wait        bool
    }
    
    func parseJobSubmitArgs(args []string) (jobSubmitOptions, error) {
        opts := jobSubmitOptions{
            selection:  "all",
            idemPrefix: fmt.Sprintf("fleetctl-%d", time.Now().Unix()),
        }
        for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
            arg := args[i]
            switch {
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--payload="):
                opts.payloadFile = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--payload=")
            case arg == "--payload":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New("--payload requires a file")
                }
                i++
                opts.payloadFile = args[i]
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--workers="):
                opts.selection = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--workers=")
            case arg == "--workers":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New("--workers requires all or a comma-separated worker_id list")
                }
                i++
                opts.selection = args[i]
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--idempotency-prefix="):
                opts.idemPrefix = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--idempotency-prefix=")
            case arg == "--idempotency-prefix":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New("--idempotency-prefix requires a value")
                }
                i++
                opts.idemPrefix = args[i]
            case arg == "--wait":
                opts.wait = true
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--master=") || strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--token-file=") || arg == "--verbose":
                // global flags already consumed by loadClientConfig
            case arg == "--master" || arg == "--token-file":
                if i+1 >= len(args) {
                    return opts, errors.New(arg + " requires a value")
                }
                i++
            case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-"):
                return opts, fmt.Errorf("unknown job submit option %q", arg)
            default:
                return opts, fmt.Errorf("unexpected job submit argument %q", arg)
            }
        }
        if opts.payloadFile == "" {
            return opts, errors.New("job payload file is required and must be readable")
        }
        return opts, nil
    }
    
    // resolveWorkerIDs expands a selection into a worker_id slice. "all"
    // reads the admin worker list; a comma-separated value is used verbatim.
    func resolveWorkerIDs(client *fleetClient, selection string) ([]string, error) {
        if selection != "all" {
            var ids []string
            for _, w := range strings.Split(selection, ",") {
                w = strings.TrimSpace(w)
                if w == "" {
                    return nil, errors.New("worker selection contains an empty worker_id")
                }
                ids = append(ids, w)

    ## Invio di un job
    
    Il contratto canonico attualmente attivo per `POST /api/v1/jobs` è
    `SubmitJobRequest`: il client invia i campi tipizzati direttamente nel body.
    Il producer deve inviare il `CompiledRenderPlanV2` completo nei due campi top-level
    `compiled_render_plan_json` e `compiled_render_plan_sha256`. Il Master conserva
    quei byte e li valida. Instrada i piani con frammenti certificati a
    `video.assemble.copy.v1`; quando il piano dichiara stock video Drive senza
    certificati di frammento, li instrada a `video.assemble.slice.v1`, che scarica
    e verifica la sorgente sul worker e taglia le finestre direttamente nel render
    finale. Il Master non compila un piano alternativo e non deduce il profilo dal
    flag del worker.
    
    Esempio:
    
    ```bash
    set -a
    . /path/to/computer-editor-77-01.env
    set +a
    
    IDEMPOTENCY_KEY="matt-damon-5-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
    PLAN_JSON=/path/to/compiled-render-plan-v2.json
    PLAN_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$PLAN_JSON" | awk '{print $1}')"
    
    jq -n \
      --rawfile plan "$PLAN_JSON" \
      --arg plan_sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" \
      --arg job_type "scene.composite.v1" \
      --arg video_name "Matt Damon — fMP4 verification" \
      --arg script_text "Producer-owned compiled render plan" \
      --arg idem "$IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \

        job_type: $job_type,
        video_name: $video_name,
        script_text: $script_text,
        compiled_render_plan_json: $plan,
        compiled_render_plan_sha256: $plan_sha256,
        delivery_plan: [{destination_id: "local-fallback"}],
        idempotency_key: $idem

    +quei byte e li valida. I piani con `stock_pool` (folder Drive, selezione
    +`shuffle` e segmenti `stock_pool_slot`) vengono instradati automaticamente a
    +`video.assemble.slice.v1`. Il Master enumera il folder e passa al worker i
    +riferimenti e i metadati; non scarica, non prepara e non pre-riscalda i file del
    +pool. Il worker li risolve nella propria cache, verifica che il materiale sia
    +compatibile con il profilo H.264 dichiarato, riempie gli slot casualmente e
    +concatena video e audio con stream copy. La preparazione anticipata resta per
    +overlay, clip e audio fissi. Se i file del pool hanno profili o parametri H.264
    +incompatibili, il job fallisce senza ricodifica.
    +
    +Per usare il pool con stream copy, il folder deve essere omogeneo rispetto al
    +profilo del piano, inclusi livello H.264, timebase e codec extradata (SPS/PPS).
    +Non basta che i file siano tutti MP4 o H.264: per esempio, un pool con livelli
    +4.0 e 4.1 non è concatenabile secondo il profilo `VELOX_ASSEMBLY_READY_V1`.
    +I piani senza `stock_pool` mantengono il percorso copy per asset già certificati.
    +Il Master non compila un piano alternativo e non deduce il profilo dal flag del

    package contract
    
    import (
    	"encoding/json"
    	"strings"
    )
    
    const (
    	VideoAssemblyCopyExecutorID  = "video.assemble.copy.v1"
    	VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID = "video.assemble.slice.v1"
    )
    
    // RequiredVideoAssemblyExecutor is the single routing rule for compiled video
    // plans. Drive-backed video and stock-pool plans use the worker's source
    // resolver; plans containing only already-certified assets use packet-copy.
    func RequiredVideoAssemblyExecutor(payload map[string]interface{}) string {
    	planJSON, _ := payload[PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string)
    	var plan CompiledRenderPlanV2
    	if strings.TrimSpace(planJSON) == "" || json.Unmarshal([]byte(planJSON), &plan) != nil {
    		return ""
    	}
    	if plan.StockPool != nil {
    		return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
    	}
    	runtimeDriveIDs := compiledRuntimeDriveIDs(payload["runtime_assets"])
    	for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
    		if asset.Kind != "video" {
    			continue
    		}
    		if asset.SourceKind == "drive" || strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID) != "" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:") {
    			return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
    		}
    		if runtimeDriveIDs[asset.AssetID] != "" || runtimeDriveIDs[asset.AssetKey] != "" {
    			return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
    		}
    	}
    	return VideoAssemblyCopyExecutorID
    }
    
    func compiledRuntimeDriveIDs(raw interface{}) map[string]string {
    	encoded, err := json.Marshal(raw)
    	if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || string(encoded) == "null" {
    		return nil
    	}
    	var assets []struct {
    		AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
    		AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
    		DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
    	}
    	if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &assets) != nil {
    		return nil
    	}
    	byIdentity := make(map[string]string, len(assets)*2)
    	for _, asset := range assets {
    		fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
    		if fileID == "" {
    			continue
    		}
    		for _, key := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
    			if key = strings.TrimSpace(key); key != "" {
    				byIdentity[key] = fileID
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	return byIdentity
    }
    ```
