    type slicePoolMember struct {
        AssetID         string `json:"asset_id"`
        DriveFileID     string `json:"drive_file_id"`
        StockPoolMember bool   `json:"stock_pool_member"`
    }
    
    func sliceRuntimePoolMembers(raw interface{}) []slicePoolMember {
        data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        var members []slicePoolMember
        _ = json.Unmarshal(data, &members)
        return members
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) compileStockPoolPlan(ctx context.Context, spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        if plan.StockPool == nil || plan.StockPool.Selection != "shuffle" {
            return nil, errors.New("unsupported stock_pool selection")
        }
        members := sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        ordered := make([]slicePoolMember, 0, len(members))
        for _, member := range members {
            if member.StockPoolMember {
                ordered = append(ordered, member)
            }
        }
        if len(ordered) == 0 {
            return nil, errors.New("stock_pool has no resolved video files")
        }
        sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].DriveFileID < ordered[j].DriveFileID })
        probes := make(map[string]publisher.MediaProbe, len(ordered))
        var baseline *publisher.MediaProbe
        // Validate the complete folder snapshot before selecting any clips. A
        // mixed/incompatible pool fails the job without starting ffmpeg.
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            binding, ok := bindings[assetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || binding.Size <= 0 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q has no verified worker cache binding", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("probe stock source %q: %w", member.DriveFileID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height || probe.VideoFPSNum != plan.Output.FPSNum || probe.VideoFPSDen != plan.Output.FPSDen || probe.VideoPixelFormat != plan.Output.PixelFormat || probe.VideoFrameCount <= 0 || probe.VideoExtradataHash == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q is incompatible with packet-copy output; refusing to transcode", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            if err := verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx, binding.Path); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q cannot be concatenated safely: %w", member.DriveFileID, err)
            }
            if baseline == nil {
                cp := probe
                baseline = &cp
            } else if !sameSliceCopySignature(*baseline, probe) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q codec parameters differ; refusing to transcode", member.DriveFileID)
            }
            probes[member.DriveFileID] = probe
        }
        seedBytes := sha256.Sum256([]byte(spec.JobID + ":" + plan.TimelineSHA256 + ":" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID))
        rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(seedBytes[:8]))))
        rng.Shuffle(len(ordered), func(i, j int) { ordered[i], ordered[j] = ordered[j], ordered[i] })
        compiled := *plan
        compiled.StockPool = nil
        compiled.Assets = append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        compiled.VideoTracks = append([]contract.VideoTrackV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks...)
        for i := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            compiled.VideoTracks[i].Segments = append([]contract.VideoSegmentV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks[i].Segments...)
        }
        assetByID := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(ordered))
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            binding := bindings[assetID]
            probe := probes[member.DriveFileID]
            assetByID[assetID] = contract.AssetRefV2{AssetID: assetID, AssetKey: member.DriveFileID, SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: member.DriveFileID, SHA256: binding.SHA256, SizeBytes: binding.Size, Kind: "video", ProfileID: plan.Output.ProfileID, FrameCount: probe.VideoFrameCount, FirstFrameKeyframe: true, ClosedGOP: true, DurationUS: int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000), Width: probe.Width, Height: probe.Height}
            compiled.Assets = append(compiled.Assets, assetByID[assetID])
        }
        poolCursor := 0
        for trackIndex := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            segments := make([]contract.VideoSegmentV2, 0, len(compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments))
            for _, segment := range compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments {
                if segment.StockPoolSlot {
                    remaining, timelineFrame := segment.FrameCount, segment.TimelineStartFrame
                    part := 0
                    for remaining > 0 {
                        member := ordered[poolCursor%len(ordered)]
                        poolCursor++
                        part++
                        assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
                        asset := assetByID[assetID]
                        count := probes[member.DriveFileID].VideoFrameCount
                        if count > remaining {
                            count = remaining
                        }
                        segments = append(segments, contract.VideoSegmentV2{SegmentID: fmt.Sprintf("%s-source-%03d", segment.SegmentID, part), AssetID: assetID, SHA256: asset.SHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FrameCount: count, SourceDurationUS: count * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)})
                        remaining -= count
                        timelineFrame += count
                    }
                    continue
                }
                segments = append(segments, segment)
            }
            compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments = segments
        }
        return &compiled, nil
    }
    
    func verifyFirstPacketKeyframe(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
        cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "packet=flags", "-read_intervals", "%+#1", "-of", "csv=p=0", path)
        out, err := cmd.Output()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("ffprobe first packet: %w", err)
        }
        if !strings.Contains(string(out), "K") {
            return errors.New("first video packet is not a keyframe")
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }
    
    type sliceCopyCompatibility struct {
        OutputTag     string
        TimeBaseNum   int
        TimeBaseDen   int
        RemuxAssetIDs map[string]struct{}
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyCopyInputs(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (sliceCopyCompatibility, error) {
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        seen := make(map[string]struct{})
        probes := make(map[string]publisher.MediaProbe)
        var baseline *publisher.MediaProbe
        byTag := make(map[string]publisher.MediaProbe)
        outputTag := ""
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            asset := assets[segment.AssetID]
            if _, done := seen[asset.AssetID]; done {
                continue
            }
            seen[asset.AssetID] = struct{}{}
            binding := bindings[asset.AssetID]
            if !binding.Verified || binding.SHA256 != asset.SHA256 || binding.Size != asset.SizeBytes || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q is not integrity-verified against the plan", asset.AssetID)
            }
            info, statErr := os.Stat(binding.Path)
            if statErr != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != binding.Size {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q local file identity is invalid", asset.AssetID)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("probe source %q: %w", asset.AssetID, err)
            }
            if !probe.HasVideo || probe.DurationSec <= 0 || asset.ProfileID != plan.Output.ProfileID || !asset.FirstFrameKeyframe || !asset.ClosedGOP {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q lacks certified keyframe/closed-GOP assembly metadata", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if probe.VideoFrameCount <= 0 || probe.VideoFrameCount != asset.FrameCount {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q has %d frames but its plan certifies %d; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID, probe.VideoFrameCount, asset.FrameCount)
            }
            wantLevel, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.ReplaceAll(plan.Output.CodecLevel, ".", ""))
            if probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || !strings.EqualFold(probe.VideoProfile, plan.Output.CodecProfile) || probe.VideoLevel != wantLevel || probe.VideoBFrames != plan.Output.BFrames || probe.VideoExtradataHash == "" || probe.VideoTimeBaseNum <= 0 || probe.VideoTimeBaseDen <= 0 || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height || probe.VideoFPSNum != plan.Output.FPSNum || probe.VideoFPSDen != plan.Output.FPSDen || probe.VideoPixelFormat != plan.Output.PixelFormat || (probe.VideoCodecTag != "avc1" && probe.VideoCodecTag != "avc3") {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q media profile differs from the output; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if sameTag, ok := byTag[probe.VideoCodecTag]; ok && !sameSliceCopySignature(sameTag, probe) {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q differs from other %s inputs; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID, probe.VideoCodecTag)
            }
            byTag[probe.VideoCodecTag] = probe
            if baseline == nil {
                copy := probe
                baseline = &copy
                outputTag = probe.VideoCodecTag
            } else if !sameSliceCopySignature(*baseline, probe) {
                if !compatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPair(*baseline, probe) {
                    return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q codec parameters differ from the other inputs; refusing to transcode", asset.AssetID)
                }
                // avc3 explicitly permits in-band SPS/PPS updates. Keep every H.264
                // packet untouched and mark the final sample entry accordingly; FFmpeg
                // rescales differing input time bases while stream-copying the concat.
                outputTag = "avc3"
            }
            probes[asset.AssetID] = probe
        }
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            probe := probes[segment.AssetID]
            actualUS := int64(probe.DurationSec * 1_000_000)
            windowEnd := segment.SourceInUS + segment.SourceDurationUS
            frameUS := int64(1_000_000 * plan.Output.FPSDen / plan.Output.FPSNum)
            if windowEnd > actualUS+frameUS {
                return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, fmt.Errorf("source %q window ends at %d us beyond probed duration %d us", segment.AssetID, windowEnd, actualUS)
            }
        }
        if baseline == nil {
            return sliceCopyCompatibility{}, errors.New("copy plan contains no video sources")
        }
        // Use avc1's verified time base as the concat-demuxer clock whenever the
        // plan mixes avc1 and avc3. FFmpeg's concat demuxer misplaces packet PTS
        // when those MP4 time bases differ, even though stream-copy remuxing can
        // normalize them without touching encoded video packets.
        clock := *baseline
        if avc1, ok := byTag["avc1"]; ok {
            clock = avc1
        }
        compatibility := sliceCopyCompatibility{OutputTag: outputTag, TimeBaseNum: clock.VideoTimeBaseNum, TimeBaseDen: clock.VideoTimeBaseDen, RemuxAssetIDs: make(map[string]struct{})}
        if len(byTag) > 1 {
            for assetID, probe := range probes {
                if probe.VideoCodecTag == "avc3" && (probe.VideoTimeBaseNum != clock.VideoTimeBaseNum || probe.VideoTimeBaseDen != clock.VideoTimeBaseDen) {
                    compatibility.RemuxAssetIDs[assetID] = struct{}{}
                }
            }
        }
        return compatibility, nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) remuxAVC3Timebases(ctx context.Context, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings, compatibility sliceCopyCompatibility, tempDir string) (map[string]string, error) {
        if len(compatibility.RemuxAssetIDs) == 0 {
            return nil, nil
        }
        if compatibility.TimeBaseNum != 1 || compatibility.TimeBaseDen <= 0 {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported packet-copy normalization time base %d/%d", compatibility.TimeBaseNum, compatibility.TimeBaseDen)
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        assetIDs := make([]string, 0, len(compatibility.RemuxAssetIDs))
        for assetID := range compatibility.RemuxAssetIDs {
            assetIDs = append(assetIDs, assetID)
        }
        sort.Strings(assetIDs)
        paths := make(map[string]string, len(assetIDs))
        for i, assetID := range assetIDs {
            binding, ok := bindings[assetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("avc3 source %q is not available for packet-copy time-base normalization", assetID)
            }
            path := filepath.Join(tempDir, fmt.Sprintf("normalized-%03d.mp4", i))
            args := []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", binding.Path,
                "-map", "0:v:0", "-c:v", "copy", "-tag:v", "avc3", "-video_track_timescale", strconv.Itoa(compatibility.TimeBaseDen), path}
            if _, err := e.runner.Run(ctx, ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRequest{Operation: ffmpegrunner.OperationEncode, Args: args}); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("packet-copy remux source %q to time base %d/%d: %w", assetID, compatibility.TimeBaseNum, compatibility.TimeBaseDen, err)
            }
            probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, path)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("probe packet-copy remux source %q: %w", assetID, err)
            }
            original, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("recheck original avc3 source %q: %w", assetID, err)
            }
            if probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.VideoCodecTag != "avc3" || probe.VideoFrameCount != assets[assetID].FrameCount || probe.VideoExtradataHash != original.VideoExtradataHash || probe.VideoTimeBaseNum != compatibility.TimeBaseNum || probe.VideoTimeBaseDen != compatibility.TimeBaseDen {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("packet-copy remux source %q did not preserve its H.264 packets and target time base", assetID)
            }
            paths[assetID] = path
        }
        return paths, nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        if probe.VideoFrameCount != slicePlanFrameCount(plan) {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output has %d frames, plan requires %d; refusing to publish", probe.VideoFrameCount, slicePlanFrameCount(plan))
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil

    func (r *sliceFFmpegRunner) Run(_ context.Context, req ffmpegrunner.FFmpegRequest) (ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult, error) {
        r.args = append(r.args, append([]string(nil), req.Args...))
        for i := 0; i+1 < len(req.Args); i++ {
            if req.Args[i] == "-i" && strings.HasSuffix(req.Args[i+1], "segments.ffconcat") {
                data, err := os.ReadFile(req.Args[i+1])
                if err != nil {
                    return ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult{}, err
                }
                r.concatInput = string(data)
            }
        }
        if err := os.WriteFile(req.Args[len(req.Args)-1], []byte("remote-render"), 0o640); err != nil {
            return ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult{}, err
        }
        return ffmpegrunner.FFmpegResult{ProcessWallMS: 12}, nil
    }

    func TestVideoAssembleSlice_CopiesDriveSourceWindowsWithoutReencoding(t *testing.T) {
        plan := driveSlicePlan()
        canonical, err := plan.CanonicalJSON()
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        videoPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "stock.mp4")
        audioPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "audio.m4a")
        if err := os.WriteFile(videoPath, []byte("stock"), 0o640); err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        if err := os.WriteFile(audioPath, []byte("audio"), 0o640); err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        runner := &sliceFFmpegRunner{}
        exec := &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: sliceMediaProbeStub{}, outputRoot: t.TempDir()}
        spec := executorTaskSpec(VideoAssembleSliceID, "job-drive-slice", canonical, plan)
        result, err := exec.Execute(runtimeassets.WithBindings(context.Background(), runtimeassets.Bindings{
            "drive:stock-01": {AssetID: "drive:stock-01", Path: videoPath, SHA256: strings.Repeat("b", 64), Size: 5, Verified: true},
            "audio":          {AssetID: "audio", Path: audioPath, SHA256: copyOnlySHA([]byte("audio")), Size: 5, Verified: true},
        }), nil, spec)
        if err != nil || result.Status != "succeeded" {
            t.Fatalf("slice execution result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
        }
        if len(result.Outputs) != 1 || result.RawMetrics == nil || result.RawMetrics.ConcatMode != "stream_copy" || result.RawMetrics.EncodePasses != 0 || !result.RawMetrics.FinalConcatStreamCopy {
            t.Fatalf("slice result did not report copy-only remote assembly: %+v", result)
        }
        if len(runner.args) != 1 {
            t.Fatalf("FFmpeg call count = %d, want one stream-copy concat/mux", len(runner.args))
        }
        copyArgs := strings.Join(runner.args[0], " ")
        for _, want := range []string{"-f concat", "-c:v copy", "-tag:v avc1", "-c:a copy", "-frames:v 24"} {
            if !strings.Contains(copyArgs, want) {
                t.Errorf("FFmpeg stream-copy args missing %q: %s", want, copyArgs)
            }
        }
        if strings.Contains(copyArgs, "libx264") || strings.Contains(copyArgs, "filter_complex") {
            t.Fatalf("copy path must not contain an encoder or filter graph: %s", copyArgs)
        }
        if !strings.Contains(runner.concatInput, "inpoint 0\noutpoint 1.000000") {
            t.Fatalf("concat manifest does not contain the expected source window: %q", runner.concatInput)
        }
        if strings.Contains(copyArgs, "14.000000") {
            t.Fatalf("copy path unexpectedly trims a non-keyframe source offset: %s", copyArgs)
        }
    }
    
    func TestVideoAssembleSlice_RejectsNonKeyframeOffsetBeforeFFmpeg(t *testing.T) {
        plan := driveSlicePlan()
        plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments[0].SourceInUS = 14_000_000
        canonical, err := plan.CanonicalJSON()
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        runner := &sliceFFmpegRunner{}
        exec := &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: sliceMediaProbeStub{}, outputRoot: t.TempDir()}
        spec := executorTaskSpec(VideoAssembleSliceID, "job-drive-slice-invalid-cut", canonical, plan)
        result, err := exec.Execute(context.Background(), nil, spec)
        if err != nil || result.Status != "failed" {
            t.Fatalf("invalid copy plan result=%+v err=%v, want immediate failure", result, err)
        }
        if result.ErrorCode != "DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID" || len(runner.args) != 0 {
            t.Fatalf("invalid cut was not rejected before FFmpeg: result=%+v ffmpeg_calls=%d", result, len(runner.args))
        }
    }
    
    func TestSameSliceCopySignatureRejectsDivergentTimebaseAndCodecData(t *testing.T) {
        base := publisher.MediaProbe{
            VideoCodec: "h264", VideoCodecTag: "avc1", VideoProfile: "High", VideoLevel: 40,
            VideoPixelFormat: "yuv420p", VideoFPSNum: 24, VideoFPSDen: 1,
            VideoTimeBaseNum: 1, VideoTimeBaseDen: 90000, VideoExtradataHash: "sps-1",
        }
        other := base
        other.VideoTimeBaseDen = 12288
        if sameSliceCopySignature(base, other) {
            t.Fatal("different source timebases were accepted for packet copy")
        }
        other = base
        other.VideoExtradataHash = "sps-2"
        if sameSliceCopySignature(base, other) {
            t.Fatal("different H.264 codec data were accepted for packet copy")
        }
    }
    
    func TestCompatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPairAllowsContainerVariantWithoutTranscoding(t *testing.T) {
        stock := publisher.MediaProbe{
            VideoCodec: "h264", VideoCodecTag: "avc1", VideoProfile: "High", VideoLevel: 40,
            VideoPixelFormat: "yuv420p", VideoFPSNum: 24, VideoFPSDen: 1,
            VideoTimeBaseNum: 1, VideoTimeBaseDen: 12288, VideoExtradataHash: "stock-sps-pps",
        }
        overlay := stock
        overlay.VideoCodecTag = "avc3"
        overlay.VideoTimeBaseDen = 90000
        overlay.VideoExtradataHash = "overlay-inband-sps-pps"
        if !compatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPair(stock, overlay) {
            t.Fatal("compatible avc1/avc3 H.264 streams with in-band parameter sets were rejected")
        }
        if sameSliceCopySignature(stock, overlay) {
            t.Fatal("container variants should remain distinct signatures")
        }
        args, err := sliceConcatMuxArgs("segments.ffconcat", "audio.m4a", "out.mp4", driveSlicePlan(), "avc3")
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        joined := strings.Join(args, " ")
        if !strings.Contains(joined, "-tag:v avc3") || strings.Contains(joined, "libx264") {
            t.Fatalf("mixed container stream-copy must signal avc3 without encoding: %s", joined)
        }
    
        divergent := overlay
        divergent.VideoLevel = 41
        if compatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPair(stock, divergent) {
            t.Fatal("divergent H.264 levels must still be rejected")
        }
        divergent = overlay
        divergent.VideoCodecTag = "avc1"
        if compatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPair(stock, divergent) {
            t.Fatal("avc1-to-avc1 parameter-set drift must still be rejected")
        }
    }

    }

    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        if probe.VideoFrameCount != slicePlanFrameCount(plan) {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output has %d frames, plan requires %d; refusing to publish", probe.VideoFrameCount, slicePlanFrameCount(plan))
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func sameSliceCopySignature(a, b publisher.MediaProbe) bool {
        return a.VideoCodec == b.VideoCodec && a.VideoCodecTag == b.VideoCodecTag &&
            a.VideoProfile == b.VideoProfile && a.VideoLevel == b.VideoLevel &&
            a.VideoPixelFormat == b.VideoPixelFormat && a.VideoFPSNum == b.VideoFPSNum &&
            a.VideoFPSDen == b.VideoFPSDen && a.VideoTimeBaseNum == b.VideoTimeBaseNum &&
            a.VideoTimeBaseDen == b.VideoTimeBaseDen && a.VideoBFrames == b.VideoBFrames &&
            a.VideoExtradataHash == b.VideoExtradataHash
    }
    
    // compatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPair permits the one mixed H.264 packaging case that
    // can preserve packet identity: an avc1 baseline and an avc3 stream whose
    // parameter sets may change in-band. All decoding-relevant media properties
    // other than the sample-entry tag, avcC data, and container time base must
    // still match; each tag class is separately pinned by sameSliceCopySignature.
    func compatibleAVC1AVC3CopyPair(a, b publisher.MediaProbe) bool {
        if !((a.VideoCodecTag == "avc1" && b.VideoCodecTag == "avc3") || (a.VideoCodecTag == "avc3" && b.VideoCodecTag == "avc1")) {
            return false
        }
        return a.VideoCodec == b.VideoCodec && a.VideoProfile == b.VideoProfile &&
            a.VideoLevel == b.VideoLevel && a.VideoPixelFormat == b.VideoPixelFormat &&
            a.VideoFPSNum == b.VideoFPSNum && a.VideoFPSDen == b.VideoFPSDen &&
            a.VideoBFrames == b.VideoBFrames && a.VideoExtradataHash != b.VideoExtradataHash &&
            (a.VideoTimeBaseNum != b.VideoTimeBaseNum || a.VideoTimeBaseDen != b.VideoTimeBaseDen)
    }
    
    func writeSliceConcatList(path string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        var b strings.Builder
        b.WriteString("ffconcat version 1.0\n")
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            binding, ok := bindings[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q is not ready for stream-copy concat", segment.AssetID)
            }
            abs, err := filepath.Abs(binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }
            quoted := strings.ReplaceAll(abs, "'", "'\\''")
            frameDurationUS := segment.FrameCount * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
            frameDuration := seconds(frameDurationUS)
            fmt.Fprintf(&b, "file '%s'\ninpoint 0\noutpoint %s\nduration %s\n", quoted, frameDuration, frameDuration)
        }
        return os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o600)
    }
    
    func sliceConcatMuxArgs(listPath, audioPath, output string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, videoTag string) ([]string, error) {
        if strings.TrimSpace(audioPath) == "" {
            return nil, errors.New("final audio path is empty")
        }
        if videoTag != "avc1" && videoTag != "avc3" {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported H.264 MP4 sample entry %q", videoTag)
        }
        return []string{"-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
            "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listPath,
            "-threads", "1", "-i", audioPath,
            "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0", "-c:v", "copy", "-tag:v", videoTag, "-c:a", "copy",
            "-frames:v", strconv.FormatInt(slicePlanFrameCount(plan), 10),
            "-t", seconds(plan.DurationUS), "-video_track_timescale", strconv.Itoa(plan.Output.TimeBaseDen),
            "-movflags", "+faststart", output}, nil
    }

    // resolveCompiledRenderPlanAssets is an adapter/orchestrator around the
    // existing common asset resolver. It deliberately does not download bytes or
    // write cache rows itself: resolveCommonAssetPayload owns that verified path.
    //
    // The synthetic payload exists only in memory so the common resolver can
    // consume the typed V2 references. Local paths returned by that resolver are
    // projected into runtimeassets.Bindings and never written back into the
    // canonical CompiledRenderPlanV2 JSON.
    func (w *Worker) resolveCompiledRenderPlanAssets(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) (runtimeassets.Bindings, error) {
        if payload == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: payload is required")
        }
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(payload)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: decode: %w", err)
        }
        if plan == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: %q is required", contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON)
        }
    
        // This structure is an adapter input, not a replacement plan. The
        // resolver understands the existing asset envelope and returns verified
        // worker-local paths for each uri. AssetKey is the canonical cache/transfer
        // identity when supplied; AssetID remains the stable plan/binding identity.
        planAssets := append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        // Folder members are a Master-resolved runtime snapshot, not editorial
        // per-file assignments in the immutable plan. Resolve them through the same
        // verified cache path as every other V2 asset.
        var runtimePool []struct {
            AssetID         string `json:"asset_id"`
            DriveFileID     string `json:"drive_file_id"`
            SizeBytes       int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
            DurationMS      int64  `json:"duration_ms"`
            StockPoolMember bool   `json:"stock_pool_member"`
        }
        if raw, marshalErr := json.Marshal(payload["runtime_assets"]); marshalErr == nil {
            _ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &runtimePool)
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            var framesNeeded int64
            for _, track := range plan.VideoTracks {
                for _, segment := range track.Segments {
                    if segment.StockPoolSlot {
                        framesNeeded += segment.FrameCount
                    }
                }
            }
            if framesNeeded <= 0 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: stock_pool has no positive slot duration")
            }
            pool := make([]struct {
                AssetID         string `json:"asset_id"`
                DriveFileID     string `json:"drive_file_id"`
                SizeBytes       int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
                DurationMS      int64  `json:"duration_ms"`
                StockPoolMember bool   `json:"stock_pool_member"`
            }, 0, len(runtimePool))
            for _, item := range runtimePool {
                if item.StockPoolMember && item.DurationMS > 0 && item.SizeBytes > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(item.DriveFileID) != "" {
                    pool = append(pool, item)
                }
            }
            seed := time.Now().UnixNano()
            if plan.TimelineSHA256 != "" {
                seed ^= int64(plan.DurationUS)
            }
            rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)).Shuffle(len(pool), func(i, j int) { pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i] })
            var framesAvailable int64
            for _, item := range pool {
                if framesAvailable >= framesNeeded {
                    break
                }
                if !item.StockPoolMember || strings.TrimSpace(item.DriveFileID) == "" {
                    continue
                }
                frames := item.DurationMS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum) / (1000 * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen))
                if frames <= 0 {
                    continue
                }
                planAssets = append(planAssets, contract.AssetRefV2{
                    AssetID: "stockpool:" + item.DriveFileID, AssetKey: item.DriveFileID,
                    SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: item.DriveFileID,
                    Kind: "video", SizeBytes: item.SizeBytes,
                })
                framesAvailable += frames
            }
            if framesAvailable < framesNeeded {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: stock_pool duration metadata covers %d of %d required frames", framesAvailable, framesNeeded)
            }
        }
        assetEnvelopes := make([]interface{}, 0, len(planAssets))
        seenIdentities := make(map[string]string, len(planAssets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := compiledRuntimeDriveFileIDs(payload["runtime_assets"])
        for _, asset := range planAssets {
            identity := compiledAssetIdentity(asset)
            if identity == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: asset %q has no canonical identity", asset.AssetID)
            }
            if previous, exists := seenIdentities[identity]; exists && previous != asset.AssetID {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("compiled render plan v2: assets %q and %q share canonical identity %q", previous, asset.AssetID, identity)
            }
            seenIdentities[identity] = asset.AssetID
            uri := compiledAssetReference(asset)
            driveID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
        data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        var members []slicePoolMember
        _ = json.Unmarshal(data, &members)
        return members
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) compileStockPoolPlan(_ context.Context, spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        if plan.StockPool == nil || plan.StockPool.Selection != "shuffle" {
            return nil, errors.New("unsupported stock_pool selection")
        }
        members := sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        ordered := make([]slicePoolMember, 0, len(members))
        for _, member := range members {
            binding, selected := bindings["stockpool:"+member.DriveFileID]
            if member.StockPoolMember && selected && binding.Verified && binding.Size > 0 && member.DurationMS > 0 {
                ordered = append(ordered, member)
            }
        }
        if len(ordered) == 0 {
            return nil, errors.New("stock_pool has no selected sources with Drive duration metadata")
        }
        sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].DriveFileID < ordered[j].DriveFileID })
        seedBytes := sha256.Sum256([]byte(spec.JobID + ":" + plan.TimelineSHA256 + ":" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID))
        rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(seedBytes[:8]))))
        rng.Shuffle(len(ordered), func(i, j int) { ordered[i], ordered[j] = ordered[j], ordered[i] })
        compiled := *plan
        compiled.StockPool = nil
        compiled.Assets = append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        compiled.VideoTracks = append([]contract.VideoTrackV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks...)
        for i := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            compiled.VideoTracks[i].Segments = append([]contract.VideoSegmentV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks[i].Segments...)
        }
        assetByID := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(ordered))
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            binding := bindings[assetID]
            frames := member.DurationMS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum) / (1000 * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen))
            assetByID[assetID] = contract.AssetRefV2{AssetID: assetID, AssetKey: member.DriveFileID, SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: member.DriveFileID, SHA256: binding.SHA256, SizeBytes: binding.Size, Kind: "video", ProfileID: plan.Output.ProfileID, FrameCount: frames, FirstFrameKeyframe: true, ClosedGOP: true, DurationUS: member.DurationMS * 1000, Width: plan.Output.Width, Height: plan.Output.Height}
            compiled.Assets = append(compiled.Assets, assetByID[assetID])
        }
        poolCursor := 0
        for trackIndex := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            segments := make([]contract.VideoSegmentV2, 0, len(compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments))
            for _, segment := range compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments {
                if !segment.StockPoolSlot {
                    segments = append(segments, segment)
                    continue
                }
                remaining, timelineFrame := segment.FrameCount, segment.TimelineStartFrame
                part := 0
                for remaining > 0 {
                    member := ordered[poolCursor%len(ordered)]
                    poolCursor++
                    part++
                    assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
                    asset := assetByID[assetID]
                    count := asset.FrameCount
                    if count > remaining {
                        count = remaining
                    }
                    if count <= 0 {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("stock source %q has no full frames in Drive duration metadata", member.DriveFileID)
                    }
                    segments = append(segments, contract.VideoSegmentV2{SegmentID: fmt.Sprintf("%s-source-%03d", segment.SegmentID, part), AssetID: assetID, SHA256: asset.SHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FrameCount: count, SourceDurationUS: count * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)})
                    remaining -= count
                    timelineFrame += count
                }
            }
            compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments = segments
        }
        return &compiled, nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanDurationFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        n := plan.DurationUS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        d := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        return (n + d - 1) / d
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        if probe.VideoFrameCount != slicePlanFrameCount(plan) {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output has %d frames, plan requires %d; refusing to publish", probe.VideoFrameCount, slicePlanFrameCount(plan))
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func writeSliceConcatList(path string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        var b strings.Builder
        b.WriteString("ffconcat version 1.0\n")
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            binding, ok := bindings[segment.AssetID]
            if !ok || !binding.Verified || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("source %q is not ready for stream-copy concat", segment.AssetID)
            }
            abs, err := filepath.Abs(binding.Path)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }
            quoted := strings.ReplaceAll(abs, "'", "'\\''")
            frameDurationUS := segment.FrameCount * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
            frameDuration := seconds(frameDurationUS)
            fmt.Fprintf(&b, "file '%s'\ninpoint 0\noutpoint %s\nduration %s\n", quoted, frameDuration, frameDuration)
        }
        return os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o600)
    }

    func slicePlanFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {

    # /etc/systemd/system/velox-worker.service
    [Unit]
    Description=Velox Worker (canonical Compose runtime)
    Documentation=https://github.com/Marcuss-ops/VeloxEditiingg/tree/main/deploy/runtime
    Requires=docker.service
    After=network-online.target docker.service
    Wants=network-online.target
    
    [Service]
    Type=simple
    WorkingDirectory=/opt/velox-worker
    EnvironmentFile=/etc/velox-worker/worker.env
    ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/docker compose --env-file /etc/velox-worker/worker.env --project-name velox-worker --file /opt/velox-worker/compose.yml config
    ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose --env-file /etc/velox-worker/worker.env --project-name velox-worker --file /opt/velox-worker/compose.yml up --remove-orphans --no-color
    ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose --env-file /etc/velox-worker/worker.env --project-name velox-worker --file /opt/velox-worker/compose.yml down --remove-orphans
    Restart=always
    RestartSec=10
    TimeoutStartSec=120
    TimeoutStopSec=90
    KillMode=control-group
    
    [Install]
    WantedBy=multi-user.target

## Assistant

Ho rimosso dal worker la scansione dei 240 stock, i probe e i controlli keyframe sui singoli file, e il remux con i relativi controlli degli overlay. Ora legge le durate già fornite dal Master, seleziona e scarica solo gli stock necessari e passa i segmenti direttamente al concat con stream copy. Resta un solo probe sul video finale per verificarne durata e frame prima della pubblicazione.

    # Fixed Direct Jobs
    
    ## PRE job intake
    
    `POST /api/v1/jobs/pre` supports both the legacy two-stage flow and a
    single-stage flow. The Master decides whether the runtime-asset gate is
    already complete from the PRE request:
    
    | PRE request | Response | Next step |
    |---|---|---|
    | `runtime_assets` is non-empty, or `runtime_payload.runtime_assets` is non-empty | `202 {job_id, dispatch_status: "prefetch_queued"}` | No FINALIZE is required; the worker prefetches the declared runtime assets. |
    | `runtime_assets_complete: true` | `202 {job_id, dispatch_status: "prefetch_queued"}` | Explicitly certifies completion, including an intentionally empty asset list. |
    | Runtime assets omitted, or empty without the explicit flag | `202 {job_id, dispatch_status: "waiting_runtime_assets"}` | Send FINALIZE later with the runtime assets. |
    | `runtime_assets_complete: false` | `202 {job_id, dispatch_status: "waiting_runtime_assets"}` | Explicitly keeps the job pending, even when assets are present. |
    
    The explicit completion flag is available on the canonical `SubmitJobRequest`
    wire schema as well as the handler type. `null` and `[]` nested under
    `runtime_payload.runtime_assets` do not complete the gate; use
    `runtime_assets_complete: true` when an empty list is intentional.
    
    ### Two-stage job intake
    
    For jobs whose overlay/audio assets are generated after the initial stock and
    clip inputs, use the same job identity for both stages:
    
    ```text
    POST /api/v1/jobs/pre
      -> 202 {job_id, dispatch_status: "waiting_runtime_assets"}
    POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/finalize
      -> 202 {job_id, future_asset_plan: "refresh"}
    ```
    
    The PRE payload must include `copy_only: true`. This is the explicit
    clips.v1 packet-copy admission contract; a later `replace` overlay may select
    the editorial re-encode path, but the renderer still requires this input gate
    to be present during validation. The PRE stage carries only the stock/clip
    timeline; FINALIZE adds the runtime assets to the same job.
    
    For the single-stage branch, include the complete runtime asset declaration in
    the PRE payload. For the two-stage branch, omit it (or leave the gate pending)
    and use FINALIZE after the generated assets are available.
    
    The finalize payload accepts typed `overlays[]` in `replace` mode with the
    canonical half-open window `[start_frame,end_frame)` (for example
    `start_frame: 120, end_frame: 240`), plus extensible `runtime_payload` /
    `runtime_assets` fields for TTS, BGM and SFX. The Master updates the existing
    task atomically and keeps its FutureAssetPlan reservation on the same worker.
    
    Raw `mode: "composite"` overlays are rejected at intake: the native worker
    cannot composite them, and downloading the source overlay before discovering
    that would waste a prefetch cycle. Generate each finished, video-only MP4
    before FINALIZE (the asset must contain the complete picture for its window,
    not a transparent layer). For a legacy `clips.v1` job, send one `replace`
    overlay covering the complete prepared window; this uses the editorial
    re-encode path. For a strict V2 job, add the MP4 to the completed
    `render_manifest.assets` and send `visual_replacements[]` with its asset ID
    and absolute timeline window. FINALIZE recompiles the V2 plan against the
    original PRE timeline and completed asset list, then refreshes prefetch for
    the same reserved task.
    The PRE video timeline, output contract, and final audio must remain identical;
    existing compiled asset identities and metadata must be preserved. The MP4
    must match the declared canonical video profile and have a duration matching
    its replacement window.
    
    ```json
    {
      "idempotency_key": "job-123-finalize-v1",
      "render_manifest": { "...": "completed manifest with the PRE assets plus finished MP4 assets" },
      "visual_replacements": [
        {
          "replacement_id": "scene-3-composite",
          "asset_id": "finished-scene-3-mp4",
          "sha256": "<sha256 from the completed manifest>",
          "timeline_start_us": 33833333,
          "timeline_end_us": 38833333,
          "profile_id": "<canonical profile declared by the manifest>"
        }
      ]
    }
    ```
    
    The runtime audio IDs point to entries in the same `runtime_assets` list; the
    worker resolves their verified local cache paths and mixes them in one final
    audio contract:
    
    ```json
    {
      "overlays": [
        {
          "id": "overlay-1",
          "asset_id": "drive-overlay-id",
          "start_frame": 120,
          "end_frame": 240,
          "frame_count": 120,
          "mode": "replace",
          "audio_mode": "preserve_final_audio"
        }
      ],
      "runtime_assets": [
        {"asset_id": "tts-1", "kind": "audio", "role": "tts", "url": "velox-drive://..."},

        {"asset_id": "sfx-1", "kind": "audio", "role": "sfx", "url": "velox-drive://..."}
      ],

          "sfx_asset_id": "sfx-1",
          "sfx_start_seconds": 2.5
        }

    func NewM2MOrAdminAuthMiddleware(cfg *config.Config, st *store.SQLiteStore, limiter *m2mRateLimiter, adminToken string, adminAuth gin.HandlerFunc) gin.HandlerFunc {
        m2mAuth := NewM2MJwAuthMiddleware(cfg, st, limiter)
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
            token := workersreg.ExtractBearerToken(c.GetHeader("Authorization"), "", "")
            if strings.TrimSpace(adminToken) != "" && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(token), []byte(strings.TrimSpace(adminToken))) == 1 {
                if adminAuth == nil {
                    c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{"error": "admin auth not configured"})
                    return
                }
                adminAuth(c)
                return
            }
            m2mAuth(c)
        }
    }
    
    // NewServiceOrM2MOrAdminAuthMiddleware protects internal artifact reads for
    // the reverse Velox→InstaEdit service contract. The service uses the shared
    // SOCIAL_API_TOKEN for both delivery requests and artifact downloads; M2M and
    // operator-admin tokens remain valid for tooling and backwards compatibility.
    // Browser-origin requests are rejected even when the service token matches.
    func NewServiceOrM2MOrAdminAuthMiddleware(cfg *config.Config, st *store.SQLiteStore, limiter *m2mRateLimiter, adminToken string, adminAuth gin.HandlerFunc) gin.HandlerFunc {
        m2mOrAdmin := NewM2MOrAdminAuthMiddleware(cfg, st, limiter, adminToken, adminAuth)
        serviceToken := ""
        if cfg != nil {
            serviceToken = strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Runtime.Social.APIKey)
        }
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
            if c.GetHeader("Origin") != "" {
                c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{"error": "direct browser access forbidden"})
                return
            }
            token := workersreg.ExtractBearerToken(c.GetHeader("Authorization"), "", "")
            if serviceToken != "" && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(token), []byte(serviceToken)) == 1 {
                c.Next()
                return
            }
            m2mOrAdmin(c)
        }
    }

    // ClientIDFromContext extracts the resolved client_id from a context
    // populated by the M2M middleware. Returns the empty string when the
    // middleware did not run (e.g., a test mount without M2M auth).
    func ClientIDFromContext(c *gin.Context) string {
        if c == nil {
            return ""
        }
        if v, ok := c.Get(m2mCtxKeyClientID); ok {
            if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
                return s
            }
        }
        return ""
    }
    
    // KeyFromContext returns the typed M2MAPIKey the middleware
    // resolved against, or nil if M2M auth did not run.
    func KeyFromContext(c *gin.Context) *m2mkeys.M2MAPIKey {
        if c == nil {
            return nil

        if v, ok := c.Get(m2mCtxKeyM2MKey); ok {
            if k, ok := v.(*m2mkeys.M2MAPIKey); ok {
                return k
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    ```

    ## Invio di un job
    
    Il contratto canonico attualmente attivo per `POST /api/v1/jobs` è
    `SubmitJobRequest`: il client invia i campi tipizzati direttamente nel body.
    Il producer deve inviare il `CompiledRenderPlanV2` completo nei due campi top-level
    `compiled_render_plan_json` e `compiled_render_plan_sha256`. Il Master conserva
    quei byte e li valida. I piani con `stock_pool` (folder Drive, selezione
    `shuffle` e segmenti `stock_pool_slot`) vengono instradati automaticamente a
    `video.assemble.slice.v1`. Il Master enumera il folder e passa al worker i

## Activity

    $ sed -n '240,265p' docs/API-JOBS.md; rg -n "GET /api/v1/admin/m2m/keys|plaintext_secret|m2m/keys" DataServer/internal/handlers/server/api/admin_m2m_keys.go
    | `m2m_scope_rejected` | 403 | Key present but lacks `jobs.submit` scope. |
    | `m2m_rate_limited` | 429 | Token-bucket exhaustion; `Retry-After: 1` header. |
    | `m2m_quota_exceeded` | 429 | Per-request `quota_max_scenes` / `quota_max_total_secs` exceeded. |
    | `ssrf_rejected` | 422 | External URL egress policy denied (loopback / private / non-allowlisted host). |
    | `job_not_found` | 404 | `GET /api/v1/jobs/:id` lookup miss. |
    
    Cross-client authorisation is **STRICT**: every M2M polling read and action resolves the requested job through `creator_forwardings` and requires `external_client_id == m2m_client_id`. This covers `GET /api/v1/jobs/:id` and `GET /api/v1/jobs/:id/asset-progress`. A job that does not exist AND a job owned by another client return the identical `404 job_not_found` envelope (`ok:false`, `error:"job_not_found"`, same `message`) — the boundary reveals no existence oracle. Artifact URLs, delivery rows, timeline events and asset-progress are surfaced only after the ownership-scoped lookup succeeds; the same rule applies to the artifact / delivery projections nested in the status response. Admin callers (operator `VELOX_ADMIN_TOKEN`) bypass the M2M boundary by design and keep the unscoped admin surface.
    
    ## Source-of-truth ladder
    
    In priority order (top authority wins on divergence):
    
    1. **Tested behavior** (final authority): `DataServer/internal/handlers/server/pipeline/job_submit_e2e_test.go` + `creator_push_e2e_test.go` (the latter covers the shared resolver path).
    2. **OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec**: `DataServer/api/openapi.yaml` (operation `submitJob` + `getSubmittedJob`, schemas `SubmitJobRequest` / `SubmitScene` / `SubmitDeliveryPlanEntry` / `SubmitJobAcceptedResponse` / `SubmitJobStatusResponse`). CI-enforced by `scripts/api/validate_openapi.py` (correctness-only since [P1] codegen).
    3. **M2M admin surface**: `DataServer/internal/handlers/server/api/admin_m2m_keys.go` (CRUD for `client_id` / `plaintext_secret` / scopes / quotas).
    4. **M2M middleware**: `DataServer/internal/handlers/server/pipeline/m2m_auth.go` (Bearer → SHA-256 → key row → scope check → token bucket → audit row).
    5. **This document** (narrative, treated as the operator onboarding reference).

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    # provision-key.sh — mint, rotate or revoke an M2M client key on THIS master.
    #
    # Run this ON the master host (the one that owns the primary SQLite database),
    # not on the remote computer. The remote only ever needs the 0600 env file this
    # script writes for it.
    #
    # ── WHY THIS SCRIPT EXISTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # The M2M auth middleware resolves `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` by looking
    # up SHA-256(secret) — LOWERCASE HEX — in the primary SQLite `m2m_clients`
    # table (internal/platform/sqlite/m2m/store.go, migration
    # 252_m2m_clients.sql). This checkout exposes NO admin HTTP endpoint that mints
    # keys: `POST /api/v1/admin/m2m/keys` exists only on the remote master build,
    # and `cmd/admin` has zero M2M references. So a key is provisioned HERE, with
    # the same digest primitive the middleware uses
    # (internal/kernel/digest.SHA256String → SHA-256 of the exact bytes, no
    # trailing newline), never a second hasher. `preflight.sh` probes that admin
    # route; a 404 on this host is expected and is exactly why this script exists.
    #
    # ── SECRET HANDLING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    #   * the plaintext secret is generated locally, written ONCE to a 0600 env
    #     file OUTSIDE the repository, and never printed to stdout;
    #   * only `secret_hash` is persisted, so a database read (even by an admin
    #     with direct SQLite access) cannot recover the secret;
    #   * the secret is never passed as a command-line argument (no `ps` leak) and
    #     never lands in shell history.
    #
    # ── PREREQUISITES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    #   * the master must run with M2M ENFORCED: `security.enable_m2m: true`
    #     (env VELOX_ENABLE_M2M=true). With it `false` the guard passes through in
    #     admin context — the `/api/v1/*` surface is open and the key is neither
    #     required nor verified;
    #   * the server must have booted at least once so migration 252 created
    #     `m2m_clients`.
    #
    # Usage:
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --list
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --client-id computer-editor-77-01
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --client-id x --scopes jobs.submit,jobs.read
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --client-id x --rotate       # new secret, same row
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --client-id x --disable      # revoke (enabled=0)
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --client-id x --dry-run      # print the SQL only
    #   ops/jobs/remote/provision-key.sh --client-id x \
    #     --master-url http://77.93.152.122:8000 --env-file ~/computer-editor-77-01.env
    #
    # Options:
    #   --client-id ID      client_id (required unless --list)
    #   --description D     free-text description stored on the row
    #   --scopes LIST       comma-separated scopes
    #                       (default: jobs.submit,jobs.read,media.read)
    #   --master-url URL    written as VELOX_MASTER_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
    #   --env-file PATH     output env file (default $HOME/<client-id>.env)
    #   --db PATH           primary SQLite DB (default: canonical path resolver)
    #   --rate-limit N      rate_limit_rps  (default 2)
    #   --burst N           rate_limit_burst (default 10)
    #   --quota-scenes N    quota_max_scenes (default 1000)
    #   --rotate            replace the secret of an existing client_id
    #   --disable           set enabled=0 on an existing client_id (revocation)
    #   --list              list provisioned clients (never prints secret material)
    #   --dry-run           print the SQL/actions, change nothing
    #   --force             allow overwriting an EXISTING --env-file
    #
    # Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 usage · 2 environment (db/sqlite3 missing) · 3 client_id
    #             already exists (use --rotate) · 4 client_id not found
    #             · 5 env file exists (use --force or --env-file)
    set -Eeuo pipefail
    
    SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    ROOT_DIR="$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
    
    # shellcheck source=scripts/lib/dotenv.sh
    source "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/lib/dotenv.sh"
    # shellcheck source=scripts/lib/canonical_db_path.sh
    source "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/lib/canonical_db_path.sh"
    load_dotenv_missing "$ROOT_DIR/.env"
    
    log()  { printf '[provision-key] %s\n' "$*"; }
    fail() { printf '[provision-key] ERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
    
    CLIENT_ID=""
    DESCRIPTION=""
    SCOPES="jobs.submit,jobs.read,media.read"
    MASTER_URL="${VELOX_MASTER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}"
    ENV_FILE=""
    DB_PATH="${VELOX_PRIMARY_DB_PATH:-}"
    RATE_LIMIT="2"
    BURST="10"
    QUOTA_SCENES="1000"
    MODE="mint"          # mint | rotate | disable | list
    DRY_RUN="0"
    FORCE="0"
    
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
      case "$1" in
        --client-id)    CLIENT_ID="${2:?--client-id needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --description)  DESCRIPTION="${2:?--description needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --scopes)       SCOPES="${2:?--scopes needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --master-url)   MASTER_URL="${2:?--master-url needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --env-file)     ENV_FILE="${2:?--env-file needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --db)           DB_PATH="${2:?--db needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --rate-limit)   RATE_LIMIT="${2:?--rate-limit needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --burst)        BURST="${2:?--burst needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --quota-scenes) QUOTA_SCENES="${2:?--quota-scenes needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
        --rotate)       MODE="rotate"; shift ;;
        --disable)      MODE="disable"; shift ;;
        --list)         MODE="list"; shift ;;
        --dry-run)      DRY_RUN="1"; shift ;;
        --force)        FORCE="1"; shift ;;
        -h|--help)      sed -n '2,58p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; exit 0 ;;
        *) echo "provision-key: unknown argument $1" >&2; exit 1 ;;
      esac
    done
    
    command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "sqlite3 not on PATH (exit 2)"
    [[ -n "$DB_PATH" ]] || DB_PATH="$(canonical_primary_db_path "$ROOT_DIR")"
    DB_PATH="$(require_canonical_primary_db "$DB_PATH")" || fail "canonical primary DB not found (exit 2)"
    
    sql() { sqlite3 -noheader -batch "$DB_PATH" "$1"; }
    
    if [[ "$MODE" == "list" ]]; then
      TABLES="$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='m2m_clients';")"
      [[ "$TABLES" == "1" ]] || fail "m2m_clients does not exist yet — boot the master once so migration 252 runs"
      log "db=$DB_PATH"
      # secret_hash is deliberately NOT selected: it is the only credential-shaped
      # column and there is never a reason to print it.
      sqlite3 -batch -column -header "$DB_PATH" \
        "SELECT client_id, enabled, scopes_json, rate_limit_rps, quota_max_scenes,
                created_at, COALESCE(last_used_at,'-') AS last_used_at
           FROM m2m_clients ORDER BY client_id;"
      exit 0
    fi
    
    [[ -n "$CLIENT_ID" ]] || fail "--client-id is required"
    [[ "$CLIENT_ID" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ ]] \
      || fail "client_id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ (got: $CLIENT_ID)"
    [[ "$RATE_LIMIT" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]] || fail "--rate-limit must be numeric"
    [[ "$BURST" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "--burst must be an integer"
    [[ "$QUOTA_SCENES" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "--quota-scenes must be an integer"
    [[ -n "$SCOPES" ]] || fail "--scopes must not be empty"
    
    # Reject typos loudly: a scope that nothing checks is a silent no-op grant, and
    # a scope this surface never issues silently produces 403s on every route.
    VALID_SCOPES=("jobs.submit" "jobs.read" "media.read")
    IFS=',' read -r -a SCOPE_LIST <<<"$SCOPES"
    for s in "${SCOPE_LIST[@]}"; do
      [[ -n "$s" ]] || fail "--scopes contains an empty entry"
      found="0"
      for v in "${VALID_SCOPES[@]}"; do [[ "$s" == "$v" ]] && found="1"; done
      [[ "$found" == "1" ]] || fail "unknown scope '$s' (known: ${VALID_SCOPES[*]})"
    done
    
    TABLES="$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='m2m_clients';")"
    [[ "$TABLES" == "1" ]] || fail "m2m_clients does not exist yet — boot the master once so migration 252 runs"
    
    # SQL string escaping: double every single quote. The client_id is already
    # charset-restricted; the description is free text.
    esc() { printf '%s' "${1//\'/\'\'}"; }
    
    # Build the JSON scope array as a SQLite JSON literal (the middleware
    # json.Unmarshal's this column into []string).
    scopes_json="["
    for i in "${!SCOPE_LIST[@]}"; do
      [[ "$i" -gt 0 ]] && scopes_json+=","
      scopes_json+="\"$(esc "${SCOPE_LIST[$i]}")\""
    done
    scopes_json+="]"
    
    EXISTS="$(sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m2m_clients WHERE client_id='$(esc "$CLIENT_ID")';")"
    
    describe_sql() {
      case "$MODE" in
        mint)
          cat <<SQL
    INSERT INTO m2m_clients
      (client_id, description, secret_hash, scopes_json, enabled,
       rate_limit_rps, rate_limit_burst, quota_max_scenes)
    VALUES
      ('$(esc "$CLIENT_ID")', '$(esc "$DESCRIPTION")', '<sha256-hex(secret)>',
       '$(esc "$scopes_json")', 1, $RATE_LIMIT, $BURST, $QUOTA_SCENES);
    SQL
          ;;
        rotate)
          cat <<SQL
    UPDATE m2m_clients
       SET secret_hash = '<sha256-hex(new-secret)>'
     WHERE client_id = '$(esc "$CLIENT_ID")';
    SQL
          ;;
        disable)
          cat <<SQL
    UPDATE m2m_clients SET enabled = 0 WHERE client_id = '$(esc "$CLIENT_ID")';
    SQL
          ;;
      esac
    }
    
    case "$MODE" in
      mint)
        if [[ "$EXISTS" != "0" ]]; then
          log "client '$CLIENT_ID' already exists — refusing to overwrite its secret"
          log "use --rotate (new secret) or --disable (revoke), or --list to inspect"
          exit 3
        fi
        ;;
      rotate|disable)
        if [[ "$EXISTS" == "0" ]]; then
          log "client '$CLIENT_ID' not found in $DB_PATH"
          exit 4
        fi
        ;;
    esac
    
    if [[ "$MODE" == "disable" ]]; then
      if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "1" ]]; then
        log "dry-run — SQL that would run:"; describe_sql
        exit 0
      fi
      sql "UPDATE m2m_clients SET enabled = 0 WHERE client_id='$(esc "$CLIENT_ID")';"
      log "client '$CLIENT_ID' DISABLED (enabled=0) — every request now answers 403"
      log "db=$DB_PATH"

        "velox-server/internal/store"
    )
    
    // =====================================================================
    // request / response shapes
    // =====================================================================
    
    // issueM2MKeyRequest is the JSON body for POST /api/v1/admin/m2m/keys.
    //
    // All fields other than ClientID are optional. Defaults applied at
    // issue time:
    //   - Scopes:             ["jobs.submit"]
    //   - Description:        ""
    //   - RateLimitRPS:       0 → cfg.M2M.DefaultRPS at enforcement
    //   - RateLimitBurst:     0 → cfg.M2M.DefaultBurst
    //   - QuotaMaxScenes:     0 → cfg.M2M.MaxScenesPerRequest
    //   - QuotaMaxTotalS:     0 → cfg.M2M.MaxTotalDurationSecondsPerRequest
    type issueM2MKeyRequest struct {
        ClientID          string   `json:"client_id"`
        Description       string   `json:"description"`
        Scopes            []string `json:"scopes"`
        RateLimitRPS      *int     `json:"rate_limit_rps"`
        RateLimitBurst    *int     `json:"rate_limit_burst"`
        QuotaMaxScenes    *int     `json:"quota_max_scenes"`
        QuotaMaxTotalSecs *float64 `json:"quota_max_total_secs"`
    }
    
    // issueM2MKeyResponse is the JSON returned by POST on success.
    // PlaintextSecret is the ONLY time the plaintext exists outside the
    // admin's clipboard; the row in `m2m_api_keys` contains only its
    // SHA-256 hash.
    type issueM2MKeyResponse struct {
        ClientID        string    `json:"client_id"`
        PlaintextSecret string    `json:"plaintext_secret"` // returned ONCE
        SecretHash      string    `json:"secret_hash"`
        Scopes          []string  `json:"scopes"`
        IsActive        bool      `json:"is_active"`
        Description     string    `json:"description"`
        RateLimitRPS    *int      `json:"rate_limit_rps"`
        RateLimitBurst  *int      `json:"rate_limit_burst"`
        QuotaMaxScenes  *int      `json:"quota_max_scenes"`
        QuotaMaxTotalS  *float64  `json:"quota_max_total_secs"`
        CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    }
    
    // =====================================================================
    // helper: validation
    // =====================================================================
    
    // validateIssueM2MKeyRequest vets the request before insertion.
    // Reject: empty ClientID, ClientID containing `:`, scopes list with
    // unknown scope. Known / accepted scopes: `jobs.submit` (the only
    // scope supported at v1).
    func validateIssueM2MKeyRequest(req *issueM2MKeyRequest) error {
        if req == nil {
            return errAdminBadRequest("request body is required")
    // =====================================================================
    
    // IssueM2MKey (POST /api/v1/admin/m2m/keys) creates a new key row,
    // generates a 32-byte (64 hex char) plaintext secret via crypto/rand,
    // returns it once with the typed row metadata, and stores only the
    // SHA-256 of the secret in m2m_api_keys.
    func IssueM2MKey(st *store.SQLiteStore) gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
            if st == nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "store unavailable"})
                return
            }
            var req issueM2MKeyRequest
            if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{
                    "error":   "invalid_payload",
                    "message": "request body must be valid JSON",
                })
                return
            }
            req.ClientID = strings.TrimSpace(req.ClientID)
            if err := validateIssueM2MKeyRequest(&req); err != nil {
                var e *adminBadRequest
                if errors.As(err, &e) {
                    c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{
                        "error": "invalid_payload", "message": e.Error(),
                    })
                    return
                }
                c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid_payload", "message": err.Error()})
                return
            }
            plaintext := m2mkeys.GenerateM2MSecret()
            hash := m2mkeys.HashM2MSecret(plaintext)
            scopes := req.Scopes
            if len(scopes) == 0 {
                scopes = []string{"jobs.submit"}
            }
            key := m2mkeys.M2MAPIKey{
                ClientID:       req.ClientID,
                SecretHash:     hash,
                Scopes:         scopes,
                IsActive:       true,
                Description:    req.Description,
                RateLimitRPS:   derefInt(req.RateLimitRPS),
                RateLimitBurst: derefInt(req.RateLimitBurst),
                Quotas: m2mkeys.M2MQuotas{
                    MaxScenes:         derefInt(req.QuotaMaxScenes),
                    MaxTotalDurationS: dereqF64(req.QuotaMaxTotalSecs),
                },
            }
            ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), 3*time.Second)
            defer cancel()
            if err := m2mkeys.InsertM2MAPIKey(ctx, st.DB(), key); err != nil {
                // The most common error is the PK violation on a duplicate
                // client_id. Map to 409 with a stable error code.
                if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "UNIQUE") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "constraint failed") {
                    c.JSON(http.StatusConflict, gin.H{
                        "error":   "duplicate_client_id",
                        "message": "client_id already exists",
                    })
                    return
                }
                c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "store_failure", "message": err.Error()})
                return
            }
    
            // Return the row PLUS plaintext_secret (one-shot). The
            // response envelope preserves typed pointers for the
            // operator-supplied overrides so they can copy them into
            // their password manager without re-parsing.
            c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, issueM2MKeyResponse{
                ClientID:        key.ClientID,
                PlaintextSecret: plaintext,
                SecretHash:      hash,
                Scopes:          key.Scopes,
                IsActive:        key.IsActive,
                Description:     key.Description,
                RateLimitRPS:    req.RateLimitRPS,
                RateLimitBurst:  req.RateLimitBurst,
                QuotaMaxScenes:  req.QuotaMaxScenes,
                QuotaMaxTotalS:  req.QuotaMaxTotalSecs,
                CreatedAt:       time.Now().UTC(),
            })
        }
    }
    
    // ListM2MKeys (GET /api/v1/admin/m2m/keys) returns all key rows.
    // The plaintext is NEVER returned (it doesn't exist in the DB).
    // Soft-disabled rows are included so operators can audit revoked
    // clients.

    func marshalCopyOnlyWire(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, jobID, outputPath string, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) ([]byte, error) {
        if plan == nil || strings.TrimSpace(jobID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(outputPath) == "" {
            return nil, errors.New("video.assemble.copy.v1: incomplete native wire document")
        }
        paths := make(map[string]string, len(bindings))
        for assetID, binding := range bindings {
            paths[assetID] = binding.Path
        }
        return json.Marshal(copyOnlyPlanWire{CompiledRenderPlanV2: plan, JobID: jobID, OutputPath: outputPath, Bindings: paths})
    }
    
    // copyOnlyRenderErrorCode classifies a native copy-only render failure into
    // a stable worker-facing error code. The native engine already fails closed
    // for every packet-mux rejection (it never re-encodes), but it reports them
    // all under a generic packet_mux_failed code; the worker re-classifies the
    // keyframe-safety rejection so operators can distinguish "the cut is not
    // packet-copy safe" from an unrelated mux failure without losing the exact
    // engine reason.
    func copyOnlyRenderErrorCode(err error) string {
        if err == nil {
            return "PACKET_COPY_FAILED"
        }
        lower := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
        if strings.Contains(lower, "must start on an exact video keyframe") ||
            strings.Contains(lower, "not keyframe-safe for packet copy") {
            return "COPY_ONLY_NOT_KEYFRAME_SAFE"
        }
        return "PACKET_COPY_FAILED"
    }
    
    func validateCopyOnlyPlan(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        if plan == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.copy.v1: plan is nil")
        }
        profile, err := validateCopyOnlyProfile(plan)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.copy.v1: exactly one non-empty video track is required")
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            if err := validateCopyOnlySegment(plan, profile, assets, segment); err != nil {
                return err
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    func decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec executor.TaskSpec) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(spec.Payload)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.copy.v1: decode CompiledRenderPlanV2: %w", err)
        }
        if plan == nil {
            return nil, errors.New("video.assemble.copy.v1: compiled plan JSON must be present")
        }
        return plan, nil
    }
    
    func validateBindings(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        if plan == nil || bindings == nil {
            return errPreparedAssetBindings
        }
        assetByID := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assetByID[asset.AssetID] = asset
            if err := validateBinding(asset.AssetID, asset.SHA256, asset.SizeBytes, bindings); err != nil {
                return err
            }
        }
        for _, track := range plan.VideoTracks {
            for _, segment := range track.Segments {
                asset, ok := assetByID[segment.AssetID]
                if !ok {
                    return fmt.Errorf("%w: segment asset_id=%q is not declared", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, segment.AssetID)
                }
                if err := validateBinding(segment.AssetID, asset.SHA256, asset.SizeBytes, bindings); err != nil {
                    return err
                }
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func validateBinding(assetID, wantSHA string, wantSize int64, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        binding, ok := bindings[assetID]
        if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q", errPreparedAssetBindings, assetID)
        }
        if strings.TrimSpace(binding.SHA256) == "" || binding.SHA256 != wantSHA || wantSize <= 0 || binding.Size != wantSize {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q declared metadata does not match plan", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, assetID)
        }
        info, err := os.Stat(binding.Path)
        if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() <= 0 {
            if err == nil {
                err = errors.New("file is empty or not regular")
            }
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q path: %v", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, assetID, err)
        }
        if info.Size() != wantSize {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q actual size=%d want=%d", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, assetID, info.Size(), wantSize)
        }
        if binding.Verified {
            return nil
        }
        file, err := os.Open(binding.Path)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q open: %v", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, assetID, err)
        }
        defer file.Close()
        hash := sha256.New()
        if _, err := io.Copy(hash, file); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q hash: %v", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, assetID, err)
        }
        actualSHA := hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
        if actualSHA != wantSHA || actualSHA != binding.SHA256 {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: asset_id=%q actual sha256=%s want=%s", errPreparedAssetIntegrity, assetID, actualSHA, wantSHA)
        }
        return nil
    }

        if strings.TrimSpace(jobID) == "" || jobID == "." || jobID == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(jobID) || strings.ContainsAny(jobID, "/\\\x00") || filepath.Base(jobID) != jobID {
            return "", errors.New("job_id must be a non-empty path-free identifier")
        }
        return jobID, nil
    }
