    package pipeline
    
    import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
    
        "velox-shared/assetref"
        "velox-shared/contract"
    )
    
    // resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets is the one V2 folder-resolution boundary.
    // It lists metadata only; media bytes remain worker-owned transfers.
    func (h *Handlers) resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets(ctx context.Context, req *SubmitJobRequest) error {
        if req == nil || req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON == "" {
            return nil
        }
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON))
        if err != nil {
            return nil // Canonical plan validation returns the structured V2 error later.
        }
        if plan.StockPool == nil {
            return nil
        }
        if h.stockFolderLister == nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool requires the Master Drive folder-listing capability")
        }
        folderURL := "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID
        folderID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFolderID(folderURL)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        files, err := listStockFolderVideos(ctx, h.stockFolderLister, folderID.String(), 0, make(map[string]struct{}))
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if len(files) == 0 {
            return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool Drive folder contains no video files")
        }
        runtimeAssets := append([]map[string]interface{}(nil), req.RuntimeAssets...)
        seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(runtimeAssets)+len(files))
        for _, asset := range runtimeAssets {
            if id, ok := asset["asset_id"].(string); ok {
                seen[id] = struct{}{}
            }
        }
        for _, file := range files {
            if _, exists := seen[file.ID]; exists {
                continue
            }
            asset := map[string]interface{}{
                "asset_id": file.ID, "asset_key": file.ID, "drive_file_id": file.ID,
                "url":        "velox-drive://" + file.ID,
                "source_uri": "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + file.ID,
                "kind":       "video", "stock_pool_member": true,
            }
            if file.Size > 0 {
                asset["size_bytes"] = file.Size
            }
            if file.VideoMediaMetadata.DurationMillis > 0 {
                asset["duration_ms"] = file.VideoMediaMetadata.DurationMillis
            }
            runtimeAssets = append(runtimeAssets, asset)
            seen[file.ID] = struct{}{}
        }
        req.RuntimeAssets = runtimeAssets
        // Ensure downstream payload projection sees the stable snapshot. The plan
        // remains byte-for-byte hash-bound; retries reuse the accepted runtime list.
        return nil
    }
    package contract
    
    import (
        "encoding/json"
        "strings"
    )
    
    const (
        VideoAssemblyCopyExecutorID  = "video.assemble.copy.v1"
        VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID = "video.assemble.slice.v1"
    )
    
    // RequiredVideoAssemblyExecutor is the single routing rule for compiled video
    // plans. Drive-backed video and stock-pool plans use the worker's source
    // resolver; plans containing only already-certified assets use packet-copy.
    func RequiredVideoAssemblyExecutor(payload map[string]interface{}) string {
        planJSON, _ := payload[PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string)
        var plan CompiledRenderPlanV2
        if strings.TrimSpace(planJSON) == "" || json.Unmarshal([]byte(planJSON), &plan) != nil {
            return ""
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
        }
        runtimeDriveIDs := compiledRuntimeDriveIDs(payload["runtime_assets"])
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            if asset.Kind != "video" {
                continue
            }
            if asset.SourceKind == "drive" || strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID) != "" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:") {
                return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
            }
            if runtimeDriveIDs[asset.AssetID] != "" || runtimeDriveIDs[asset.AssetKey] != "" {
                return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
            }
        }
        return VideoAssemblyCopyExecutorID
    }
    
    func compiledRuntimeDriveIDs(raw interface{}) map[string]string {
        encoded, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || string(encoded) == "null" {
            return nil
        }
        var assets []struct {
            AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
            AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
            DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
        }
        if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &assets) != nil {
            return nil
        }
        byIdentity := make(map[string]string, len(assets)*2)
        for _, asset := range assets {
            fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
            if fileID == "" {
                continue
            }
            for _, key := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
                if key = strings.TrimSpace(key); key != "" {
                    byIdentity[key] = fileID
                }
            }
        }
        return byIdentity
    }

        plan.canvas.fps_num = static_cast<int>(ju::extractJsonNumberValue(outputBlock, "fps_num", 0.0));
        plan.canvas.fps_den = static_cast<int>(ju::extractJsonNumberValue(outputBlock, "fps_den", 0.0));
        if (plan.canvas.width <= 0 || plan.canvas.height <= 0 ||
            plan.canvas.fps_num <= 0 || plan.canvas.fps_den <= 0) {
            std::cerr << "errore: CompiledRenderPlanV2 output must carry positive "

        }

        if (plan.canvas.fps <= 0) {

            return std::nullopt;

    // validateCopyOnlyProfile resolves the output's canonical profile and checks
    // every stream-identity field against it. The packet-copy path can only accept
    // streams produced under an admitted profile.
    func validateCopyOnlyProfile(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) (contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1, error) {
        if plan.Output.ProfileID == "" {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: output.profile_id is required", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch)
        }
        profile, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID)
        if err != nil {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch, err)
        }
        if err := profile.MatchesOutput(plan.Output); err != nil {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch, err)
        }
        if plan.Output.CodecProfile != profile.CodecProfile || plan.Output.CodecLevel != profile.CodecLevel || plan.Output.GOPSize != profile.GOPSize || plan.Output.BFrames != profile.BFrames || plan.Output.TimeBaseNum != profile.TimeBaseNum || plan.Output.TimeBaseDen != profile.TimeBaseDen || !plan.Output.ClosedGOP {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: output encoder/time-base fields do not match profile %q", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch, profile.ProfileID)
        }
        return profile, nil
    }
    
    // validateCopyOnlySegment certifies one prepared video fragment against its
    // declared asset manifest: the reference must exist, be a prepared-video kind,
    // and match the plan's timeline identity and frame bounds exactly.
    func validateCopyOnlySegment(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, profile contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1, assets map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, segment contract.VideoSegmentV2) error {
        asset, ok := assets[segment.AssetID]
        if !ok || (asset.Kind != "video" && asset.Kind != "prepared_video_fragment") {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: segment %q does not reference a prepared video asset", ErrCopyOnlyCertification, segment.SegmentID)
        }
        if asset.SHA256 != segment.SHA256 || asset.ProfileID != profile.StreamProfile() || asset.FrameCount != segment.FrameCount || asset.TimelineRevision != plan.TimelineRevision || asset.TimelineSHA256 != plan.TimelineSHA256 || asset.TimelineStartFrame != segment.TimelineStartFrame || asset.DurationUS != segment.SourceDurationUS || !asset.FirstFrameKeyframe || !asset.ClosedGOP || segment.SourceInUS != 0 {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: segment %q manifest binding is not exact", ErrCopyOnlyCertification, segment.SegmentID)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func validatePreparedAssetBindings(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) error {
        if err := validateCopyOnlyPlan(plan); err != nil {
            return err
        }
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            binding := bindings[segment.AssetID]
            if strings.TrimSpace(binding.Path) == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: missing binding for %q", ErrCopyOnlyCertification, segment.AssetID)
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    // normalizeSceneVideoPayloadContext validates and wraps producer-owned V2
    // bytes. It deliberately has no scene, overlay, media, or manifest compiler.
    func normalizeSceneVideoPayloadContext(ctx context.Context, payloadMap map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
        if payloadMap == nil {
            return nil, errors.New("compiled_render_plan_v2: payload is required")
        }
        for _, key := range []string{"scenes", "scenes_json", "render_manifest", "manifest_ref", "layers", "overlays", "visual_replacements", "items", "clips", "images", "voiceover_paths", "voiceover_path", "audio_path"} {

                return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationError(key, "is retired; submit the producer-compiled CompiledRenderPlanV2")
            }
        }
        base, err := contract.NewJobPayloadV2Checked(payloadMap)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        if err := contract.ValidateCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(payloadMap); err != nil {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationErrorWrapped("compiled_render_plan_v2", "producer plan validation failed", err)
        }
        if !compiledRenderPlanV2Present(payloadMap) {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationError("compiled_render_plan_v2", "producer-compiled plan and SHA are required")
        }
        base.VideoName = strings.TrimSpace(base.VideoName)
        if base.VideoName == "" {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationError("video_name", "is required")
        }
        base.ScriptText = strings.TrimSpace(base.ScriptText)
        if base.ScriptText == "" {
            base.ScriptText = base.VideoName
        }
        base.SetIdentity(base.JobID, base.JobRunID, base.CorrelationID)
        base.Version = "v2"
        base.Status = contract.InputAssemblyPending
        base.JobFingerprint = sceneVideoFingerprintContext(ctx, base.JobID, base.VideoName, base.ScriptText, base.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256)
    
        out, err := base.ToMap()
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        // These fields are control-plane or runtime binding metadata. Preserve
        // them without interpreting or modifying the compiled timeline.
        for key, value := range payloadMap {
            if strings.HasPrefix(key, "runtime_") || key == "publications" || key == "assembly" ||
                key == "_internal_forwarding_key" || key == "_placement_pin_worker_id" ||
                key == "source_provider" || key == "source_job_id" || key == "target_executor_id" || key == "delivery_plan" || key == "render_only" {
                if key == "_placement_pin_worker_id" {
                    if pin, ok := value.(string); ok {
                        value = strings.TrimSpace(pin)
                    }
                }
                out[key] = value
            }
        }
        if err := contract.ValidateCompiledRenderPlanV2Payload(out); err != nil {
            return nil, deliveryplan.NewValidationErrorWrapped("compiled_render_plan_v2", "normalized plan validation failed", err)
        }
        return out, nil
    }
    
    func compiledRenderPlanV2Present(payloadMap map[string]interface{}) bool {
        if payloadMap == nil {
            return false
        }
        _, hasJSON := payloadMap[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON]
        _, hasSHA := payloadMap[contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanSHA]
        return hasJSON || hasSHA
    }
    
    func resolveInternalExecutorID(payloadMap map[string]interface{}) string {
        if !compiledRenderPlanV2Present(payloadMap) {
            return ""
        }
        if executorID := contract.RequiredVideoAssemblyExecutor(payloadMap); executorID != "" {
            return executorID + "@1"
        }
        return canonicalCompiledPlanExecutor
    }
    
    func resolveRequiredCapabilities(executorID string) []string {
        if strings.HasPrefix(executorID, "video.assemble.copy.v1") || strings.HasPrefix(executorID, "video.assemble.slice.v1") {
            return []string{"artifact.commit.v1"}
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func sceneVideoFingerprintContext(ctx context.Context, parts ...interface{}) string {
        h := sha256.New()
        for _, part := range parts {
            switch value := part.(type) {
            case string:
                if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value); trimmed != "" {
                    h.Write([]byte(trimmed))
                }
            default:
                if part == nil {
                    continue
                }
                telemetry.RecordEnqueueJSONMarshal(ctx)
                if data, err := json.Marshal(part); err == nil {
                    h.Write(data)
                }
            }
            h.Write([]byte{0})
        }
        return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))[:32]
    }

        statusText, ok := rawStatus.(string)
        if !ok {
            return nil, domain.NewInvalidPayload("payload.status", "invalid", "status must be an input-assembly status")

        status, ok := contract.ParseInputAssemblyStatus(statusText)
        if !ok || status != contract.InputAssemblyCompleted {

    // FinalizeJobRequest carries runtime asset bindings for a producer-compiled
    // V2 plan. Timeline compilation belongs to the producer.
    type FinalizeJobRequest struct {
        IdempotencyKey string                   `json:"idempotency_key"`
        RuntimeAssets  []map[string]interface{} `json:"runtime_assets,omitempty"`
        RuntimePayload map[string]interface{}   `json:"runtime_payload,omitempty"`

    // PrepareJob handles the first stage of the two-stage intake. It uses the
    // canonical submission core, so delivery validation, asset normalization and
    // job idempotency remain identical to POST /api/v1/jobs.
    func (h *Handlers) PrepareJob() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
            var req SubmitJobRequest
            if err := decodeStrictJSON(c.Request.Body, &req); err != nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "invalid_json", "message": "request body must be valid JSON without unknown fields: " + err.Error()})
                return
            }
            req.RuntimeAssetsPending = !runtimeAssetsCompleteForPrepare(req)
            out := h.submitJobCore(c.Request.Context(), req, intakeIdentity{
                ClientID:     ClientIDFromContext(c),
                IntakeSource: creatorflow.IntakeSourceCanonical,
                Phase:        "PREPARE",
                Quota:        KeyFromContext(c),
            })
            if out.Status < http.StatusMultipleChoices {
                out.Body["phase"] = "PREPARE"
                if req.RuntimeAssetsPending {
                    out.Body["dispatch_status"] = "waiting_runtime_assets"
                } else {
                    out.Body["dispatch_status"] = "prefetch_queued"
                }
            }
            writeIntakeResponse(c, out)
        }
    }
    
    func runtimeAssetsCompleteForPrepare(req SubmitJobRequest) bool {
        complete := len(req.RuntimeAssets) > 0
        if runtimePayloadHasNonEmptyAssets(req.RuntimePayload) {
            complete = true
        }
        if req.RuntimeAssetsComplete != nil {
            complete = *req.RuntimeAssetsComplete
        }
        return complete
    }
    
    func runtimePayloadHasNonEmptyAssets(payload map[string]interface{}) bool {
        value, ok := payload["runtime_assets"]
        if !ok || value == nil {
            return false
        }
        switch assets := value.(type) {
        case []interface{}:
            return len(assets) > 0
        case []map[string]interface{}:
            return len(assets) > 0
        default:
            return false
        }
    }

    func (h *Handlers) FinalizeJob() gin.HandlerFunc {

                return
            }
            req.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(req.IdempotencyKey)
            if vErr, bad := ValidateIdempotencyKey(req.IdempotencyKey); bad {
                status, body := idempotencyKeyErrorEnvelope(vErr)
                c.JSON(status, body)
                return
            }
            if errs := ValidateRuntimeAssetSourceURLs(req.RuntimeAssets, h.cfg); len(errs) > 0 {
                status, body := ssrfValidationErrorEnvelope(errs)
                c.JSON(status, body)
                return
            }
            jobID := strings.TrimSpace(c.Param("id"))
            if jobID == "" {
                c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "job_id_required", "message": "URL path /api/v1/jobs/:id/finalize requires non-empty :id"})
                return
            }
    
            taskReader := h.jobs.TaskReader
            if taskReader == nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusServiceUnavailable, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "task_store_unavailable", "message": "two-stage task updates are not wired"})
                return
            }
            task, err := taskReader.GetByJobID(c.Request.Context(), jobID)
            if err != nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "store_failure", "message": err.Error()})
                return
            }
            if task == nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "job_not_found", "message": "job_id does not match any task"})
                return
            }

                return
            }
            if task.Status != taskgraph.StatusPending && task.Status != taskgraph.StatusReady {
                c.JSON(http.StatusConflict, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "job_already_leased", "message": "runtime assets must be finalized before the task is leased"})
                return
            }
            specStore, ok := taskReader.(taskgraph.TaskSpecStore)
            if !ok {
                c.JSON(http.StatusServiceUnavailable, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "task_store_unavailable", "message": "task spec runtime updates are not wired"})
                return
            }
            current, err := specStore.GetTaskSpecPayload(c.Request.Context(), task.ID)
            if err != nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "store_failure", "message": err.Error()})
                return
            }
            if previous, _ := current["runtime_finalize_idempotency_key"].(string); previous != "" && previous != req.IdempotencyKey {

                // prevented the original planner notification. Replays must re-drive
                // the refresh so the durable prefetch plan cannot remain stale.
                if h.enqueuer != nil {
                    h.enqueuer.NotifyTaskUpdated(c.Request.Context(), jobID)
                }
                logFinalizeAccepted(jobID, req, current, true)
                c.JSON(http.StatusAccepted, gin.H{"ok": true, "job_id": jobID, "phase": "FINALIZE", "dispatch_status": "prefetch_refresh_queued", "idempotent": true})
                return
            }
    
            patch := make(map[string]interface{}, len(req.RuntimePayload)+4)
            for key, value := range req.RuntimePayload {
                if key == "runtime_assets_pending" || key == "runtime_finalize_idempotency_key" {
                    continue
                }
                patch[key] = value
            }
            if len(req.RuntimeAssets) > 0 {
                patch["runtime_assets"] = req.RuntimeAssets
            }
            patch["runtime_assets_pending"] = false
            patch["runtime_finalize_idempotency_key"] = req.IdempotencyKey
            if _, err := specStore.MergeTaskSpecPayload(c.Request.Context(), task.ID, patch); err != nil {
                status := http.StatusConflict
                if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not initialized") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not found") {
                    status = http.StatusInternalServerError
                }
                c.JSON(status, gin.H{"ok": false, "error": "runtime_payload_update_failed", "message": err.Error()})
                return
            }
            if h.enqueuer != nil {
                h.enqueuer.NotifyTaskUpdated(c.Request.Context(), jobID)
            }
            logFinalizeAccepted(jobID, req, current, false)
            c.JSON(http.StatusAccepted, gin.H{
                "ok": true, "job_id": jobID, "phase": "FINALIZE",
                "dispatch_status":   "prefetch_refresh_queued",
                "future_asset_plan": "refresh",
                "idempotency_key":   req.IdempotencyKey,
            })
        }
    }
    
    func logFinalizeAccepted(jobID string, req FinalizeJobRequest, payload map[string]interface{}, idempotent bool) {
        correlationID, _ := payload["correlation_id"].(string)
        project := intakeProjectLabel(SubmitJobRequest{RuntimePayload: req.RuntimePayload}, payload)
        pipelineLog(
            "API_V1_JOBS_ACCEPTED phase=FINALIZE job_id=%s correlation_id=%s project=%q idem_hash=%s idempotent=%t",
            jobID,
            correlationID,
            project,
            logHashShort(req.IdempotencyKey),
            idempotent,
        )
    }
    
    func writeIntakeResponse(c *gin.Context, out intakeResponse) {
        for key, values := range out.Header {
            for _, value := range values {
                c.Header(key, value)
            }
        }
        if out.Location != "" {
            c.Header("Location", out.Location)
        }
        if out.Usage != nil {
            SetUsageStats(c, out.Usage.Scenes, out.Usage.TotalDurationSeconds)
        }
        c.JSON(out.Status, out.Body)
    }

        planJSON, _ := payload[PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON].(string)
        var plan CompiledRenderPlanV2
        if strings.TrimSpace(planJSON) == "" || json.Unmarshal([]byte(planJSON), &plan) != nil {
            return ""
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
        }
        runtimeDriveIDs := compiledRuntimeDriveIDs(payload["runtime_assets"])
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            if asset.Kind != "video" {
                continue
            }
            if asset.SourceKind == "drive" || strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID) != "" || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)), "drive:") {
                return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
            }
            if runtimeDriveIDs[asset.AssetID] != "" || runtimeDriveIDs[asset.AssetKey] != "" {
                return VideoAssemblySliceExecutorID
            }
        }
        return VideoAssemblyCopyExecutorID
    }
    
    func compiledRuntimeDriveIDs(raw interface{}) map[string]string {
        encoded, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil || len(encoded) == 0 || string(encoded) == "null" {
            return nil
        }
        var assets []struct {
            AssetID     string `json:"asset_id"`
            AssetKey    string `json:"asset_key"`
            DriveFileID string `json:"drive_file_id"`
        }
        if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &assets) != nil {
            return nil
        }
        byIdentity := make(map[string]string, len(assets)*2)
        for _, asset := range assets {
            fileID := strings.TrimSpace(asset.DriveFileID)
            if fileID == "" {
                continue
            }
            for _, key := range []string{asset.AssetID, asset.AssetKey} {
                if key = strings.TrimSpace(key); key != "" {
                    byIdentity[key] = fileID
                }
            }
        }
        return byIdentity
    }

    // resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets is the one V2 folder-resolution boundary.
    // It lists metadata only; media bytes remain worker-owned transfers.
    func (h *Handlers) resolveStockPoolRuntimeAssets(ctx context.Context, req *SubmitJobRequest) error {
        if req == nil || req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON == "" {
            return nil
        }
        plan, err := contract.DecodeCompiledRenderPlanV2([]byte(req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON))
        if err != nil {
            return nil // Canonical plan validation returns the structured V2 error later.
        }
        if plan.StockPool == nil {
            return nil
        }
        if h.stockFolderLister == nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool requires the Master Drive folder-listing capability")
        }
        folderURL := "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID
        folderID, err := assetref.ParseDriveFolderID(folderURL)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        files, err := listStockFolderVideos(ctx, h.stockFolderLister, folderID.String(), 0, make(map[string]struct{}))
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if len(files) == 0 {
            return fmt.Errorf("stock_pool Drive folder contains no video files")
        }
        runtimeAssets := append([]map[string]interface{}(nil), req.RuntimeAssets...)
        seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(runtimeAssets)+len(files))
        for _, asset := range runtimeAssets {
            if id, ok := asset["asset_id"].(string); ok {
                seen[id] = struct{}{}
            }
        }
        for _, file := range files {
            if _, exists := seen[file.ID]; exists {
                continue
            }
            asset := map[string]interface{}{
                "asset_id": file.ID, "asset_key": file.ID, "drive_file_id": file.ID,
                "url":        "velox-drive://" + file.ID,
                "source_uri": "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=" + file.ID,
                "kind":       "video", "stock_pool_member": true,
            }
            if file.Size > 0 {
                asset["size_bytes"] = file.Size
            }
            if file.VideoMediaMetadata.DurationMillis > 0 {
                asset["duration_ms"] = file.VideoMediaMetadata.DurationMillis
            }
            runtimeAssets = append(runtimeAssets, asset)
            seen[file.ID] = struct{}{}
        }
        req.RuntimeAssets = runtimeAssets
        // Ensure downstream payload projection sees the stable snapshot. The plan
        // remains byte-for-byte hash-bound; retries reuse the accepted runtime list.
        return nil
    }

    const (
        VideoAssembleSliceID      = "video.assemble.slice.v1"
        VideoAssembleSliceVersion = 1
    )
    
    // videoAssembleSliceExecutor copies compatible source packets from verified
    // runtime assets in the worker cache into the final mux. It never encodes.
    type videoAssembleSliceExecutor struct {
        runner     *pipeline.Runner
        prober     sliceMediaProber
        outputRoot string
    }
    
    type sliceMediaProber interface {
        ProbeMediaDetails(context.Context, string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error)
    }
    
    type ffprobeSliceMediaProber struct{}
    
    func (ffprobeSliceMediaProber) ProbeMediaDetails(ctx context.Context, path string) (publisher.MediaProbe, error) {
        return publisher.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, path)
    }
    
    func NewVideoAssembleSlice(outputRoot string, runner *pipeline.Runner) executor.Executor {
        if strings.TrimSpace(outputRoot) == "" {
            outputRoot = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "velox", "video-assemble-slice")
        }
        return &videoAssembleSliceExecutor{runner: runner, prober: ffprobeSliceMediaProber{}, outputRoot: outputRoot}
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Descriptor() executor.Descriptor {
        return executor.Descriptor{
            ID: VideoAssembleSliceID, Version: VideoAssembleSliceVersion,
            InputTypes: []string{"render.compiled.v2.drive"}, OutputTypes: []string{"video/mp4"},
            ResourceClass: executor.ResourceCPU, Deterministic: true, Cacheable: true,
            TemporalMode: executor.TemporalGlobal,
        }
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Validate(spec executor.TaskSpec) error {
        if spec.ExecutorID != VideoAssembleSliceID {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: executor_id must be %q", VideoAssembleSliceID)
        }
        if e == nil || e.runner == nil || e.runner.RenderClient() == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: native packet-copy renderer is not configured")
        }
        if e.prober == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: FFprobe media validation is not configured")
        }
        plan, err := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: invalid CompiledRenderPlanV2: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: canonical output profile required: %w", err)
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        runtimeDriveIDs := sliceRuntimeDriveFileIDs(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        hasDrive := plan.StockPool != nil
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
            driveSource := asset.Kind == "video" && isSliceDriveSource(asset, runtimeDriveIDs)
            hasDrive = hasDrive || driveSource
        }
        if !hasDrive {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: plan must contain at least one Drive video source")
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || (len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 && plan.StockPool == nil) {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: exactly one video track is required; segments or stock_pool must be supplied")
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            members := 0
            for _, item := range sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"]) {
                if item.StockPoolMember && strings.TrimSpace(item.DriveFileID) != "" {
                    members++
                }
            }
            if members == 0 {
                return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: Master did not resolve any stock_pool files")
            }
        }
        var nextFrame int64
        stockPoolSlots := 0
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            if segment.StockPoolSlot {
                if plan.StockPool == nil {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q has stock_pool_slot without stock_pool", segment.SegmentID)
                }
                stockPoolSlots++
                if segment.FrameCount <= 0 {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: stock pool slot %q has invalid frame count", segment.SegmentID)
                }
            } else {
                asset, ok := assets[segment.AssetID]
                if !ok || (asset.Kind != "video" && asset.Kind != "prepared_video_fragment") {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q must reference a video asset", segment.SegmentID)
                }
                if asset.ProfileID != plan.Output.ProfileID || asset.FrameCount <= 0 || !asset.FirstFrameKeyframe || !asset.ClosedGOP {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: asset %q is not certified for packet-copy assembly", segment.AssetID)
                }
                if segment.SourceInUS != 0 {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q starts at a non-keyframe offset (%d us); packet-copy is unsafe", segment.SegmentID, segment.SourceInUS)
                }
                if segment.FrameCount <= 0 || segment.FrameCount > asset.FrameCount {
                    return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q frame count %d exceeds certified source frames %d", segment.SegmentID, segment.FrameCount, asset.FrameCount)
                }
            }
            if segment.TimelineStartFrame != nextFrame {
                return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: segment %q leaves a timeline gap or overlap at frame %d", segment.SegmentID, nextFrame)
            }
            nextFrame += segment.FrameCount
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil && stockPoolSlots == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.slice.v1: stock_pool requires at least one stock slot")
        }
        framesNum := int64(plan.DurationUS) * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
        framesDen := int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000
        wantFrames := (framesNum + framesDen - 1) / framesDen
        if nextFrame != wantFrames {
            return fmt.Errorf("video.assemble.slice.v1: timeline has %d frames, plan duration requires %d", nextFrame, wantFrames)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) Execute(ctx context.Context, execCtx executor.ExecutionContext, spec executor.TaskSpec) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
        started := time.Now().UTC()
        fail := func(code string, err error) (executor.ExecutionResult, error) {
            return executor.ExecutionResult{Status: "failed", ErrorCode: code, ErrorDetail: err.Error(), StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC()}, nil
        }
        if err := e.Validate(spec); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        plan, _ := decodeCompiledPlanV2(spec)
        bindings, ok := runtimeassets.FromContext(ctx)
        if !ok {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_MISSING", errors.New("verified runtime asset bindings are required"))
        }
        if plan.StockPool != nil {
            compiled, err := e.compileStockPoolPlan(ctx, spec, plan, bindings)
            if err != nil {
                return fail("DRIVE_STOCK_POOL_INCOMPATIBLE", err)
            }
            plan = compiled
        }
        if err := validateCopyOnlyPlan(plan); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        audio, ok := bindings[plan.FinalAudio.AssetID]
        if !ok || !audio.Verified || audio.Size <= 0 || audio.SHA256 == "" || audio.SHA256 != plan.FinalAudio.SHA256 || audio.Size != plan.FinalAudio.SizeBytes {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", errors.New("final audio integrity binding does not match the plan"))
        }
        if info, statErr := os.Stat(audio.Path); statErr != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() != audio.Size {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_ASSETS_INVALID", errors.New("final audio local file identity is invalid"))
        }
        jobID, err := safeOutputJobID(spec.JobID)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("INVALID_JOB_ID", err)
        }
        outputPath := filepath.Join(e.outputRoot, jobID+".mp4")
        if resolver := storageResolverFromExecutionContext(execCtx); resolver != nil {
            if placement, placeErr := resolver.Place(storage.ArtifactStaging, jobID+".mp4", estimateOutputBytesFromDuration(plan.DurationUS)); placeErr == nil {
                outputPath = placement.Path
            }
        }
        if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(outputPath), 0o750); err != nil {
            return fail("OUTPUT_DIRECTORY", err)
        }
        wire, err := marshalCopyOnlyWire(plan, spec.JobID, outputPath, bindings)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_PLAN_INVALID", err)
        }
        metrics, renderErr := e.runner.RenderCompiledPlanV2(ctx, wire, outputPath)
        if renderErr != nil {
            return fail(copyOnlyRenderErrorCode(renderErr), renderErr)
        }
        if err := e.verifyFinalMedia(ctx, outputPath, plan); err != nil {
            return fail("DRIVE_SLICE_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        artifact, err := artifactFromFile("video/mp4", outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fail("FINAL_OUTPUT_INVALID", err)
        }
        raw := copyOnlyRawMetrics(plan, metrics, artifact)
        return executor.ExecutionResult{
            Status: "succeeded", Outputs: []executor.ArtifactRef{artifact}, RawMetrics: raw,
            Segments: projectSegments(metrics), DetailedPhases: projectDetailedPhases(metrics),
            StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
        }, nil
    }
    
    type slicePoolMember struct {
        AssetID         string `json:"asset_id"`
        DriveFileID     string `json:"drive_file_id"`
        SizeBytes       int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
        DurationMS      int64  `json:"duration_ms"`
        StockPoolMember bool   `json:"stock_pool_member"`
    }
    
    func sliceRuntimePoolMembers(raw interface{}) []slicePoolMember {
        data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        var members []slicePoolMember
        _ = json.Unmarshal(data, &members)
        return members
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) compileStockPoolPlan(_ context.Context, spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        if plan.StockPool == nil || plan.StockPool.Selection != "shuffle" {
            return nil, errors.New("unsupported stock_pool selection")
        }
        members := sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        ordered := make([]slicePoolMember, 0, len(members))
        for _, member := range members {
            binding, selected := bindings["stockpool:"+member.DriveFileID]
            if member.StockPoolMember && selected && binding.Verified && binding.Size > 0 && member.DurationMS > 0 {
                ordered = append(ordered, member)
            }
        }
        if len(ordered) == 0 {
            return nil, errors.New("stock_pool has no selected sources with Drive duration metadata")
        }
        sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].DriveFileID < ordered[j].DriveFileID })
        seedBytes := sha256.Sum256([]byte(spec.JobID + ":" + plan.TimelineSHA256 + ":" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID))
        rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(seedBytes[:8]))))
        rng.Shuffle(len(ordered), func(i, j int) { ordered[i], ordered[j] = ordered[j], ordered[i] })
        compiled := *plan
        compiled.StockPool = nil
        compiled.Assets = append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        compiled.VideoTracks = append([]contract.VideoTrackV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks...)
        for i := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            compiled.VideoTracks[i].Segments = append([]contract.VideoSegmentV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks[i].Segments...)
        }
        poolCursor := 0
        framesLeft := make(map[string]int64, len(ordered))
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            framesLeft[assetID] = member.DurationMS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum) / (1000 * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen))
        }
        for trackIndex := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            segments := make([]contract.VideoSegmentV2, 0, len(compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments))
            for _, segment := range compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments {
                if !segment.StockPoolSlot {
                    segments = append(segments, segment)
                    continue
                }
                remaining, timelineFrame := segment.FrameCount, segment.TimelineStartFrame
                part := 0
                for remaining > 0 {
                    for poolCursor < len(ordered) && framesLeft["stockpool:"+ordered[poolCursor].DriveFileID] <= 0 {
                        poolCursor++
                    }
                    if poolCursor >= len(ordered) {
                        return nil, errors.New("selected stock pool duration is shorter than its timeline slots")
                    }
                    member := ordered[poolCursor]
                    part++
                    baseAssetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
                    binding := bindings[baseAssetID]
                    count := framesLeft[baseAssetID]
                    if count > remaining {
                        count = remaining
                    }
                    assetID := fmt.Sprintf("%s:timeline:%d", baseAssetID, timelineFrame)
                    durationUS := count * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
                    asset := contract.AssetRefV2{AssetID: assetID, AssetKey: member.DriveFileID, SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: member.DriveFileID, SHA256: binding.SHA256, SizeBytes: binding.Size, Kind: "video", MIME: "video/mp4", ProfileID: plan.Output.ProfileID, FrameCount: count, TimelineRevision: plan.TimelineRevision, TimelineSHA256: plan.TimelineSHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FirstFrameKeyframe: true, ClosedGOP: true, DurationUS: durationUS, Width: plan.Output.Width, Height: plan.Output.Height}
                    compiled.Assets = append(compiled.Assets, asset)
                    bindings[assetID] = binding
                    segments = append(segments, contract.VideoSegmentV2{SegmentID: fmt.Sprintf("%s-source-%03d", segment.SegmentID, part), AssetID: assetID, SHA256: asset.SHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FrameCount: count, SourceDurationUS: durationUS})
                    framesLeft[baseAssetID] -= count
                    remaining -= count
                    timelineFrame += count
                    if framesLeft[baseAssetID] == 0 {
                        poolCursor++
                    }
                }
            }
            compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments = segments
        }
        return &compiled, nil
    }
    
    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) verifyFinalMedia(ctx context.Context, outputPath string, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        probe, err := e.prober.ProbeMediaDetails(ctx, outputPath)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("probe assembled output: %w", err)
        }
        if !probe.HasVideo || !probe.HasAudio || probe.VideoCodec != "h264" || probe.AudioCodec != "aac" || probe.Width != plan.Output.Width || probe.Height != plan.Output.Height {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output streams/profile invalid: video=%t/%s audio=%t/%s size=%dx%d want=h264/aac %dx%d", probe.HasVideo, probe.VideoCodec, probe.HasAudio, probe.AudioCodec, probe.Width, probe.Height, plan.Output.Width, plan.Output.Height)
        }
        if probe.VideoFrameCount != slicePlanFrameCount(plan) {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output has %d frames, plan requires %d; refusing to publish", probe.VideoFrameCount, slicePlanFrameCount(plan))
        }
        wantDuration := float64(plan.DurationUS) / 1_000_000
        frameTolerance := float64(plan.Output.FPSDen)/float64(plan.Output.FPSNum) + 0.1
        if probe.DurationSec <= 0 || probe.DurationSec-wantDuration > frameTolerance || wantDuration-probe.DurationSec > frameTolerance {
            return fmt.Errorf("assembled output duration %.3fs does not match plan %.3fs (tolerance %.3fs)", probe.DurationSec, wantDuration, frameTolerance)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func slicePlanFrameCount(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) int64 {
        var frames int64
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            frames += segment.FrameCount
        }
        return frames
    }

    package pipeline
    
    import (

    func projectWorkerPayload(req *SubmitJobRequest) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
        return contract.RenderOnlyPayload(submitRequestToRawPayload(req))
    }
    
    // submitRequestToRawPayload projects only the V2 execution bytes and fields
    // needed by enqueue. Publication and routing intents remain control-plane data.
    func submitRequestToRawPayload(req *SubmitJobRequest) map[string]interface{} {
        if req == nil {
            return map[string]interface{}{}
        }
        raw := map[string]interface{}{
            "job_id":      req.IdempotencyKey,
            "video_name":  req.VideoName,
            "script_text": req.ScriptText,
            contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanJSON: req.CompiledRenderPlanJSON,
            contract.PayloadKeyCompiledRenderPlanSHA:  req.CompiledRenderPlanSHA256,
        }
        if req.JobType != "" {
            raw["job_type"] = req.JobType
        }
        if req.RenderOnly {
            raw["render_only"] = true
        }
        if req.RuntimeAssets != nil {
            raw["runtime_assets"] = req.RuntimeAssets
        }
        if req.RuntimePayload != nil {
            raw["runtime_payload"] = req.RuntimePayload
        }
        if req.RuntimeAssetsPending {
            raw["runtime_assets_pending"] = true
        }
        if pin := req.PlacementPinWorkerID; pin != "" {
            raw["_placement_pin_worker_id"] = pin
        }
        if len(req.DeliveryPlan) > 0 {
            entries := make([]interface{}, 0, len(req.DeliveryPlan))
            for _, entry := range req.DeliveryPlan {
                retryBudget := DefaultRetryBudget
                if entry.RetryBudget != nil {
                    retryBudget = *entry.RetryBudget
                }
                entries = append(entries, map[string]interface{}{
                    "destination_id": entry.DestinationID,
                    "priority":       entry.Priority,
                    "retry_budget":   retryBudget,
                    "metadata":       entry.Metadata,
                })
            }
            raw["delivery_plan"] = entries
        }
        return raw
    }

## Assistant

Nel contratto attuale r40, i metadati `role=stock` arrivano solo alla finalizzazione, dopo che il Master ha già scelto `video.assemble.copy.v1`. Il worker poi riceve finestre stock spezzate dagli overlay e il copy executor le rifiuta perché la certificazione del segmento non coincide col file Drive intero. Sto correggendo il percorso nel codice Velox: il Master deve riconoscere lo stock quando finalizza e il worker deve trattare quelle sorgenti come pool, senza probe dei singoli file.

    // Reader is the read-only task query surface.
    type Reader interface {
        // Get returns a single task by ID, or (nil, nil) on missing.
        Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*Task, error)
    
        // List returns tasks matching the filter.
        List(ctx context.Context, filter Filter) ([]Task, error)

        // until the fan-out enqueue path lands; the method returns the first
        // task row for the job.
        GetByJobID(ctx context.Context, jobID string) (*Task, error)
    }
    
    // TaskSpecStore is the narrow control-plane surface used by the two-stage
    // intake. It updates the payload of the existing task while the task is still
    // PENDING or READY; it never creates a second Job/Task identity.
    type TaskSpecStore interface {
        GetTaskSpecPayload(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (map[string]interface{}, error)
        MergeTaskSpecPayload(ctx context.Context, taskID string, patch map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error)
    }
    
    // Writer is the canonical write-only task mutation surface.

    func (r *SQLiteTaskRepository) GetTaskSpecPayload(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
        if r == nil || r.store == nil || r.store.db == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("task spec store: not initialized")
        }
        var encoded string
        if err := r.store.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(payload_json, '{}') FROM task_specs WHERE task_id = ?`, taskID).Scan(&encoded); err != nil {
            if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("task spec store: task %q not found", taskID)
            }
            return nil, wrapDBInfrastructure("task spec read", err)
        }
        payload := make(map[string]interface{})
        if encoded != "" && encoded != "{}" {
            if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(encoded), &payload); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("task spec store: decode task %q payload: %w", taskID, err)
            }
        }
        return payload, nil
    }
    
    // MergeTaskSpecPayload applies a top-level runtime patch to the existing
    // renderer payload. The task identity is deliberately unchanged: this is the
    // PREPARE -> FINALIZE transition of one job, not a second enqueue.
    //
    // Only PENDING and READY tasks can be finalized. Once a worker has leased the
    // task, changing its immutable render input would make the attempt ambiguous.
    func (r *SQLiteTaskRepository) MergeTaskSpecPayload(ctx context.Context, taskID string, patch map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
        if r == nil || r.store == nil || r.store.db == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("task spec store: not initialized")
        }
        if taskID == "" {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("task spec store: task_id is required")
        }
        if patch == nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("task spec store: patch is required")
        }
    
        // Acquire SQLite's write reservation before reading the task/spec rows.
        // A deferred transaction can read a WAL snapshot, lose a race to the
        // future-asset planner (or another writer), then fail immediately with
        // SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT when it upgrades to a write transaction. FINALIZE
        // must be atomic with respect to leasing and planner writes, so begin an
        // IMMEDIATE transaction on a pinned connection before the read.
        conn, err := r.store.db.Conn(ctx)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, wrapDBInfrastructure("task spec merge connection", err)
        }
        defer conn.Close()
        if _, err := conn.ExecContext(ctx, `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`); err != nil {
            return nil, wrapDBInfrastructure("task spec merge begin immediate", err)
        }
        committed := false
        defer func() {
            if !committed {
                _, _ = conn.ExecContext(context.Background(), `ROLLBACK`)
            }
        }()
    
        var jobID, executorID, status, payloadJSON string
        var specVersion int

    func firstNonBlank(values ...string) string {
        for _, value := range values {
            if value = strings.TrimSpace(value); value != "" {
                return value
            }
        }
        return ""
    }
    
    func hashLocalAsset(path string) (string, int64, error) {
        f, err := os.Open(path)
        if err != nil {
            return "", 0, err
        }
        defer f.Close()
        h := sha256.New()
        size, err := io.Copy(h, f)
        if err != nil {
            return "", 0, err
        }
        if size <= 0 {
            return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("downloaded file is empty")
        }
        return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), size, nil
    }

    // compiledAssetIdentity is the one V2-to-cache identity rule. AssetKey is
    // optional for backwards-compatible plans; when omitted, AssetID is the
    // canonical cache key as well as the runtime binding key.
    func compiledAssetIdentity(asset contract.AssetRefV2) string {
        identity := strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetKey)
        if identity == "" {
            identity = strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)
        }
        if wireID, ok := assetref.WireAssetID(identity); ok {
            return wireID
        }
        return identity
    }
    
    func compiledAssetReference(asset contract.AssetRefV2) string {
        raw := strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetKey)
        if raw == "" {
            raw = strings.TrimSpace(asset.AssetID)
        }
        if _, ok := assetref.WireAssetID(raw); ok {
            return raw
        }
        return assetref.SchemeVeloxAsset + "://" + compiledAssetIdentity(asset)
    }

    func marshalCopyOnlyWire(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, jobID, outputPath string, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) ([]byte, error) {

    // copyOnlyRenderErrorCode classifies a native copy-only render failure into
    // a stable worker-facing error code. The native engine already fails closed
    // for every packet-mux rejection (it never re-encodes), but it reports them
    // all under a generic packet_mux_failed code; the worker re-classifies the
    // keyframe-safety rejection so operators can distinguish "the cut is not
    // packet-copy safe" from an unrelated mux failure without losing the exact
    // engine reason.
    func copyOnlyRenderErrorCode(err error) string {
        if err == nil {
            return "PACKET_COPY_FAILED"
        }
        lower := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
        if strings.Contains(lower, "must start on an exact video keyframe") ||
            strings.Contains(lower, "not keyframe-safe for packet copy") {
            return "COPY_ONLY_NOT_KEYFRAME_SAFE"
        }
        return "PACKET_COPY_FAILED"
    }
    
    func validateCopyOnlyPlan(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) error {
        if plan == nil {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.copy.v1: plan is nil")
        }
        profile, err := validateCopyOnlyProfile(plan)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if len(plan.VideoTracks) != 1 || len(plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments) == 0 {
            return errors.New("video.assemble.copy.v1: exactly one non-empty video track is required")
        }
        assets := make(map[string]contract.AssetRefV2, len(plan.Assets))
        for _, asset := range plan.Assets {
            assets[asset.AssetID] = asset
        }
        for _, segment := range plan.VideoTracks[0].Segments {
            if err := validateCopyOnlySegment(plan, profile, assets, segment); err != nil {
                return err
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    // validateCopyOnlyProfile resolves the output's canonical profile and checks
    // every stream-identity field against it. The packet-copy path can only accept
    // streams produced under an admitted profile.
    func validateCopyOnlyProfile(plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) (contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1, error) {
        if plan.Output.ProfileID == "" {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: output.profile_id is required", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch)
        }
        profile, err := contract.KnownCanonicalVideoProfileV1(plan.Output.ProfileID)
        if err != nil {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch, err)
        }
        if err := profile.MatchesOutput(plan.Output); err != nil {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch, err)
        }
        if plan.Output.CodecProfile != profile.CodecProfile || plan.Output.CodecLevel != profile.CodecLevel || plan.Output.GOPSize != profile.GOPSize || plan.Output.BFrames != profile.BFrames || plan.Output.TimeBaseNum != profile.TimeBaseNum || plan.Output.TimeBaseDen != profile.TimeBaseDen || !plan.Output.ClosedGOP {
            return contract.CanonicalVideoProfileV1{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: output encoder/time-base fields do not match profile %q", ErrCopyOnlyProfileMismatch, profile.ProfileID)
        }
        return profile, nil
    }

        // AudioModeFinalAudioCopy is the wire value for an already-finalized
        // audio asset that must be muxed without another mix or encode.
        AudioModeFinalAudioCopy = "FINAL_AUDIO_COPY"
    
        // AudioModeFinalAudioCopyV2 is retained as an explicit V2-named alias for
        // callers that prefer versioned constants; both names have one wire value.
        AudioModeFinalAudioCopyV2 = AudioModeFinalAudioCopy
    )
    
    // CompiledRenderPlanV2 is the canonical, producer-compiled execution plan.
    // It contains editorial decisions and verified asset identity only; job and
    // attempt identity remain in the surrounding TaskSpec so retries and workers
    // can consume the same plan bytes and plan hash.
    type CompiledRenderPlanV2 struct {
        PlanVersion      int              `json:"plan_version"`
        TimelineRevision int64            `json:"timeline_revision"`
        TimelineSHA256   string           `json:"timeline_sha256"`
        DurationUS       int64            `json:"duration_us"`
        Output           OutputContractV2 `json:"output"`
        FinalAudio       FinalAudioV2     `json:"final_audio"`
        VideoTracks      []VideoTrackV2   `json:"video_tracks"`
        // StockPool declares that the worker selects source videos from one Drive
        // folder at execution time. The folder is expanded by the Master into
        // runtime_assets; the producer never assigns individual files to scenes.
        StockPool *StockPoolV2 `json:"stock_pool,omitempty"`
        Assets    []AssetRefV2 `json:"assets"`
    }
    
    // StockPoolV2 is the single canonical stock selection rule for a job.
    // Selection is deterministic per job so retries reproduce the same edit.
    type StockPoolV2 struct {
        SourceKind    string `json:"source_kind"`
        DriveFolderID string `json:"drive_folder_id"`
        Selection     string `json:"selection"`
    }
    
    // OutputContractV2 describes the normalized output timeline and container.
    type OutputContractV2 struct {
        Container   string `json:"container"`
        VideoCodec  string `json:"video_codec"`
        Width       int    `json:"width"`
        Height      int    `json:"height"`
        FPSNum      int    `json:"fps_num"`
        FPSDen      int    `json:"fps_den"`
        PixelFormat string `json:"pixel_format,omitempty"`
    
        // Strengthened canonical-profile fields. The native packet-copy executor
        // validates the complete profile before execution.
        ProfileID    string `json:"profile_id,omitempty"`
        CodecProfile string `json:"codec_profile,omitempty"`
        CodecLevel   string `json:"codec_level,omitempty"`
        GOPSize      int    `json:"gop_size,omitempty"`
        // b_frames is required by the native canonical-profile parser even when
        // the canonical value is zero; omitting it would make Go's canonical JSON
        // differ from the C++ wire contract.
        BFrames     int  `json:"b_frames"`
        ClosedGOP   bool `json:"closed_gop,omitempty"`
        TimeBaseNum int  `json:"time_base_num,omitempty"`
        TimeBaseDen int  `json:"time_base_den,omitempty"`
    }
    
    // FinalAudioV2 identifies the one already-finalized audio source for the
    // output. Its timeline revision and hash bind it to the same editorial
    // timeline as the enclosing plan.
    type FinalAudioV2 struct {
        Mode string `json:"mode"`
    
        AssetID   string `json:"asset_id"`
        SHA256    string `json:"sha256"`
        SizeBytes int64  `json:"size_bytes"`
    
        Codec        string `json:"codec"`
        SampleRateHz int    `json:"sample_rate_hz"`
        Channels     int    `json:"channels"`
    
        DurationUS int64 `json:"duration_us"`
    
        TimelineRevision int64  `json:"timeline_revision"`
        TimelineSHA256   string `json:"timeline_sha256"`
    }

    +// adaptRuntimeStockPoolPlan adapts the legacy two-stage envelope where the
    +// producer plan names individual stock assets and FINALIZE supplies their
    +// Drive locators. Only stock references become worker-selected slots.
    +func adaptRuntimeStockPoolPlan(spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2) *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2 {
    +	if plan == nil || plan.StockPool != nil {
    +		return plan
    +	}
    +	byID := make(map[string]struct{})
    +	for _, member := range sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"]) {
    +		if !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(member.Role), "stock") || strings.TrimSpace(member.DriveFileID) == "" || member.DurationMS <= 0 {

    +		}

    +		if member.AssetKey != "" { byID[member.AssetKey] = struct{}{} }
    +	}

    +	compiled := *plan

    +			segment.StockPoolSlot = true
    +			changed = true
    +		}
    +	}
    +	if !changed { return plan }
    +	return &compiled

    func sliceRuntimePoolMembers(raw interface{}) []slicePoolMember {
        data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
        if err != nil {
            return nil
        }
        var members []slicePoolMember
        _ = json.Unmarshal(data, &members)

    func (e *videoAssembleSliceExecutor) compileStockPoolPlan(_ context.Context, spec executor.TaskSpec, plan *contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, bindings runtimeassets.Bindings) (*contract.CompiledRenderPlanV2, error) {
        if plan.StockPool == nil || plan.StockPool.Selection != "shuffle" {
            return nil, errors.New("unsupported stock_pool selection")
        }
        members := sliceRuntimePoolMembers(spec.Payload["runtime_assets"])
        ordered := make([]slicePoolMember, 0, len(members))
        for _, member := range members {
            binding, selected := bindings["stockpool:"+member.DriveFileID]
            if member.StockPoolMember && selected && binding.Verified && binding.Size > 0 && member.DurationMS > 0 {
                ordered = append(ordered, member)
            }
        }
        if len(ordered) == 0 {
            return nil, errors.New("stock_pool has no selected sources with Drive duration metadata")
        }
        sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].DriveFileID < ordered[j].DriveFileID })
        seedBytes := sha256.Sum256([]byte(spec.JobID + ":" + plan.TimelineSHA256 + ":" + plan.StockPool.DriveFolderID))
        rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(seedBytes[:8]))))
        rng.Shuffle(len(ordered), func(i, j int) { ordered[i], ordered[j] = ordered[j], ordered[i] })
        compiled := *plan
        compiled.StockPool = nil
        compiled.Assets = append([]contract.AssetRefV2(nil), plan.Assets...)
        compiled.VideoTracks = append([]contract.VideoTrackV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks...)
        for i := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            compiled.VideoTracks[i].Segments = append([]contract.VideoSegmentV2(nil), plan.VideoTracks[i].Segments...)
        }
        poolCursor := 0
        framesLeft := make(map[string]int64, len(ordered))
        for _, member := range ordered {
            assetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
            framesLeft[assetID] = member.DurationMS * int64(plan.Output.FPSNum) / (1000 * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen))
        }
        for trackIndex := range compiled.VideoTracks {
            segments := make([]contract.VideoSegmentV2, 0, len(compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments))
            for _, segment := range compiled.VideoTracks[trackIndex].Segments {
                if !segment.StockPoolSlot {
                    segments = append(segments, segment)
                    continue
                }
                remaining, timelineFrame := segment.FrameCount, segment.TimelineStartFrame
                part := 0
                for remaining > 0 {
                    for poolCursor < len(ordered) && framesLeft["stockpool:"+ordered[poolCursor].DriveFileID] <= 0 {
                        poolCursor++
                    }
                    if poolCursor >= len(ordered) {
                        return nil, errors.New("selected stock pool duration is shorter than its timeline slots")
                    }
                    member := ordered[poolCursor]
                    part++
                    baseAssetID := "stockpool:" + member.DriveFileID
                    binding := bindings[baseAssetID]
                    count := framesLeft[baseAssetID]
                    if count > remaining {
                        count = remaining
                    }
                    assetID := fmt.Sprintf("%s:timeline:%d", baseAssetID, timelineFrame)
                    durationUS := count * int64(plan.Output.FPSDen) * 1_000_000 / int64(plan.Output.FPSNum)
                    asset := contract.AssetRefV2{AssetID: assetID, AssetKey: member.DriveFileID, SourceKind: "drive", DriveFileID: member.DriveFileID, SHA256: binding.SHA256, SizeBytes: binding.Size, Kind: "video", MIME: "video/mp4", ProfileID: plan.Output.ProfileID, FrameCount: count, TimelineRevision: plan.TimelineRevision, TimelineSHA256: plan.TimelineSHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FirstFrameKeyframe: true, ClosedGOP: true, DurationUS: durationUS, Width: plan.Output.Width, Height: plan.Output.Height}
                    compiled.Assets = append(compiled.Assets, asset)
                    bindings[assetID] = binding
                    segments = append(segments, contract.VideoSegmentV2{SegmentID: fmt.Sprintf("%s-source-%03d", segment.SegmentID, part), AssetID: assetID, SHA256: asset.SHA256, TimelineStartFrame: timelineFrame, FrameCount: count, SourceDurationUS: durationUS})

Il fix adesso instrada le submission in due fasi verso l’executor slice già presente, e riconosce i runtime asset con `role=stock`: i segmenti stock legacy diventano slot selezionati dal pool sul worker; overlay, clip e audio restano intatti. Il worker usa i binding già verificati e ripete il pool in modo deterministico se la durata totale dei file è inferiore alla timeline; non introduce probe sui singoli stock. Sto rivedendo ora il diff e i vincoli del renderer nativo, poi aggiorno la verifica completa per i moduli toccati.

    +    byID := make(map[string]struct{})

## Assistant

Capito: il render citato era un backup vecchio. **Non l’ho rilanciato né ho fatto deploy**; ho lavorato solo sul codice di VeloxEditingg.

Ho corretto il routing: i job in PREPARE restano sullo slice executor finché non arrivano i riferimenti Drive. Se un piano legacy chiede un taglio stock non sicuro, il worker ora lo rifiuta subito con un errore esplicito, senza probe, taglio o ricodifica dello stock.

Test mirati di contratto, enqueue, intake e worker superati. Modifica committata e inviata su `main`: `6d3027c2`.

Questo evita il routing errato e l’assemblaggio di un risultato scorretto; non trasforma da solo un piano legacy a finestre in un piano `stock_pool` di clip interi.
